Luna saw Max trying to destroy the safe. Luna said, "Max, let me help you." Max laughed, "You are too small, Luna. You cannot destroy the safe." But Luna had a secret plan. Luna used her small paws to press some buttons on the safe. Click! The safe opened! Max was surprised. Inside the safe were lots of toys. Max and Luna played with the toys and had lots of fun. They learned that working together was better than trying to destroy things.

Tom and Sam are friends. They like to play with cars and balls. But today they have a fight. Tom wants the red car and Sam wants the red car too. They both pull the car and say "Mine!" "Stop!" says Mom. "You have to share. There are many cars to play with. Why don't you take turns?" But Tom and Sam do not listen. They keep pulling the car and shouting. They make a lot of noise and mess. Mom is angry. She takes the car away and puts it on a high shelf. She says "No more car for you. Go to your rooms and think about what you did." Tom and Sam are sad. They go to their rooms and sit on their beds. They do not have any toys to play with. They are bored and lonely. They start to miss each other. They think about their fight and feel sorry. They get up and walk to the door. They open the door and see each other. They smile and hug. They say "I'm sorry. I was mean. You can have the red car. I like you." Mom hears them and smiles. She is happy. She brings the car down and gives it to them. She says "I'm proud of you. You are good friends. Now you can play nicely." Tom and Sam are happy. They take the car and play together. They share and take turns. They have fun and laugh. They are not tired anymore. They are glad.

One day, a large bug named Bob wanted to play. He went outside and saw a strip of grass. The strip of grass was very long and green. Bob thought it would be fun to crawl on the strip of grass. As Bob started to crawl, he met a small bug named Tim. Tim was also crawling on the strip of grass. They decided to crawl together and play on the large strip of grass. They crawled and played all day long. They had so much fun on the large strip of grass. When the sun went down, Bob and Tim said goodbye and went back to their homes. They were very happy and tired from their fun day of crawling and playing on the large strip of grass.

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. There is a big fence around the park. The fence is brown and hard. One day, Lily and Ben see a dog. The dog is on the other side of the fence. The dog is black and white and has a long tail. The dog looks sad. "Hello, dog!" Lily says. "Do you want to play with us?" The dog wags its tail and barks. It wants to play, but it cannot get through the fence. "Can we help the dog?" Ben asks. Lily thinks. She sees a hole in the fence. The hole is small, but maybe the dog can fit. "Look, Ben! There is a hole! Maybe the dog can come through!" Lily says. Lily and Ben run to the hole. They call the dog. The dog runs to the hole, too. It tries to squeeze through, but it is too big. It gets stuck. "Oh no! The dog is stuck!" Lily says. "Don't worry, dog! We will help you!" Ben says. Lily and Ben pull the dog gently. The dog pushes with its legs. Slowly, the dog comes out of the hole. It is free! "Yay! The dog is free!" Lily and Ben cheer. The dog is happy. It licks Lily and Ben's faces. It wags its tail. It jumps and runs with them. "Thank you, Lily and Ben! You are very kind!" the dog says. "You are welcome, dog! You are very cute!" Lily and Ben say. They hug the dog. The dog hugs them back. They feel warm and cozy. They play in the park until the sun goes down. Then they say goodbye to the dog and go home. They hope to see the dog again. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a witch. She lived in a big house. The witch was very rich. She had many toys and a big bed. She was not mean. She liked to help people. One day, it was very cold. The witch saw a little girl outside. The girl was shivering. The witch felt sad. She wanted to help the girl. The witch gave the girl a warm coat. The little girl was happy. She said thank you to the witch. The witch was happy too. They became friends. The witch and the girl played with the toys in the big house. They were very happy together.

One day, a little girl named Amy went to play outside. She saw a little bird with a rope on its foot. The rope was locked to a tree. The little bird was sad and wanted to fly. Amy said, "Don't worry, little bird. I will help you." She tried to unlock the rope, but it was too hard. Amy felt sad too. She wanted to help the little bird. Amy went to her mommy and said, "Mommy, a little bird needs help. The rope is locked, and it can't fly." Mommy went outside with Amy. They both helped the little bird. The bird was happy and flew away. Amy and her mommy felt happy too. They went inside and had a big hug.

Once upon a time there was an old lady who was very generous. She liked to give things to other people and make them very happy. One day, she decided to make a big surprise for her street. She bought a giant tub of ice cream and made cones for all the children to enjoy. That day it was raining but it didn't stop the old lady from serving everyone a delicious treat. She even made the biggest cone ever for the most special little girl. She was so wet from the rain but the old lady carefully used her umbrella to keep the ice cream warm and dry. The children all happily enjoyed their treats, and thanked the old lady for being so generous. They knew that it was a special day, and every time it rained they would never forget how caring and thoughtful the old lady was to serve them ice cream.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Mike and his cousin Kate. They were out in the park when they found a map. "What is it?" asked Mike. "It's a map!" said Kate. Mike was excited and wanted to know where it would lead them. "Let's find out!" he said. So, Mike and Kate followed the map until they reached a frozen lake. It looked so icy and pretty. "It looks so nice!" Kate said. Suddenly, Mike heard a loud noise and the lake started to crack. Before Mike and Kate had time to react, the lake was breaking apart. Mike and Kate ran as fast as they could and made it back safely to the park. But Mike and Kate were never able to tell anyone what happened that day.

Once upon a time, in a regular house, there lived a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily lost her favorite mitten. She looked everywhere for it, but it seemed to vanish. Lily asked her mom, "Mom, have you seen my mitten?" Her mom replied, "No, sweetie, I have not seen it. Maybe it is outside." So, Lily went outside to look for her mitten. She saw her friend, Max, playing with a ball. "Max," she asked, "have you seen my mitten?" Max shook his head and said, "No, Lily, I have not seen it, but I will help you look." Together, Lily and Max looked all around the yard. At last, they found the mitten under a big tree. Lily was so happy and said, "Thank you, Max!" They both went back to playing, and Lily made sure to keep her mitten safe.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim was a bit weird. He had a special power to freeze things. One day, Tim went to school. He was scared because he had an exam. During the exam, Tim thought of his power. He wanted to do something unexpected. He wanted to freeze the exam. So, he used his power and the exam froze. All the kids in the class were surprised. But then, something strange happened. The frozen exam started to melt. The exam turned into a big ice cream! All the kids were happy. They ate the ice cream and forgot about the exam. The teacher was happy too, because she loved ice cream. And that's how Tim's weird power saved the day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue liked to play with her toys and her dog, Max. One day, she saw a different door in her house. She had never seen this door before. It was a small door, just her size. Sue opened the door and found a room full of toys. She was so happy! She played with the toys all day. Then, she saw a big red button on the wall. It said, "Send." Sue didn't know what it meant, but she pushed it anyway. Suddenly, all the toys in the room changed! The toys were now alive and could talk. They were nice and played with Sue. She had so much fun with her new friends. The different door and the "Send" button made her day full of surprises and fun.

Once upon a time there was a girl who loved to solve puzzles. Every day after school she would go to the gym with her friends. The gym was her favorite place because it had a lot of puzzles to solve. One day the girl and her friends were in the gym and she noticed something special. On the wall was a large poster with puzzles that looked to be very difficult to solve. The girl was so excited! She decided to challenge herself and try to solve the puzzles. As her friends watched, she slowly began to put the pieces together. Finally, after a lot of hard work and dedication, the girl had solved the puzzles! She was so proud of herself that she decided to start going to the gym on a regular basis to practice solving puzzles. The girl's friends were so impressed with her determination, and she was very happy to have them for encouragement. She kept improving her skills until she became an expert puzzle solver!

Once upon a time, there was a unique dog named Spot. Spot loved to play golf. One day, Spot and his friend, Kitty, went to the park to play golf. Spot said, "I love golf! Let's play!" As they played, Spot began to suffer. His paw hurt a lot. Spot said, "Ouch! My paw hurts." Kitty looked worried and said, "Oh no, we must go home and make it better." They went home to rest and help Spot's paw. But then, something unexpected happened. Spot's paw didn't hurt anymore. It turned out that Spot's paw was just tired from playing too much golf. Spot and Kitty laughed and said, "We can play golf again tomorrow!" And they lived happily ever after.

Lila and Ben were playing in the park with their mom. They liked to swing, slide and run. They were having fun. But soon, Lila felt a rumble in her tummy. She was hungry. She wanted a snack. She looked at her mom and said, "Mom, can I have a cookie?" Mom smiled and said, "Yes, you can have one cookie. But only one, okay? We will have lunch soon." Lila nodded and ran to the bench where mom had a bag. She opened the bag and saw many cookies. They looked yummy. She had an urge to eat more than one. She thought, maybe mom will not notice. She reached for a second cookie, but then she heard Ben's voice. He was also hungry. He said, "Lila, can I have a cookie too?" Lila felt guilty. She knew she should share with her brother. She also knew mom would not permit her to eat more than one. She said, "Sorry, Ben. I was greedy. Here, you can have this cookie." Ben smiled and said, "Thank you, Lila. You are a good sister. I love you." Lila hugged him and said, "I love you too. And I love mom. And I love cookies. But not too many." They ate their cookies and waited for mom to call them for lunch. They were happy.

One sunny day, a boy named Tim went to the park to play. He saw his friends there. They were playing a fun game. Tim wanted to play too. He was very excited. Tim's friends said, "We are playing a game. The game is to see who can throw a ball the farthest. The one who throws the farthest will win." Tim thought that was amazing. He wanted to win the game. Tim used his strong arm to throw the ball. He threw it very far. His friends were surprised. Tim won the game. They all clapped and cheered for him. Tim felt happy and proud.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a little dog named Max. Max was a happy dog, but he was always trying to escape from his yard. One day, he saw a big hole in the fence. Max thought, "This is my chance to go out and play!" Max went through the hole and ran to the park. He saw a big tree and wanted to rub his back on it. He rubbed and rubbed, but he could not get the itch to go away. Max was very frustrated. He wanted to go back home, but he didn't know how. Max tried to find his way home, but he got lost. He was very sad and scared. He missed his warm bed and his food. Max never found his way back home, and he learned that escaping from his yard was not a good idea.

One day, there was a clever meeting. All of the people at the meeting wanted to make something special. They all had ideas, but nobody knew what to do. Then, one clever girl had an idea. She said, “Let’s polish something!” Everyone was excited, so they started to polish. They polished and polished until finally, it was perfect. Everyone was proud of the work that they had done. The next day, they looked at the work they had polished and it shone like a bright star in the sky. Everyone was happy and came away feeling very proud. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a raven. This raven was unusual. It could spin in the sky. One day, the raven met a little bird. The little bird could not spin. The raven wanted to help. The raven said, "I can spin. I will show you how." The little bird was happy. They started to try. The little bird tried to spin, but it was hard. The raven did not give up. They tried again and again. One day, something unexpected happened. The little bird could spin! The raven and the little bird were very happy. They spun together in the sky. The moral of the story is to never give up and help others learn new things.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a delicate butterfly. The butterfly liked to fly around and play with its friends. One day, the butterfly met a wise old owl. The owl told the butterfly about a special law in the town. The law said that everyone must attach something nice to their homes. The butterfly thought this was a good idea. It wanted to make its home pretty too. So, it asked the owl, "How can I attach something nice to my home?" The owl told the butterfly to find a beautiful flower and attach it to its home. The butterfly flew around and found the most colorful flower. It carefully attached the flower to its home. The butterfly's home looked very pretty with the flower. All its friends loved it and they all lived happily together.

Once upon a time, there was a big, reliable dog named Buddy. Buddy was very good at helping his friends. One day, Buddy went to the park with his friend, Tim. Tim said, "Buddy, I want to play, but I am tired. Can you find me a place to rest?" Buddy wagged his tail and ran to find a nice spot for Tim. He found a big tree with soft grass under it. "Here, Tim! This is a good place to rest," said Buddy. While Tim was resting, Buddy saw a small cat stuck in a tree. Buddy wanted to help the cat, so he climbed up the tree. But as Buddy tried to save the cat, he got a big rub from the tree branch. The rub hurt Buddy a lot, and he fell down from the tree. Tim woke up from his rest and saw Buddy on the ground. Tim was sad because Buddy was hurt, and they both went home with a bad ending to their day.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Mia and her dog, Spot, went for a walk. They saw a big door that was close. Mia felt the urge to open it. She asked Spot, "Do you think we can open it?" Spot barked, "Woof!" Mia tried to open the door, but it was not available to open. She was sad. Spot tried to help her, but he could not open it too. Just then, a friendly bird came by. The bird saw Mia and Spot were sad. The bird said, "I can help you open the door!" The bird flew up and pushed a button. The door opened! Mia and Spot were so happy. They thanked the bird and went through the door to play.

Once upon a time, in an ancient garden, there was a little red poppy. The poppy loved the sun and the rain, and it grew tall and strong. One day, a small bug came to visit the poppy. The bug was very happy to see the poppy, and they became friends. "Hi, poppy!" said the bug. "You are so pretty and red!" "Thank you, bug!" said the poppy. "I like your tiny legs and wings!" One hot day, the sun was shining very bright. The poppy started to feel too hot, and it felt like it was going to burn. The bug saw the poppy was not happy, and it wanted to help. "Poppy, you look too hot!" said the bug. "I will find some shade for you." The bug flew away and found a big leaf. It brought the leaf to the poppy, and the leaf gave the poppy some shade. The poppy did not burn and was very happy. The poppy and the bug were best friends forever, and they played in the ancient garden every day.

Once upon a time, there was a tough pumpkin. It was a huge pumpkin, the biggest one the farmer had ever seen. One day, the farmer wanted to separate the pumpkin into two pieces. He tried very hard to do it, but the pumpkin was too tough. He asked the 3-year-old child to help him. The child said, "I can't do it - it's too tough!" But the farmer said, "I know you can do it. Just try it." The child tried to separate the pumpkin, but it was too hard. He tried and tried, but after 10 minutes, he still couldn't do it. He became frustrated and started crying. The farmer said, "It's okay. I understand. You tried your best." He gave the child a hug, and they both went inside the house. The tough pumpkin stayed together and was never separated. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a yellow cat named Max. Max loved to play with his rope toy. One day, Max was playing with his rope in the park when something unexpected happened. A little bird came and took his rope away. Max was sad and wanted his rope back. Max ran after the bird to get his rope back. He chased the bird up a tree, but Max was too scared to climb the tree. Max felt embarrass because he was a cat and cats are good at climbing trees. He didn't know what to do. Then, a friendly dog named Bella came to help Max. Bella had a great idea. She took Max's rope from the bird and gave it back to Max. Max was so happy to have his rope back. In the end, Max and Bella became best friends and they played with the rope together.

One day, a boy named Tim saw a big motorcycle. It was shiny and loud. Tim liked the motorcycle a lot. He wanted to ride it, but it was too far away. He could only see it from a distant place. Tim's dad saw him looking at the motorcycle. He asked, "Do you like the motorcycle, Tim?" Tim nodded his head and said, "Yes, I want to ride it." His dad smiled and said, "Maybe one day when you are big, you can ride a motorcycle too." Later, Tim and his dad went to the park. They saw a toy motorcycle on the ground. Tim's dad picked it up and gave it to Tim. Tim was very happy. He played with the toy motorcycle all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a popular pet. It was a dog. The dog loved to play with kids. One day, the dog went to the park. It saw a big tree. The tree could provide shade. The dog sat under the tree. A mean cat came to the park. The cat did not like the dog. The cat scared the dog away. The dog was sad. The end.

Lily and Ben were very happy. They were going to visit Grandma and Grandpa for a week. They had a big bag with clothes and toys. Mom and Dad helped them put the bag in the car. They said goodbye to their house and their cat. The car ride was long, but fun. They sang songs, played games, and looked out the window. They saw cows, horses, and trees. They ate some sweet cookies that Mom made. They drank some juice. They felt sleepy and took a nap. When they woke up, they were at Grandma and Grandpa's house. They were very excited. They jumped out of the car and ran to hug them. Grandma and Grandpa were very happy to see them. They gave them big kisses and hugs. They said, "Welcome, Lily and Ben! We have a lot of fun things to do with you!" They went inside the house. It was warm and cozy. It smelled like bread and flowers. Grandma and Grandpa showed them their room. It had two beds, a table, and a shelf. They said, "This is your room for the week. You can unpack your bag and put your things here." Lily and Ben unpacked their bag. They took out their clothes and put them in a drawer. They took out their toys and put them on the shelf. They took out their books and put them on the table. They said, "Thank you, Grandma and Grandpa! This is a nice room. We like it here!" They hugged their body and smiled. They were happy to be with Grandma and Grandpa. They were ready to have a lot of fun. They said, "We love you, Grandma and Grandpa! You are the best!"

Tom and Lily wanted to go to the beach. They liked to play in the sand and the water. But first they had to complete their chores. Mom said they had to clean their room and help with the dishes. Tom and Lily did not like chores. They wanted to go to the beach now. They tried to do their chores fast. But they did not do them well. They threw their toys in the closet and hid the dirty dishes under the sink. They hoped Mom would not notice. They ran to the door and said they were ready to go to the beach. Mom looked at them and smiled. She said she had a surprise for them. She took them to the car and drove to the beach. Tom and Lily were happy. They thought they had tricked Mom. They did not know Mom had checked their room and the kitchen. She had seen their mess. When they got to the beach, they saw a big sign. It said: "Beach closed. No swimming. Jellyfish alert." Tom and Lily were sad. They could not play in the water. They could only sit on the hot sand. They wished they had done their chores better. They learned their lesson.

Once upon a time, there was a big gym. In the gym, there were many fun things to do. There were balls to play with and ropes to climb. All the kids loved going to the gym to play. One day, a little boy named Tim went to the gym. He saw a big, red ball that he wanted to play with. But the ball belonged to another kid named Sam. Tim asked Sam if he could borrow the ball. Sam said yes, but only if Tim promised to give it back. Tim said he would, but he was not really sorry for taking the ball. Tim played with the ball all day, and it was so much fun. But then, something unexpected happened. The ball popped! Tim was very scared. He knew he had to tell Sam what happened, but he was afraid Sam would be mad. When Tim told Sam about the ball, Sam was very sad. Tim felt bad, but it was too late. The ball was gone. The moral of the story is that you should always be sorry when you borrow things, and take care of them as if they were your own.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl named Lucy. One day, Lucy was sad and tired. She sighed loudly and asked her mom, "Why am I so tired?" Her mom put her arm around her and said, "Sometimes you feel tired when you don't get enough sleep." Lucy yawned and nodded. "But why? I want to play." Her mom smiled and said, "You can play, but first let's have some dinner. I made your favorite – spaghetti with sauce!" Lucy's face lit up. She hugged her mom tight and said, "Yay! I love spaghetti with sauce!" She happily ate her dinner and sighed with contentment. As she drifted off to sleep, Lucy knew she was never too tired to enjoy her favorite dinner.

One day, a girl named Lily went to the park with her mom. Lily wore her favorite hat. It was a healthy day outside, with the sun shining and birds singing. Lily saw her friend, Tim, by the tree. "Hi, Tim!" said Lily. "What are you doing?" "I am eating a prune," said Tim. Lily had never seen a prune before. It was small and dark. Tim gave her one to try. Lily liked the taste. As they were eating prunes, a big wind came. Lily's hat flew off her head! It went high up into the tree. Lily and Tim were sad. Then, a friendly bird saw the hat and picked it up. The bird flew down and put the hat back on Lily's head. Lily and Tim were surprised and happy. They thanked the bird and went on to play together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boat. The boat was on a big lake. The boat liked to rock back and forth on the water. The boat felt happy when it rocked. One day, the boat saw a big wake in the water. The wake was from a big fish. The fish was jumping and playing in the water. The fish made the boat rock even more. The boat liked the fish. But then, the boat started to feel uncomfortable. The boat rocked too much. The boat wanted the fish to stop. The boat asked the fish to stop making the wake. The fish stopped, and the boat felt happy again. The boat and the fish were friends.

One day, a little girl named Emily wanted to go outside and play. She asked her mom if it was okay and her mom said it was fine. Emily got ready and went out to the garden. She wanted to tie something, so she took some rope and tied it to a tree. But the ground was wet, so Emily got muddy. She didn't like being all wet and cold, so she ran back inside. Inside the house, Emily found some ribbon and decided to try and tie again. She held it in her hands and tried to tie a bow. She tried and tried but couldn't do it. Just then, her older brother came in. He could tie a bow. He showed Emily how to tie a bow and soon Emily was tying them by herself. She looked at her bows and was very proud of her fine work. Emily was happy and ready to go back outside and continue playing.

One day, a little bird named Tim was flying in the sky. He was an intelligent bird who loved to sing songs. Tim had many friends in the forest. Tim met a big bear named Ben. Ben was sad because he lost his way home. Tim wanted to help him. "Do you trust me, Ben?" asked Tim. "Yes, I trust you," said Ben. Tim sang a happy song to make Ben feel better. Tim and Ben walked and walked. They found Ben's home with the help of Tim's songs. Ben was so happy to be home. He thanked Tim for being a good friend. They played together and sang songs every day.

Lily was a little girl who liked to crawl. She crawled under the table, behind the sofa and into the closet. She liked to pretend she was a cat or a snake or a bug. She made funny noises and moved fast or slow. One day, she crawled into the kitchen and saw a big blue cake on the counter. It smelled sweet and yummy. She wanted to taste it, but it was too high for her. She looked around and saw a chair. She crawled to the chair and climbed on it. She reached for the cake, but it was still too far. She heard a voice behind her. It was her daddy. He said, "Lily, what are you doing? That cake is for mommy's birthday. You can't have it now. You have to wait until later." Lily turned around and saw her daddy. He was smiling, but he looked a little angry. She felt sorry and scared. She said, "I'm sorry, daddy. I just wanted to see the cake. It's so blue and pretty. Can I have a little bit, please?" Daddy shook his head and said, "No, Lily. You have to be patient and polite. You can have some cake after we sing happy birthday to mommy. Come on, let's go find mommy and give her a hug. She will be happy to see you." He lifted Lily off the chair and carried her to the living room. Lily hugged her daddy and said, "I love you, daddy. And I love mommy. And I love cake. Can we sing happy birthday now?" Daddy laughed and said, "Yes, Lily. We can sing happy birthday now. You are a sweet and silly girl. But next time, don't crawl to the cake. Ask me first, okay?" Lily nodded and said, "Okay, daddy. I will ask you first. But can I still crawl to the closet?" Daddy smiled and said, "Yes, Lily. You can still crawl to the closet. But be careful and don't make a mess. And come out when I call you, okay?" Lily said, "Okay, daddy. Thank you, daddy. You are the best daddy ever." They hugged and kissed and went to the living room. Mommy was there, waiting for them. She had a big smile on her face. She said, "Hello, Lily. Hello, daddy. Are you ready to sing happy birthday to me?" Lily said, "Yes, mommy. We are ready. We love you, mommy. And we love your blue cake. Can we have some now?" Mommy said, "Yes, Lily. You can have some now. But first, let's sing happy birthday to me. And then, let's make a wish and blow the candles. And then, let's share the cake and have fun. How does that sound?" Lily said, "That sounds great, mommy. Happy birthday, mommy. You are the best mommy ever." They sang happy birthday to mommy. They made a wish and blew the candles. They shared the cake and had fun. Lily ate a big piece of blue cake. She liked it very much. She was happy and full. She crawled to the closet and took a nap. She dreamed of blue cakes and cats and snakes and bugs. She was a happy little girl.

Sara and Tom are going on a big trip with Mom and Dad. They are very happy and excited. They pack their bags and toys and get in the car. Mom and Dad have passports. Passports are papers that let you go to other places. When they get to the airport, they have to wait in a long line. Sara and Tom are bored and tired. They see a big scissors on a table. Sara has an idea. She takes the scissors and says to Tom, "Let's play cut and paste. We can make pictures with the passports." Tom thinks that sounds fun. He takes Mom's passport and Sara takes Dad's passport. They start to cut them into pieces. They make shapes and animals and letters. They laugh and giggle. Mom and Dad do not see them. They are busy talking to a man. The man looks at their passports and frowns. He says, "These passports are not good. They are cut and torn. You cannot go on the trip. You have to get new passports." Mom and Dad turn around and see Sara and Tom with the scissors and the pieces of passports. They are very angry and sad. They say, "Sara and Tom, what have you done? You have ruined our passports. Now we cannot go on the trip. We have to go home." Sara and Tom feel bad. They did not know passports were important. They say, "We are sorry, Mom and Dad. We just wanted to play. We did not mean to make you mad." Mom and Dad hug them and say, "We love you, Sara and Tom. But you have to be careful with things that are not yours. Passports are not for playing. They are for traveling. Maybe we can go on the trip another time. But now we have to go home." They pack their bags and toys and get in the car. Sara and Tom are quiet and sad. They look at the pieces of passports. They are dry and dull. They wish they had not cut them. They wish they had gone on the trip.

Once upon a time, there was a pretty flower named Lily. Lily lived in a big garden with many other flowers. Lily was a very reliable flower because she always helped her friends. One day, all the flowers in the garden wanted to perform a dance. They had a big show for all the bugs and birds to see. Lily was so excited to dance with her friends. She practiced her dance moves every day. The day of the dance came and all the flowers were ready to perform. Lily danced so well that all the bugs and birds clapped for her. Lily was very happy, and her friends were proud of her. They knew they could always count on reliable Lily to help them.

Sara and Tom are friends. They like to play with cars and dolls. One day, Sara finds a shiny key on the floor. She picks it up and puts it in her pocket. "Look, Tom, I have a key!" Sara says. "It is shiny and pretty. I can open doors with it." Tom wants the key too. He thinks it is his key. He lost his key yesterday. He tries to grab the key from Sara. "Give me the key, Sara!" Tom says. "It is my key. You took it from me." "No, Tom, it is my key!" Sara says. "I found it on the floor. You can't have it." They pull and tug on the key. They are angry and sad. They don't want to share the key. Mom sees them fighting. She comes over and takes the key from them. "Stop fighting, Sara and Tom!" Mom says. "This is not your key. This is the key to the car. I dropped it this morning. You can't play with it. It is not a toy. It is important." Sara and Tom feel sorry. They say sorry to Mom and to each other. Mom gives them a hug and a kiss. She says they can play with something else. "Here, Sara and Tom, you can play with these cookies," Mom says. "They are sweet and yummy. You can share them and be happy." Sara and Tom smile. They take the cookies and say thank you to Mom. They sit down and eat the cookies. They are sweet and yummy. They share them and are happy. They are friends again.

One day, a little dog named Max wanted to play. He saw his friend, a big cat named Tom. Max was glad to see Tom. He wanted to invite Tom to play with him. He said, "Tom, let's play with the ball!" But Tom was not happy. He was thirsty and wanted to drink water. Tom said, "I cannot play now, I need water." Max wanted to help Tom, so he looked for water. Max found a bowl of water and gave it to Tom. Tom drank the water and felt better. Now, Tom was glad too. He said, "Thank you, Max. Now let's play together!" Max and Tom played with the ball and had a lot of fun. They learned that helping friends is important. When we help our friends, we can all be happy and play together.

One day, a cat and a dog went for a jog. The cat had a wide smile on her face. The dog was very happy too. They liked to jog together. They jogged through a big park with many trees. As they jogged, the cat saw a big red ball. The cat said, "Look, a big red ball! Let's play with it!" The dog wagged his tail and barked, "Yes, let's play!" They stopped jogging and started to play with the ball. They kicked it and chased it. Then, something unexpected happened. A small bird came down from a tree and took the big red ball in its beak. The cat and dog were very surprised. The bird said, "This is my ball. I lost it. Thank you for finding it." The cat and dog looked at each other and smiled. They were happy to help the bird. The bird let the cat rub its head, and they all became friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a toy that he loved very much. It was a ball with a buckle on it. He played with it all day long. One day, Tim saw a big tree that was very far away. He wanted to strike the ball at the tree. So, he threw the ball as hard as he could. The ball went up, up, up in the sky. But it did not come back down. Tim was very sad. He looked for his ball everywhere, but he could not find it. He knew that the tree was very far away, but he did not think that his ball would be lost forever. Now, Tim had no ball to play with.

Once upon a time, in a big nation, there was a stubborn king. The king loved to welcome people to his big house. One day, a small cat came to the king's house. The king welcomed the cat and gave it food. The cat was happy and stayed with the king. The king and the cat became best friends. They played together all day long. One day, the cat found a magic hat. The cat put on the hat and turned into a big lion. The king was scared at first, but the lion was still his friend. They played together and had more fun than before. The stubborn king learned that even small cats can have big surprises.

Once upon a time, there was a gentle girl named Lily. She liked to observe things around her. One day, she went to the store with her mom. At the store, she saw many things. Lily saw a green thing called an avocado. She liked the avocado. She asked her mom if she could have it. Her mom said yes, and they took the avocado home. At home, Lily and her mom cut the avocado. They ate it and it was yummy. Lily was happy to observe and try new things. She learned that avocados are good to eat.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a brilliant, shiny star. This star was a symbol of love and happiness. Every night, the star would bow to the moon and say hello. One day, a little girl named Lily saw the star bow to the moon. She was so happy to see this. She told her friends about the star, and they all wanted to see it too. So, they went to the forest at night to watch the star bow. As they watched the star bow, they felt love and happiness. The brilliant star was like a friend to them. They knew that as long as the star was in the sky, they would always be happy. And so, they went home with big smiles on their faces, knowing that the star would always be there for them.

Ben and Mia were playing in the park. They liked to dig in the sand and find things. Sometimes they found rocks, shells, or coins. One day, they found something different. It was a big, white, hard thing with holes and teeth. It looked like a head, but not a real one. "Wow, what is this?" Ben asked. "I don't know. Maybe it is a skull," Mia said. "A skull? What is a skull?" Ben wondered. "It is what is inside your head. It holds your brain and your eyes and your mouth," Mia explained. "That is cool. Can we keep it?" Ben asked. "Sure, why not? Let's show it to mom and dad. Maybe they will know more about it," Mia said. They put the skull in a bag and ran to their parents, who were sitting on a bench. They were very excited to show them their discovery. "Mom, dad, look what we found!" Ben shouted. "Let us see, honey," mom said. They opened the bag and took out the skull. Mom and dad gasped and looked scared. "Where did you get this?" dad asked. "We found it in the sand. It is a skull. Isn't it cool?" Mia said. "No, it is not cool. It is dangerous. This is not a normal skull. It is a colorful skull. It belongs to a bad man who did bad things. He had a curse on him. If you touch his skull, you will get sick and die," dad said. "What? No, that can't be true. We touched it. We are fine," Ben said. But as he said that, he felt a pain in his chest. He looked at his hand and saw it was turning red and purple. He screamed and dropped the skull. Mia felt a pain in her head. She looked at her face and saw it was turning green and yellow. She screamed and fell to the ground. Mom and dad tried to help them, but it was too late. The curse had killed them. The skull laughed and said, "I told you not to touch me. Now you are mine." The end.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to drink milk every day. They drank milk in the morning, at lunch, and before bed. They thought milk made them strong and healthy. One day, they saw a big bottle of milk in the fridge. It was bigger than any bottle they had seen before. They wanted to drink it all. "Let's drink this milk," Tom said. "Maybe we will become huge like giants." "Yes, let's drink it," Lily agreed. "Maybe we will become huge like elephants." They opened the bottle and drank and drank and drank. They drank so much that their tummies hurt. They drank so much that they felt sick. They drank so much that they could not move. "Tom, I don't feel good," Lily said. "I think we drank too much milk." "Me too, Lily," Tom said. "I think we were greedy." They lay on the floor and moaned. They wished they had not drunk so much milk. They wished they had shared the milk with their mom and dad and their friends. Soon, their mom came home and saw them on the floor. She was worried and angry. "Tom, Lily, what happened?" she asked. "Why did you drink all the milk?" "We wanted to become huge," Tom and Lily said. "That was a silly idea," their mom said. "Milk is good for you, but too much of anything is bad for you. You should drink milk in moderation and share it with others. That is the right thing to do." Tom and Lily felt sorry and ashamed. They hugged their mom and said they were sorry. They learned their lesson. They never drank too much milk again. They became happy and healthy children who shared and cared.

Once upon a time, there was a big and interesting temple. Inside the temple, there were many animals. One day, a small bird wanted to raise her nest high up in the temple. The bird asked her friend, a big elephant, "Can you help me raise my nest?" The elephant said, "Yes, I will help you." The elephant used his long nose to lift the bird's nest up high in the temple. The bird was very happy. She thanked the elephant and said, "You are a good friend. Now my nest is safe and high." They both lived happily in the interesting temple.

Once upon a time, there was a wise, old owl. The owl had a big family. He loved his family very much. The owl liked to write. He wrote stories for his family. One day, the owl's little baby asked, "Dad, can you write me a story?" The wise owl smiled and said, "Yes, my little one. I will write you a story." The wise owl wrote a story about a brave cat. The cat went on a big adventure. The cat met new friends. The cat helped his friends. The owl's family loved the story. They were happy and clapped their wings. The wise owl said, "I am glad you liked the story, my family." The little baby owl hugged his dad. The wise owl's family was very happy. They all went to sleep with the story in their hearts.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He had a blue scooter that he loved to ride. Every day, he would ride his scooter up and down the street, laughing and having fun. One day, Tim tried to ride his scooter down a big hill. He was scared, but he wanted to try. He started going down the hill very fast. Tim felt like he couldn't manage to control his scooter. He was going too fast! Suddenly, a big dog jumped in front of him. Tim was so surprised that he fell off his scooter. He felt ashamed that he couldn't manage the hill. But then, the big dog picked up Tim's scooter in its mouth and brought it back to him. Tim realized that the dog wanted to help him. He thanked the dog and tried going down the hill again. This time, with the dog by his side, Tim managed to ride down the hill without falling. They became best friends and rode together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a big field. In the field, there was a hidden spot. It was behind a big tree. The tree had many leaves and was very tall. One day, a small cat named Kitty found the hidden spot. Kitty liked it very much. She played there every day. She liked to hide and jump out when her friends came by. One day, Kitty saw a little dog named Spot. Spot was sad. Kitty asked Spot to join her in the hidden spot. They played together and had lots of fun. Spot was happy to have a new friend and a fun place to play. From that day on, Kitty and Spot played in the hidden spot every day. They were very happy together.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy named Tim. He loved to read books. One day, he went to the library with his mom. He wanted to find a new book to read. At the library, Tim met a nice lady who worked there. She said, "I recommend this book for you, Tim." She gave him a book with many pages. Tim was very happy and said, "Thank you!" He started to read the book right away. But when Tim turned to the last page, something unexpected happened. The pages stuck together and he could not see the end of the story. Tim was sad and cried. He tried to fix the book, but he could not. His mom said they had to go home. Tim left the library with the broken book, feeling very sad.

One day, a curious little boy named Tim went for a walk. He saw a big cop car on the street. Tim hoped to meet a cop one day. He walked closer to the car and saw a big cop standing next to it. "Hi, I'm Tim," said the little boy. "I hope to be a cop one day, just like you!" The cop smiled and said, "Hi Tim, I'm Officer Sam. It's nice to meet you. If you work hard and listen to your mom and dad, you can be a cop too." Tim was very happy to meet Officer Sam. They talked for a little while and then Tim went back home. He told his mom and dad about his new friend. They were proud of Tim for being brave and talking to the cop. Now Tim knew he could be a cop one day, just like Officer Sam.

Once upon a time, there was a clumsy boy named Tim. He loved to eat avocado. One day, while Tim was walking, he saw a big avocado tree. He wanted to get the avocado from the tree. Tim asked his friend, Sam, to support him. They both went to the tree. Sam lifted Tim up to reach the avocado. Tim tried to grab it, but he was clumsy and fell down. They both laughed and tried again. This time, Tim held on tight and got the avocado. But, when they opened it, they found something unexpected. Inside the avocado was a shiny gold coin! They were so surprised and happy. Tim and Sam decided to share the gold coin and buy more avocados.

One day, a kid named Ben went to the park with his mom. He saw a big slide and wanted to try it. He ran to the slide and climbed up the ladder. He was very happy and excited. But when he reached the top, he saw another kid sitting on the slide. The other kid was bigger than Ben and had a mean face. He said, "This is my slide. Go away. You can't play here." Ben felt sad and scared. He wanted to slide, but he didn't want to fight. He looked at his mom, who was watching him from a bench. She smiled at him and said, "Ben, you can share the slide with the other kid. Sharing is good. It makes you and others happy." Ben nodded and took a deep breath. He said to the other kid, "Hi, I'm Ben. Can we slide together? It will be more fun." The other kid was surprised. He had never heard anyone say that to him before. He thought for a moment, then said, "Okay, I'm Sam. You can slide with me. But you go first." Ben smiled and thanked Sam. He slid down the slide and felt a warm glow in his heart. He had made a new friend. He waited for Sam at the bottom and said, "That was fun. Do you want to slide again?" Sam nodded and smiled back. He felt a warm glow in his heart too. He had learned to share. He followed Ben to the ladder and said, "Yes, let's slide again. And maybe we can play with the swings and the sandbox too." Ben and Sam played together for a long time. They had a lot of fun and laughed a lot. They were both cheerful and kind. Their moms were proud of them and happy to see them get along. The moral of the story is: Sharing is good. It makes you and others happy. It can also help you make new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was scared to go on the big stage. Her mom and dad said, "You can do it, Lily!" Lily went to touch the stage. It was big and strong. She took a deep breath and walked up the steps. Her friends were waiting for her with big smiles. "Hi, Lily!" they said. "Don't be scared. We are here with you." Lily smiled and felt better. They all held hands and danced on the stage. Everyone clapped and cheered. Lily was not scared anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Max. Max was very tidy. He liked to keep his toys in a neat row. One day, Max saw a spark in the sky. He did not know what it was, but he wanted to find out. Max went to his friend, a big cat named Tom. Tom was always sleepy. Max told Tom about the spark. Tom just yawned and said, "Maybe it is a star." Max thought that maybe Tom was right, but he still wanted to see it up close. So Max and Tom went on a long walk to find the spark. They walked and walked, and Tom yawned and yawned. Then, they finally found the spark. It was a shiny star that had fallen from the sky! Max and Tom took the star back to Max's tidy home. They put the star with Max's toys, and it made them all shine bright.

One day, a busy bee named Bob was flying in the sky. He saw a big tree with a small door on it. Bob was curious and wanted to see what was inside the door. Bob flew to the door and said, "Hello, can I come in?" A small voice inside said, "You need to unlock the door first." Bob looked around and found a tiny key on a leaf. He used the key to unlock the door. Inside, Bob found a little room with many other bees working hard. They were making honey. The bees welcomed Bob and asked if he wanted to help. Bob was happy to join them and they all worked together to make the sweetest honey.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play games with her friends. They played tag, hide and seek, and raced each other. Lily was very competitive. She always wanted to win. One hot day, Lily and her friends decided to race to a big tree. Lily wanted to win so much that she forgot to drink water. She ran and ran, but she felt very tired. Her friends stopped to drink water, but Lily kept running. When Lily reached the tree, she felt very sick. Her friends came and gave her water. Lily learned that it's important to take care of yourself, even when you want to win. The moral of the story is to not forget to care for yourself, even if you are competitive.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very excited to go outside and play. The sun was shining, and the sky was blue. Lily loved to run and jump in the park. One day, Lily saw a beautiful rainbow in the sky. She wanted to introduce her friends to the rainbow. So, she ran to find her friends, Tom and Sue. They all looked at the rainbow and smiled. But then, something unexpected happened. The rainbow started to move! It came down from the sky and touched the ground. Lily, Tom, and Sue were very surprised. They walked closer to the rainbow, and it turned into a slide! They all took turns sliding down the rainbow and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a small cabin in the woods. In the cabin, there was a kind old man. He felt helpless because he could not understand how to fix a hole in his roof. One sunny day, a little bird saw the old man. The bird wanted to help. The bird found a big leaf and put it over the hole in the cabin's roof. The old man was very happy. Now, the old man was not helpless anymore. He understood that even a little bird could help him. The old man and the little bird became good friends. They lived happily in the cabin together.

Once upon a time, there was a big organized party. At the party, there was a yummy cake. All the kids and grown-ups were happy. They liked to dance and play games. One day, a little girl named Amy went to the party. Amy loved to dance. She danced and danced all day. She was so happy. She also wanted to eat the cake. But then, something unexpected happened. A big wind came and took the cake away. Everyone was sad. They did not know what to do. They wanted the cake back. Amy had an idea. She asked all her friends to dance with her. They danced and danced together. The wind saw how much fun they were having. The wind felt bad and brought the cake back. Everyone was happy again. They all ate the cake and danced together. The party was even more fun than before. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a boy named Tim found a broken microphone in his toy box. He did not know how it got there. He wanted to show it to his friend, Lily. So, Tim went to Lily's house as fast as he could. He ran and ran with speed. When Tim got to Lily's house, he said, "Look, Lily! I found a broken microphone in my toy box." Lily looked at the microphone and said, "Wow! Let's try to fix it." They tried to fix the broken microphone together. They used glue and tape. After a while, the microphone was fixed. Tim and Lily were very happy. They sang into the microphone and danced. They had a lot of fun. Tim said, "Thank you for helping me fix the microphone, Lily." Lily smiled and said, "You're welcome, Tim. Let's sing and dance some more!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved popcorn. One day, Sue's mom said they were going to watch a movie. Sue knew this meant they would make popcorn. She was very excited. Before the movie started, Sue and her mom made popcorn. The popcorn was very hot and smelled so good. Sue's mom told her to be careful because the popcorn was hot. Sue really wanted to eat the popcorn, but she didn't want to get hurt. She knew she had to wait. Sue and her mom started to watch the movie. Sue was happy when her mom said it was time to eat the popcorn. She waited, and now it was not too hot. Sue took a bite and it was so yummy. The popcorn was not harsh or hard. Sue was glad she waited and didn't get hurt. She learned that sometimes it's good to settle and wait for the right time.

One day, a little girl named Mia went to visit her friend, Tim. Mia and Tim liked to play and shout together. They also liked to have tea parties with their toys. Today, they decided to have a big tea party outside. Mia and Tim set up a table with cups, plates, and a big pot of tea. They invited all their toys to join the tea party. Mia's teddy bear sat next to Tim's toy car. They all talked and laughed while they drank tea. At the tea party, Mia said, "I wish we were rich!" Tim smiled and said, "We are rich because we have each other and our toys!" They both laughed and shouted, "We are rich!" They drank more tea and played until the sun went down.

Sara and Ben love to play in the park. They like to swing, slide and run. One day, they see a stranger in the park. He has a big bag and a hat. He looks at Sara and Ben and smiles. "Hello, little ones. Do you want to see what I have in my bag?" he says. Sara and Ben are curious. They go near the stranger. He opens his bag and shows them many things. He has toys, books, candy and a ball. "These are for you. You can have anything you want. Just come with me," he says. Sara and Ben are happy. They want the things in the bag. They think the stranger is nice and useful. They forget what their mom told them. She said, "Never go with a stranger. Strangers can be bad. Stay away from them." But then, they hear a loud voice. It is their mom. She is looking for them. She sees them with the stranger. She runs to them and hugs them. "Sara, Ben, what are you doing? Don't you know this man? He is a stranger. He is not your friend. He wants to take you away. He is not useful. He is dangerous," she says. Sara and Ben are scared. They drop the things in the bag. They say sorry to their mom. They do not want to go with the stranger. They want to stay with their mom. They love their mom. She is useful. She is good. She keeps them safe.

Bob was very troubled. He had a lot of smoke in his house, and he couldn't figure out where it was coming from. He asked his friend Sam for help. Sam said, "Let's share our ideas. Maybe that will help!" So they started to talk about the problem. Bob was very scared, because he didn't know what to do about the smoke. Sam said, "I know how to stop the smoke. I think it's coming from outside, so let's close all the windows and doors to make it stop." Bob was so relieved. He did what Sam said, and soon the smoke was gone. Bob and Sam shared a big hug and said goodbye. Bob was very happy. The smoke was gone, and he wasn't so troubled anymore.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named James and Jenny. They were always very nice to each other. One day, they decided to unpack their toy box to find something new to play with. They opened the box, and inside were two pink stuffed animals. The two animals were part of a team, and they were the same colour! James and Jenny were very excited. "Look!" said James, "We can make a game with these two!" Jenny agreed and the two friends decided to plan a game. As they were planning, James said something that Jenny didn't like. "I don't want to play that way," said Jenny in a sad voice. James realized he had made a mistake. He put his arm around Jenny and said, "I'm sorry. It's important to be kind and work together as a team. That's what friendship is all about!" James and Jenny learned an important lesson that day. Being kind to friends and working as a team is the best way to have fun.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a folder on the floor. It was a big folder with a slide picture on it. Tim wanted to know what was inside the folder. He looked around and saw his friend, Sue. "Look, Sue!" Tim said. "I found a folder with a slide on it. What do you think is inside?" Sue looked serious and said, "I don't know, Tim. Let's open it and see." They opened the folder and found a map. The map showed them the way to a big slide they had never seen before. Tim and Sue were so happy and surprised. They followed the map and had lots of fun on the new slide.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. Her name was Angela. Angela loved cartoons and spent most of her days watching them. One day, Angela stayed up past her bedtime watching cartoons. She yawned as the sun was coming up. Her mommy caught her and scolded her for not sleeping. Angela felt guilty for not doing what her mommy said. She knew she should go right to sleep, but she wanted to finish the cartoon. So she kept watching until it was finished and then she went to bed. But later that day, when Angela was still tired, she yawned again. This time, her mommy said something different. She said if Angela was still tired, she should take a nap. Angela was surprised. But she realised she was too sleepy to stay awake, so she nodded and went off to take a nap. The moral of the story is that sometimes it's ok to be a little naughty, as long as you learn from it and make things right. Angela learnt her lesson and knew she wouldn't stay up past her bedtime again.

One day, a girl named Sally went to the store. She wanted to buy some butter. On the way, she saw her friend, Tom. Tom was feeling dizzy. He said, "Sally, I feel dizzy. Can you help me?" Sally tried to resist the urge to laugh. She wanted to help Tom feel better. She said, "Tom, let's sit down for a bit. Then we can go get the butter together." They sat down and soon, Tom felt better. They went to the store to get the butter. But when they got there, they saw a big, silly dog eating all the butter! They did not expect that! Sally and Tom laughed at the silly dog. They said, "We can't be mad at you, dog. You are too funny!" The dog wagged its tail and they all became friends. They went to another store to buy butter and had a fun day together.

Once upon a time, there was a hairy dog named Max. Max liked to play with a small ball. One day, Max found a new game called golf. He saw people hit balls with a stick. Max wanted to try golf too. Max tried to play golf with his small ball. He hit the ball with a stick, but it did not go far. Max felt sad. His friend, a big cat named Sam, saw Max and wanted to help. Sam was good at golf and knew how to make the ball go far. Sam showed Max how to play golf. They played together and had lots of fun. When Max felt sad, Sam would comfort him and say, "It's okay, Max. Try again!" Max got better at golf and was very happy. Max and Sam played golf every day and became best friends.

Once upon a time, in a small lively town, there lived a thief. The thief liked to take things that did not belong to him. One day, the thief saw a girl writing a letter. The girl was very happy. The thief wanted to be happy too, so he took the girl's pen. The girl cried and said, "Please give me back my pen. I need it to write to my friend." The thief felt bad and gave the pen back to the girl. The girl smiled and said, "Thank you. If you want to be happy, you should not take things from others." The thief learned that taking things from others did not make him happy. He decided to change and be a good person. He started to write letters to make friends and share happiness with others. The town became even more lively and everyone was happy. The moral of the story is that being kind and sharing with others brings happiness.

Once upon a time, there was a lovely little ant. This ant lived in a big garden with many friends. They all played together and had fun all day. One day, the lovely little ant wanted to explore the garden. While walking, it found a big, red apple. The ant thought it would be a nice place to remain and rest for a while. It climbed onto the apple and sat down. As the lovely little ant sat on the apple, more friends came to join it. They all remained on the apple, laughing and talking. They had a great time together. The lovely little ant was very happy to have found the apple and to share it with its friends.

Once upon a time, there were two little friends called John and Jane. They both wanted an apple. They looked around everywhere but couldn't find one. Suddenly, they spotted an attractive apple tree in the garden. They both raced to get to the tree and fought over the apples. In the end, John won and plucked an apple from the tree. He took a bite and shared the apple with Jane. Even though they had fought with each other, they still went home as best friends. The end!

One day, a big bug went for a crawl. It saw a huge box full of stuff. The bug was very happy and wanted to play with the stuff. It crawled closer to the box and looked inside. Inside the box, there was a small bug. The small bug said, "Hi! Do you want to play with me?" The big bug said, "Yes! I want to play with the stuff in the huge box." So, they started to play together. As they played, the big bug found a magic wand. It waved the wand and said, "I wish we could fly!" Suddenly, the big bug and the small bug could fly! They didn't have to crawl anymore. They flew around the room, laughing and playing together. The big bug and the small bug became best friends, and they had lots of fun playing with the stuff in the huge box.

Once upon a time, there was a big, deep hole. A little rabbit lived near the hole. One day, the rabbit saw a window in the hole. The rabbit was very curious and wanted to look inside. The rabbit tried to jump up to the window, but it was too high. The rabbit tried and tried but could not manage to reach the window. Then, the rabbit had an idea. The rabbit found a big box and put it under the window. The rabbit jumped on the box and could now see through the window. Inside the deep hole, the rabbit saw a big, shiny gem. The rabbit wanted the gem, so it jumped through the window into the deep hole. But the hole was too deep, and the rabbit could not jump back out. The rabbit was now stuck in the deep hole, and could not get back home.

One day, a little toy frog named Fred lived in a small room. He liked to jump and play with his friends. They had a lot of fun together. One morning, it was wet outside. The rain made big puddles on the ground. Fred wanted to go out and spring in the puddles. He asked his friends to come with him. They all said yes. They went outside and started to spring in the wet puddles. They laughed and had a great time. The little toy frog and his friends got wet, but they didn't mind. They played all day and loved every moment of it.

Once upon a time, there was a happy girl named Lisa. She loved to play outside with her friends and was always looking for fun things to do. One day, Lisa and her friends were walking in the park when they spotted a big purple bag. Inside was a surprise treat just for them. Lisa was so excited and clapped her hands together. She knew just what to do. "Let's wrap it up!" shouted Lisa's friends. So, with lots of energy the friends quickly wrapped the treat up in the purple bag and ran away laughing. They had so much fun! And Lisa's treat was the best surprise ever.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a big maze. The maze was unusual because it was made of bushes. People liked to play inside the maze. One day, a little boy named Tom went into the maze. He was lost. He met a friendly bird inside. The bird said, "I can help you get out." Tom was happy. The bird would point with its beak to show Tom where to go. They walked and talked together. Finally, they found the way out. Tom thanked the bird and went home. He told his mom about his new friend and the unusual maze.

Once upon a time, in a distant land, there was a big hive. In the hive, there were many bees who worked together. They all loved to share their yummy honey with each other. One sunny day, a little bee named Buzz met a new friend. His friend was a tiny ant named Tiny. Tiny was sad because he had no food. Buzz wanted to help his new friend. Buzz said, "Tiny, let's share my honey with you!" Tiny was very happy. They went to the hive and ate the sweet honey together. From that day on, Buzz and Tiny were the best friends who loved to share.

One day, a little boy named Tim saw a big dog. The dog was sad because he had zero toys. Tim wanted to help the dog. He went to his house to find a toy for the dog. He found a red ball and said, "This will make the dog happy!" Tim went back to the dog and gave him the red ball. The dog was very happy and wagged his tail. They played with the red ball all day. Tim's cat, Fluffy, saw them play and was jealous. She wanted to play too. The next day, Tim found a toy mouse for Fluffy. He said, "Now Fluffy can play too and won't be jealous." Tim, the dog, and Fluffy played together all day. They all had fun and nobody was jealous anymore.

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to the park with her mom. They saw a popcorn man selling popcorn. Lucy loved popcorn, so she asked her mom, "Can I have some popcorn, please?" Her mom said, "Yes, you can have some popcorn." While they were eating the popcorn, a persistent little bird came by. The bird wanted some popcorn too. Lucy said, "No, bird, this is my popcorn!" But the bird did not go away. It kept trying to get the popcorn from Lucy. Then, something unexpected happened. The bird started to sing a song. As it sang, Lucy felt very sleepy. She closed her eyes and went to sleep. The bird took the popcorn and flew away. When Lucy woke up, she saw the bird sharing the popcorn with its friends. She smiled and said, "It's okay, bird. We can share the popcorn."

Once upon a time, there was an old leopard. He lived in a big forest with many trees. The old leopard liked to go for walks every day. One day, as the old leopard went for his walk, he met a small rabbit. The rabbit was very scared, but the old leopard said, "Don't worry, I am your friend. Let's go for a walk together." The rabbit felt happy and they went for a walk. As they walked, the old leopard and the small rabbit saw many things. They saw big trees, pretty flowers, and a big blue sky. They had a lot of fun on their walk. From that day on, the old leopard and the small rabbit became best friends and went for walks together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. She loved to play with her toys. One day, her mom took her to the store. They went to look at new toys. Mia saw a big, pretty doll. It was very expensive. Mia wanted the doll so much. Her mom said, "I promise we will get the doll next time. We need to save money first." Mia felt sad, but she knew her mom always kept her promises. She gave her mom a big hug and said, "Okay, I will wait." A few weeks later, Mia's mom took her back to the store. Mia saw the expensive doll again. This time, her mom said, "We have saved enough money. We can get the doll now." Mia was so happy! The doll came with many things. It included a little bed, clothes, and a tiny tea set. Mia played with her new doll and her toys all day long. She knew that good things come to those who wait.

One day, a dull owl named Oliver lived in a big tree. He had many friends in the forest. But Oliver was not happy. He wanted to be a better friend to everyone. One day, Oliver met a wise old bird. The wise bird said, "To increase your friends, you must be kind and share." So, Oliver thought of a plan. He found a big, red apple and called his friends. He said, "I have a big apple. Let's all share it together." His friends were happy to share. They all ate the apple and had a great time. The wise bird was right. By sharing, Oliver increased his friends and became a better friend. The moral of the story is to be kind and share with others.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Peanut. Peanut was an obedient dog who always did what he was told. He loved to play and run around with his friends in the park. One day, Peanut got very dirty while playing in the mud. His owner, a kind girl named Lily, told him it was time to bathe. Peanut did not like to bathe, but he was an obedient dog, so he listened to Lily. Lily filled the tub with warm water, and Peanut got in. He did not like the water at first, but soon he started to enjoy it. Lily washed Peanut, and he became clean again. After the bath, Peanut was happy because he was clean, and Lily was happy because her dog was obedient. They both learned that sometimes, doing things we don't like can make us happy in the end.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a noisy dog named Max. Max liked to bark all day long. He would bark at the birds, the cars, and even the wind. His barks echoed off the walls of the houses. One day, Max's friend, a little girl named Lisa, came to visit him. She said, "Max, you are so noisy! Can you remain quiet for a little while?" Max looked at Lisa and wagged his tail. He wanted to make her happy, so he tried his best to stay quiet. As they played near the wall, Max heard a cat meowing. It was stuck in a tree! Max wanted to bark, but he remembered what Lisa said. He remained quiet and ran to get help. Lisa saw Max and followed him. Together, they found a tall man who helped the cat down from the tree. The cat was safe, and Max stayed quiet. Lisa was so proud of Max and gave him a big hug. From that day on, Max learned that sometimes it was good to be quiet.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to pour water from her cup into her toy teapot. One day, while Lily was playing, she saw her mom making food for dinner. She wanted to help her mom, so she picked up a big jug of milk to pour into a bowl. But Lily was too small and the jug was too heavy. As she tried to pour the milk, it spilled all over the floor. Lily felt very ashamed because she made a big mess. Her mom saw what happened and came over to help clean up. She told Lily that it's okay to make mistakes and that she was proud of her for trying to help. From that day on, Lily's mom taught her how to pour and make food safely. Lily was so happy that she could help her mom without making a mess. They had lots of fun making food together, and Lily was never ashamed to ask for help when she needed it.

One day, Tom saw a big box while he was walking. He wanted to know what was inside the box. He asked his dad, "What is in the box?" His dad said, "I don't know. Let's see!" Tom and his dad opened the box. Inside the box, there was a big toy car! His dad said, "Wow, it's for you! I'm going to lend it to you for a few days." Tom was very excited and thanked his dad. The next day, Tom went outside with his toy car. He rode it on the sidewalk and used it to race with his friends. Tom had so much fun! He couldn't wait to lend the car to his friends so they could join in the fun. The happy time came to an end, and soon it was time to give the toy car back to his dad. But Tom enjoyed it so much that he kept asking if he could lend it to his friends for one more day. His dad smiled, "Of course you can lend the toy to your friends. Who knows, you might even be able to keep it for a little longer!" In the end, Tom had so much fun with the big box and his toy car that he got to keep them for a little while longer.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a boy named Tim. Tim did not like vegetables. He thought they were boring. Every day, his mom would ask him to eat his vegetables, but he would say "no". One day, Tim went for a walk in the woods. He met a big rabbit. The rabbit said, "Hello, Tim! I see you don't like vegetables. But they can make you strong and healthy. Try to step on this big rock." Tim tried, but he was not strong enough. The next day, Tim ate his vegetables. He ate carrots, peas, and even spinach. He went back to the woods and met the rabbit again. The rabbit said, "Now, try to step on the rock." This time, Tim stepped on the rock easily. Tim learned that eating vegetables can make him strong. He told his mom, "I will eat my vegetables from now on." His mom was happy. Tim was happy too, because he could step on big rocks now. The moral of the story is: eat your vegetables, they make you strong.

One day, a big sack was in a room. In the sack, there was a figure. The figure was a toy. It was a spicy toy. It could talk and walk. The toy did not like the sack. It wanted to go out and play. The toy pushed the sack. It pushed and pushed. The sack did not open. The toy felt sad. It wanted to find a way out. Then, something unexpected happened. A little girl came into the room. She saw the sack and wanted to see what was inside. She opened the sack and the spicy toy jumped out. The little girl was happy. The toy was happy too. They played and played. The toy was no longer sad. The little girl and the toy became best friends.

Once there was a little girl called Lucy. She was three years old and loved playing with her toys. One day, she spent the afternoon playing in her garden. Lucy saw a unique thumb on the path. She had never seen anything like it before. She thought it was very special and wanted to keep it. She bent down and tried to pick it up but it was too slippery. "I will throw it back," said Lucy. She grabbed the thumb and threw it as hard as she could. But the thumb went over the garden wall and out of sight. Lucy felt scared and started to cry. Suddenly, an angry grown-up appeared. The grown-up shouted at Lucy for throwing the thumb away. Lucy was so upset she never went back to the garden again.

Once upon a time, there was a big event in the town. All the people came to see what was happening. They saw a man who was trying to spread a big, colorful blanket on the ground. It was very difficult for him because the blanket was so big. A little girl named Lily saw the man and wanted to help. She said, "Mister, can I help you?" The man smiled and said, "Yes, please! It is difficult to do this alone." So, Lily and the man worked together to spread the big, colorful blanket on the ground. After they finished, the man thanked Lily and said, "Thank you, Lily. You made this difficult job easier." They both smiled and enjoyed the event together. The people in the town were happy, too. They had a fun day at the big event with the big, colorful blanket on the ground.

Once there was a boy named Tim. He loved to play in the water. One day, he found a big tub. He filled it with water and jumped in to soak. He splashed and laughed. Tim had a neighbor named Sue. Sue was not very nice. She would say harsh things to Tim. One day, Sue saw Tim playing in the water. She wanted to play too, but she was too scared to ask. She just watched Tim from her window. Tim saw Sue watching him. He thought, "I can be nice, even if Sue is not always nice." He called out, "Sue, come play with me!" Sue came out and played with Tim. They both soaked in the water and had fun. Sue learned that being nice is better than being harsh. Tim and Sue became good friends.

Once upon a time there was a wide, green jungle. In the jungle there lived a curious little girl called Sally. One day, Sally decided she wanted to go for an adventure. She started walking deep into the jungle, when she heard a loud noise up ahead. Then she saw it--a big, wide gorilla! Sally got scared and wanted to run away, but the gorilla said something that made her stop. He said, "Oh, hello! Are you here to play in the jungle?" The gorilla seemed friendly. Sally answered, "Yes, but it looks like you are too big to play with me!" The gorilla laughed and said, "Come closer and we can play hide and seek." So Sally stepped closer and the gorilla showed her a big, wide tree trunk. He said they could hide under it. Then Sally knew that something special was about to happen. The gorilla showed Sally to a secret cave behind the tree trunk. Inside the cave, Sally saw something beautiful--a rainbow of colors and shapes. The gorilla smiled and said, "Now, let's play!" Sally was excited and the two of them had the best day ever playing in the cave. She was sad when it was time to leave, but the gorilla said to her, "Don't worry, I'm sure we'll get to play together again soon." Sally smiled and waved goodbye as she left

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom liked to find new things. One day, Tom went on a walk with his dog, Spot. They walked and walked until they found a new land. This land was very big and tough. It had tall trees and many rocks. Tom and Spot walked into the land. They saw a big bear. The bear was very big and tough too. Tom said to the bear, "Hello, Mr. Bear. Can we play with you?" The bear looked at Tom and Spot, and said, "No, this is my land. You cannot play here." Tom and Spot were sad. They wanted to play in the tough land, but the bear would not let them. They walked away, but then they got lost. They could not find their way back home. Tom and Spot were very scared. As it got darker, Tom and Spot heard a loud noise. They saw the big bear again. The bear was angry and chased them away from his land. Tom and Spot ran very fast, but they still could not find their way back home. In the end, Tom and Spot were still lost in the tough land. They were very sad and scared. They never found their way back home, and the big bear kept his land all to himself.

Sam and Tom are brothers. They like to play outside in the yard. One day, they see their dad with a big grill. He is putting food on it. It smells good. "What are you doing, dad?" Sam asks. "I am making lunch for us. This is a grill. It makes the food hot and tasty," dad says. "Can we help you, dad?" Tom asks. "Sure, you can. You can be my useful helpers. You can watch the grill and tell me if you see any smoke. Smoke means the food is burning. We don't want that," dad says. "Okay, dad. We will watch the grill for you," Sam and Tom say. They sit on the grass and watch the grill. They see the food sizzle and smell the yummy flavors. They see some smoke coming out of the grill. "Dad, dad! We see smoke! The food is burning!" they shout. Dad runs to the grill and turns the food over. He thanks Sam and Tom for being good watchers. "Good job, boys. You saved the lunch. You are very useful helpers. Now, let's eat. I bet you are hungry," dad says. Sam and Tom smile and nod. They are hungry and proud. They helped their dad with the grill. They are a good team.

One day, a boy named Tim went for a walk with his mom. They went to a noisy place with a long rail. It was a train station. Tim saw a big train on the rail. It was the first time he saw a train. He was very happy. Tim's mom said, "I will introduce you to the train driver." They walked to the front of the train. The train driver was a nice man. He said, "Hi, I am Tom. I drive the train." Tim said, "Hi Tom! I like trains. They are big and noisy." Tom smiled and let Tim sit in the train. Tim had a great day at the train station. He loved the noisy train on the long rail.

Once upon a time, there was a lucky little girl named Lucy. She lived in a small house with her mom and dad. One night, Lucy looked out of her window and saw the big, round moon in the sky. "Mommy, can the moon melt like ice cream?" Lucy asked. "No, Lucy, the moon cannot melt," her mom said with a smile. The next day, Lucy went to the park with her friends. They played on the swings and slides, and had lots of fun. As the sun began to set, Lucy saw the moon again. She felt lucky to see the big, round moon two times in one day. That night, as Lucy lay in her bed, she looked out the window and said, "Thank you, moon, for not melting like ice cream. I am lucky to see you every night."

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to the park. She was feeling troubled because she didn't have any friends to play with. As she walked around the park, she saw a big computer sitting on a bench. Lucy thought it was strange, but she went to say hello. "Hi, computer! My name is Lucy," she said. The computer smiled and said, "Hello, Lucy! I'm Compy. I'm new here and I don't have any friends either." Lucy and Compy decided to play together. They played on the swings, the slide, and even the see-saw. After a fun day at the park, Lucy and Compy became best friends. They learned that when you meet someone new, you can make a great friend. The moral of the story is to always be kind and open to meeting new friends, because you never know who might need one.
