Once upon a time, there was a big place called "university". In this university, there was a little, ordinary bug. The bug had a special power. It could zip very fast from one place to another. One day, the little bug saw a big cake in the university. The bug was very hungry. It wanted to eat the cake. So, it zipped over to the cake and took a small bite. The little bug was so happy. It zipped around the university telling all its friends about the big cake. All the bugs zipped over to the cake and had a big party. They were all very happy and full.

One day, a boy and a girl were playing. They wanted to do a pretty picture. The boy took a blue crayon and the girl took a red one. They started to draw on a big paper. The boy said, "My part of the picture is more attractive than yours!" The girl did not like this. She said, "No, my part is more attractive!" They began to argue about whose part of the picture was more attractive. A nice dog came and saw the kids fighting. The dog barked, "Stop fighting! Both parts of the picture are attractive!" The boy and the girl looked at the dog and then at their picture. They saw that the dog was right. They said sorry to each other and finished the picture together. The picture was very attractive, and they were happy.

Once upon a time there was a brave copper cat. He lived in a small house and he was very happy. One day, the cat heard a terrible noise. He knew he had to be brave and prevent the noise. He looked around and saw a dog in his garden. The dog was very big and he was growling. Cat was scared but he knew he had to do something to prevent the noise. So he ran up to the dog and tried to scare him away. The brave copper cat made a loud noise and ran around the dog. The dog was so scared that he ran away and didn't come back. Cat was very proud of himself for being brave enough to prevent the noise. He learned that he can do anything if he is brave.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play with toys and draw pictures. One day, Anna has a new toy. It is a doll with long hair and a pretty dress. Ben likes the doll too. He asks Anna if he can play with it. "Can I have your doll for a bit?" Ben says. "Okay, but you have to return it soon. It is my doll," Anna says. Ben takes the doll and runs to his room. He plays with the doll and makes her hair into different styles. He forgets about Anna. Anna waits and waits. She is sad and angry. "Ben, where is my doll? Give it back!" Anna says. Ben does not want to give the doll back. He likes the doll too much. He thinks of a creative lie. "I don't have your doll. A big bird came and took it away. I tried to stop it, but it was too fast," Ben says. Anna does not believe Ben. She knows he is not telling the truth. She sees the doll's hair sticking out of his closet. "Ben, that is not true. I see my doll in your closet. You are lying to me. That is not nice. Give me my doll now!" Anna says. Ben feels bad. He knows he did something wrong. He takes the doll out of his closet and gives it to Anna. "I'm sorry, Anna. I lied to you. I wanted to keep your doll. But it is your doll. You can have it back," Ben says. Anna takes the doll and hugs it. She is happy to have her doll back. She looks at Ben and sees that he is sorry. "It's okay, Ben. I forgive you. But don't lie to me again. Lying is bad. We can share the doll if you want. Do you want to play with me?" Anna says. Ben nods and smiles. He is happy that Anna is still his friend. He says sorry again and thanks her for sharing. They play with the doll and other toys. They draw pictures of the doll and the big bird. They are friends again.

Once upon a time, there was a peaceful town. In this town, there was a big desk. The desk was magic. The magic desk could reverse time. One day, a little girl found the magic desk. She saw a boy take a toy from another boy. The boy who took the toy was not nice. The girl went to the desk and said, "Reverse!" The time went back, and the toy was with the first boy again. The girl learned that using the magic desk to help others was good. She used the desk to stop bad things from happening. The town stayed peaceful and happy. The girl knew that helping others made her feel good too.

Once there was a boy named Jimmy. One day, Jimmy went outside in the mist. It was so thick he couldn't see where he was going. So he decided to split up from his family. Jimmy saw a useful stick on the ground and picked it up. He decided to use it as a guide. He followed it until he got to a big hill. Jimmy climbed the hill and noticed something strange. Nothing was there! Suddenly, he started to slip and fall down the hill. He couldn't hold on to the stick and split away from it. Jimmy's family was worried and called the police to help them find him. But Jimmy was nowhere to be found. They searched all throughout the mist but couldn't find him. They never saw Jimmy again and his family was very sad.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who wanted a steak. She was only three years old, but very smart. One day, she saw a steak in a deep pot. She was so excited! She pointed at the steak and said, "I want that!" She was so happy. The little girl carefully took the steak out of the deep pot and put it in a pan. She waited and waited for the steak to cook. Then, when it was ready, she took it out of the pan. The steak looked so yummy! The little girl took a big bite and smiled. She pointed at the steak and said, "This is yummy!" She had found her favorite food. The little girl ate the steak and was so happy. The end.

Once upon a time there was a very smart mouse called Sally. Sally loved to adventure and explore the world around her. One day, she was happily running through the grass when she discovered a special place. "Wow!" exclaimed Sally. "This looks like an exciting place to explore!" So she slowly stepped through the entrance, looking all around to see what she could find. Suddenly, Sally saw something very shiny in the corner. She carefully jumped over and saw that it was a pile of golden coins! "Oh my!" exclaimed Sally. She was so excited she started to jump around in circles. Then she came up with an idea. She quickly put the coins into her pocket and ran back home. "I'm so smart!" she said to herself. From then on, Sally made it her mission to go exploring and discovering places to find exciting things. She was sure that one day she would find something even more special than the coins.

One day, a bright sun was in the sky. A boy named Tim found a rod. He wanted to attach something to the rod. Tim saw a big, red balloon. He thought it would be fun to attach the balloon to the rod. Tim tied the balloon to the rod. He walked around with it, and everyone saw the big, red balloon. They all liked it. Tim felt happy. But, the wind started to blow. The balloon and rod moved in the wind. The wind got stronger. The balloon pulled the rod up, up, up. Tim held on tight, but the wind was too strong. Tim let go of the rod. The big, red balloon and the rod went up, up, up into the sky. Tim was sad. He lost his balloon and rod.

One day, the sun was shining bright and yellow in the sky. A big bear named Ben and a little bird named Lily were best friends. They liked to play together in the big green forest. Today, they wanted to march to the big pond. So, they started to walk, one foot in front of the other. Ben's big feet went "thump, thump" and Lily's little feet went "tap, tap". They laughed and sang as they marched. When they got to the pond, they saw a big yellow duck. The duck was happy to see them. Ben, Lily, and the duck played in the water all day. They splashed and had fun. When the sun went down, they marched back home, tired but happy.

One day, a cheerful boy named Tim went to the park. He saw his friend, Sue, playing with her toy car. Tim had a bag of oats with him. He thought it would be fun to share with Sue. "Hi, Sue!" Tim said, "I have oats. Do you want some?" Sue looked at the bag and said, "Yes, please!" They sat down and ate the oats together. They talked and laughed. Tim mentioned that he saw a big hill nearby, perfect for rolling down. The next day, Tim and Sue went to the big hill that Tim had mentioned. They were very excited to roll down the hill. They climbed up and sat at the top. "Are you ready?" Tim asked. Sue nodded, and they both started to roll down the hill. As they reached the bottom of the hill, they laughed and cheered. They were so happy they had found the hill and had such a fun time. From that day on, Tim and Sue always went to the big hill to play and eat oats together.

One day, a little boy named Tim went outside to play. He wanted to find his toy car. Tim looked all around his yard. The yard was very messy. There were leaves and sticks everywhere. Tim asked his mom, "Mom, where is my car?" His mom said, "I think it is in the yard. Can you find it?" Tim said, "Yes, I will find my car!" Tim looked under the big tree. He found a red ball, but not his car. Then, he looked by the flowers. He found a blue shovel, but not his car. Finally, Tim looked by the swing. There, under the messy leaves, he found his car! Tim was happy and played with his car all day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with clay. He made many things like animals, houses, and trees. One day, he made a big, loud bell out of clay. He was very proud of his bell. Tim's friend, Sam, came to play with him. Sam saw the loud bell and wanted to play with it too. But Tim did not want to share. Sam was sad and went home. Tim felt bad for not sharing his bell with Sam. The next day, Tim decided to make a new, big bell. He went to Sam's house and gave him the new bell. Sam was very happy. They played with the bells together and had a lot of fun. Tim learned that it is good to share and be kind to friends.

Once upon a time, there was a tidy little house. In the house, there lived a girl named Lucy. Lucy loved to keep her room clean and tidy. One day, Lucy saw a big box in her room. It was closed, but she wanted to see what was inside. Lucy tried to open the box. She pulled and pulled, but it would not open. Lucy's friend, Tom, came over to play. Lucy told Tom about the box. Tom wanted to help Lucy open the box. They both pulled and pulled, but the box still would not open. Lucy and Tom did not give up. They insist that they could open the box. They asked Lucy's mom for help. Lucy's mom came into the room and helped them. With a little push, the box finally opened. Inside the box, there were lots of toys for Lucy and Tom to play with. They were so happy and played together all day long.

Martha was a very cheerful little girl. Everyday she went to school to play, learn and make new friends. Today, she was feeling so excited to see everyone as she skipped along to school. There was one thing Martha didn't like about school though. That was going to the bathroom. She found it scary and she was always vry nervous when she had to do it. But Martha was very brave and today she decided she was going to try. She took a deep breath, grabbed her friend's hand and together they went to the bathroom. When they got there, she was surprised to see how nice it was. It was colourful and there were even books to read while she was in there - her favourite! Martha was so happy and her fears were gone. She earned a big cheer from her friend as she finally went to the bathroom cheerfully.

One day, a lovely little girl named Lily went for a walk. She saw a newspaper on the ground. Lily picked it up and looked at the pictures. She saw a big car with wheels that could reverse. Lily thought it was fun. Lily ran home to her mom and said, "Mom, look at this newspaper! It has a car that can go backwards!" Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, Lily, that's called reverse. Cars can go forwards and backwards." Lily and her mom sat down and read the newspaper together. They talked about the car and how fun it would be to drive. Lily was happy to learn a new word and share a lovely day with her mom.

Once upon a time, there was a little human named Tim. Tim liked to number his toys. He would count them one by one, making sure he knew how many he had. One day, Tim's toy bear went missing. He felt upset because he could not number his toys without his bear. He looked under his bed, in the closet, and even in the kitchen, but he could not find his bear. Then, Tim's mom came into his room and saw him upset. She asked, "What's wrong, Tim?" Tim told his mom about his missing bear. His mom smiled and gave him a hug. She reached behind a pillow and found the bear. Tim was so happy, and he could number his toys again. From that day on, Tim always made sure to keep his toys close, so he would never lose them again.

Once upon a time, there was a little train named Timmy. Timmy was upset because he could not rock like the other trains. He would watch the other trains rock back and forth as they went down the tracks. One day, Timmy met a wise old train named Grandpa Will. Timmy said, "Grandpa Will, I am upset because I cannot rock like the other trains." Grandpa Will smiled and said, "Timmy, I can help you. Just follow me." Timmy followed Grandpa Will down the tracks. They went slow at first, but then they started to go faster. As they went faster, Timmy felt himself start to rock back and forth. He was so happy! From that day on, Timmy could rock just like the other trains. He was no longer upset and loved to race with his new friends. And every time he saw Grandpa Will, he would thank him for helping him learn how to rock.

One day, a dog named Max went for a walk. He saw a smooth trail and decided to follow it. Max walked and walked on the trail. He saw many fun things like birds, trees, and flowers. Max heard a little cat crying. The cat was stuck in a tree! "Help me, please!" said the cat. Max wanted to help the cat, but he was too small to reach the tree. Max had an idea. He ran to find his big friend, Bear. Bear came to rescue the cat. When Bear reached up to help the cat, the cat jumped down and landed on Bear's back. The cat was not scared anymore. It was all a game! The cat laughed and said, "Thank you for playing with me!" Max, Bear, and the cat all played together and had a fun day on the smooth trail.

Once upon a time, there was a thin boat named Shiver. Shiver lived in a port with many big boats. Shiver felt small and alone. One day, Shiver wanted to show that it could be strong too. It left the port and went on a long trip. The sun was hot, and the water was deep. Shiver was happy to be out on its own. But soon, the sky turned dark and the wind blew hard. The big waves made Shiver scared. Shiver tried to go back to the port, but it was too late. The waves were too strong, and Shiver broke into pieces. It was a sad day for the thin boat named Shiver.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. They saw a big bench near the trees. Tim's mom said, "Let's sit on the bench and wait for your friends." Tim was very patient as he sat on the bench with his mom. Soon, Tim's friends came to the park. They wanted to play with a big truck. Tim's friend, Sam, said, "Let's load the truck with sand and take it to the other side of the park." All the kids were excited to play with the truck. The kids took turns loading the truck with sand. Tim was patient as he waited for his turn. When it was Tim's turn, he loaded the truck with a lot of sand. The kids had a lot of fun playing with the truck and the sand at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a powerful muffin. The muffin lived in a small house with a kind girl named Lily. Lily loved to rock in her chair and eat the muffin. The muffin was very tasty and made Lily strong. One day, Lily said to the muffin, "You make me feel so strong! I want to help others too." The muffin was happy to help Lily. They went outside to play and saw a cat stuck in a tree. Lily used her powerful strength from the muffin to climb the tree and save the cat. The cat said, "Thank you, Lily! You are so strong and kind." Lily smiled and said, "It's all because of my powerful muffin. We love to help others!" From that day on, Lily and the muffin went on many fun adventures, helping others and making new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. Jane had a best friend named Tom. They liked to play together in the park. One day, Jane wanted to introduce Tom to her old dog, Max. Max was very nice and liked to play too. Jane and Tom went to Jane's house to meet Max. Max was happy to see them. They played with Max in the backyard. They ran, jumped, and laughed together. Max was very good at playing with them. After playing, Jane wanted to teach Tom a new game. They sat on the grass with Max and played the new game. Tom liked the game and thanked Jane for teaching him. They all had a great day together.

Once upon a time, there was a big, red pole in the middle of a park. Every day, kids would come and play around the pole. One day, a girl named Lily decided to paint the pole. Lily took her paint and brush and started to paint the pole. She painted it with many colors: blue, green, yellow, and pink. The kids in the park stopped to watch Lily paint. They thought it was very impressive. A boy named Tom came up to Lily and said, "Wow, your painting is very good!" Lily smiled and said, "Thank you! Do you want to help me paint the pole?" Tom said, "Yes, I would love to help!" So, Tom and Lily painted the pole together, and it became the most beautiful and impressive pole in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a compassionate girl named Jane. She lived in a small house with her mom, dad, and her dog, Spot. Jane loved to play outside, but today it started to rain. She was sad because she could not play with her dog in the yard. Jane's mom saw her looking sad and had an idea. She took Jane's mattress and put it in the living room. "Let's play inside today," her mom said with a big smile. Jane and Spot jumped on the mattress, laughing and having fun. But then, something unexpected happened. The rain stopped, and the sun came out. Jane's mom said, "Let's take the mattress outside and play in the sun!" They put the mattress in the yard, and Jane, Spot, and her mom all played outside together. The day that started with rain turned into a fun and sunny adventure.

Once upon a time there was a friendly boy named Jim. He loved to play outdoors and was always pushing his little paper car around. One day, Jim heard a noise near his car. He saw shining eyes looking at him and he noticed a furry creature. Jim was so surprised he shouted out "Who are you?". The creature just smiled. He was a friendly fox. Jim and the fox became friends. They played together all afternoon. He showed the fox how to push his paper car around. The fox was very excited and carefully watched Jim as he played. They laughed and raced around until the sun started to set. As it got dark, the fox said bye. Jim said to the fox with a smile "Come back soon, please." The fox nodded and ran off into the night. Jim waved goodbye and went back home, feeling more friendly than ever.

Mandy was a little girl who dreamt of having a pet elephant. She would often wish for an elephant every time she saw one on television. One night, Mandy had a dream where an elephant appeared in her bedroom. "Hi Mandy!" said the elephant happily. Mandy was so excited and said, "Hello! What's your name?" "My name is Trunk!" said the elephant. Mandy was very happy and asked Trunk if he could stay with her. "Yes I can, but there's one problem," said Trunk. "I'm big. I can't fit in your bedroom." Mandy thought for a moment and said "I know! I'll make you shrink!" Mandy closed her eyes, made a wish and suddenly Trunk started to shrink. He was only the size of a little puppy. Mandy hugged Trunk and said, "Welcome to your new home!" They were very happy together.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy brush. Every day it just wanted to sleep in its cozy home. But one day, something very different happened! A wave! It came right over the brush and suddenly it was awake. The brush knew it had to do something. With a push, it floated away from its home to the land beyond. It floated over hills and valleys and then it came to a surprising place - a river. The brush was so scared when the river began to move fast. The lazy brush decided to make a plan. With a wave of its handle, it started to go up and down. Soon enough, it was floating towards the other side of the river. It had made it out alive! The lazy brush felt so proud of itself. It waved goodbye to the river, and went off to find another cozy home. From then on, it always waved whenever it needed to move on.

Once upon a time, in a small friendly farm, lived a happy hen named Henny. Henny loved to lay eggs every day. She would enjoy sitting in her cozy nest, waiting for a new egg to come out. One sunny day, Henny laid a big, beautiful egg. She was very proud of it. But, a naughty fox saw the egg too. He wanted to take the egg for himself. Henny was sad and scared. She did not want to lose her special egg. Henny thought of a plan to save her egg. She asked her friends, the cow and the sheep, to help her. Together, they made a trap for the fox. When the fox came to take the egg, he fell into the trap. The friendly animals saved the egg and chased the fox away. Henny was very happy and thankful. She enjoyed her days with her friends, laying eggs and keeping them safe.

Once upon a time, there was a brave rabbit. He started every morning with a big stretch and a smile. Every day, he set off on a new adventure. One day, he found an old cave. He started exploring it and soon he found a big surprise. There was a huge pile of carrots! The brave rabbit was so happy he hopped up and down. The next day he went back to the cave to get some carrots for his friends. But when he got there, he found something even bigger. It was a big box with a reward in it! The brave rabbit opened it and saw a pretty flower inside. He knew that this flower was special. It was dead, but still very soft and smelled amazing! He brought the flower to his friends as a reward for being so brave. They were so happy to receive it. The brave rabbit hugged them all and felt very proud. He'd found the perfect reward to share with his friends!

Sophie was a 3-year-old girl who lived in the city. She had a friend named Amanda, who was wealthy and lived in a big mansion. One day, Sophie went over to Amanda’s house to play. When Sophie got there, Amanda pulled out a wire. She started to tease Sophie with it, waving it around her head. ‘Amanda, stop!’ Sophie said. But Amanda kept teasing her. Sophie was getting very frustrated. She grabbed the wire from Amanda’s hand and held it tight. ‘Why are you teasing me?’ she asked. Amanda smiled. ‘Because it’s fun! I’m so lucky to have a wire, I can tease you with it because I’m wealthy.’ she said. Sophie thought for a moment, then smiled too. ‘Okay, if you are so wealthy then we can play together with the wire. That would be much more fun for both of us!’ she said. And so, the two friends started playing with the wire together.

One day, a little girl named Sally went to the beach. She saw a big, dull rock. But when she got closer, she saw it was not a rock. It was a big seal! The seal looked sad. Sally said, "Hi, seal! Why are you sad?" The seal said, "I am sad because I have no friends. No one wants to play with me." Sally felt bad for the seal. She said, "I will be your friend! Let's play together!" They played all day. They had so much fun. But then, something unexpected happened. The seal said, "Sally, I have to tell you something. I am not a real seal. I am a magic seal. I can only be friends with someone if they welcome me into their home." Sally was scared. She did not want to welcome the magic seal into her home. She thought it might be bad. So she said, "I am sorry, seal. I cannot welcome you into my home." The magic seal was very sad. It went back into the sea, and Sally never saw it again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his basketball. One day, he found an ancient, old tree in the park. The tree was so big, it almost touched the sky. Tim thought it would be fun to bounce his basketball near the tree. As Tim played, a little squirrel came down from the tree. The squirrel saw the basketball and wanted to play too. "Can I play?" asked the squirrel. "Yes!" said Tim, and they played together, laughing and having fun. After a while, the squirrel had to go back up the tree. Tim wanted to see where the squirrel lived, so he decided to follow it. The squirrel climbed the ancient tree, and Tim looked up, trying to see where it went. But the tree was too tall, and Tim couldn't see the squirrel's home. Tim waved goodbye to the squirrel and went back to playing with his basketball, knowing he had made a new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a polite lawyer. He lived in a small house. He had many friends because he was nice. One day, the lawyer went to the park. He saw a big tree. He wanted to disappear like magic. He said to his friend, "I want to disappear!" His friend laughed and said, "You can't do that!" The lawyer tried to disappear. He closed his eyes and wished very hard. But he did not disappear. Instead, he fell into a hole. His friend looked for him, but could not find him. And the polite lawyer was never seen again.

Once upon a time, in a cute little house, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his football. Every day, he would run outside and kick the ball around the yard. He had so much fun playing with his football. One day, Tim could not remember where he put his football. He looked in his room, he looked under his bed, and he looked in the yard. Tim was sad because he could not find his football. He missed playing with it very much. Then, Tim's mom came outside and saw him looking sad. She asked, "Why are you sad, Tim?" Tim told her he could not find his football. His mom smiled and said, "I remember where your football is. It is in the garage." Tim was so happy, he ran to the garage and found his football. He played with it all day and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a thoughtful boy who liked to help others. One day, Tim went for a walk in the park. As he walked, he saw a little girl named Sue. Sue was sad because she lost her pet cat. Tim wanted to help Sue find her cat. They walked around the park and called, "Here, kitty, kitty!" Suddenly, they saw the cat up in a tree. Tim and Sue were happy to meet the cat again. Tim said, "Don't worry, Sue. I will help you get your cat down." Tim found a big stick and carefully pushed the cat out of the tree. The cat jumped down and Sue hugged her pet. Sue said, "Thank you, Tim, for helping me find my cat." Tim felt happy because he was able to help his new friend. They both smiled and continued to play in the park together.

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy man. He had a big house and many things. One day, he saw a pretty ornament in a shop. It was shiny and colorful. He wanted to buy it and take it home. He brought the ornament home and put it on a high shelf. He was very happy. But his little girl saw the ornament on the high shelf. She wanted to play with it. She tried to reach it, but she was too small. The little girl made a frown. She was sad. The wealthy man saw his little girl frown. He felt sad too. He took the ornament down from the high shelf. He gave it to his little girl to play with. Now, they both were happy. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a big boat with a big sail. Sam and his dad were on the boat, ready to rush across the lake. "Are you ready for a big adventure, Sam?" Daddy asked. "Yes!" Sam shouted with excitement. Daddy released the rope and the wind began to blow. The boat sailed faster and faster. Sam couldn't believe it! "Woah!" Sam said in surprise. But as the wind grew stronger, it became tougher to keep the boat in control. Daddy kept sailing, but the waves started to rock the boat back and forth. Sam started to feel scared. "Help!" Sam cried out. Daddy quickly turned to the wheel and steered the boat back to shore. He saved the day! Sam hugged his dad, feeling relieved and proud. "You're so tough, Daddy," Sam said. Daddy smiled and said, "We all need a little help sometimes, Sammy".

Once upon a time, there was a smelly dog named Spot. Spot loved to play outside in the dirt. One sunny day, Spot found a big bone. He was so happy! Spot thought, "I must bury this bone so no one can take it." He dug a deep hole with his paws and put the bone in the hole. Then, he covered the hole with dirt. Spot was very proud of his work. Later, Spot's friend, Kitty, came by. Kitty asked, "What did you do today, Spot?" Spot replied, "I found a big bone and buried it in the ground. It was fun!" Kitty smiled and said, "Good job, Spot! Now you can enjoy your bone next time you want to play with it." They both laughed and played together until it was time to go home.

One day, a big cloud was in the sky. It was not easy for the cloud to work. The cloud had to make rain for the plants and animals. The cloud was sad because it wanted to play with the animals, but it had to work. A little bird saw the cloud and wanted to help. The bird flew up to the cloud and said, "I can help you work. Then you can play with the animals." The cloud was happy and let the bird help. The bird worked hard to make rain for the plants and animals. Then, something unexpected happened. The cloud started to change colors! It turned into a beautiful rainbow. Now, the cloud could play with the animals and still make rain. The cloud and the bird were very happy, and they played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a kangaroo who was feeling very sad. He wanted to find some friends to play with. He hopped around the forest, but no one would join him. He saw a charming little bunny and approached her. "Will you come and play with me?" asked the kangaroo. The bunny answered "I'm sorry, but I have to hop home. I'm too busy." The kangaroo was unhappy, but he kept hopping around the forest. Suddenly, he stumbled into a big hole and he couldn't get out. He called out for help again and again, but nobody came to his rescue. The kangaroo was stuck in the big hole for a very long time. The kangaroo never found any friends and he was stuck in the big hole forever. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a cat named Fluffy. Fluffy was a naughty cat. She liked to play tricks on her friends. One day, Fluffy saw her friend, Bunny, hopping in the garden. Fluffy had an idea. She wanted to play a trick on Bunny. Fluffy said to Bunny, "Bunny, I heard someone mention that there is a big carrot hidden in the garden. If you find it, it's yours!" Bunny got excited and started to look for the carrot. Bunny looked and looked, but she could not find the big carrot. She said to Fluffy, "I can't find it. Can you help me?" Fluffy laughed and said, "I was just being naughty. There is no big carrot. I'm sorry." Bunny was sad but forgave Fluffy. They decided that from now on, they would play in the right order and not be naughty to each other.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck named Ducky. Ducky loved to swim in the pond near his home. Every day, he would pick a new spot in the pond to swim and play with his friends. One day, Ducky saw a new friend at the pond. It was a big frog named Froggy. Ducky asked, "Do you want to swim with me?" Froggy said, "Yes, but first, let's pick a good spot to jump in." They looked around the pond and found a big rock to jump off. Ducky and Froggy were very patient as they waited for the perfect time to jump. They knew something fun was going to happen. Finally, they both jumped into the water with a big splash! They laughed and swam all day long. And from that day on, Ducky and Froggy were the best of friends.

One day, a boy named Tim went to play in the park. He saw a big ball near the goal. He wanted to kick the ball and make a score. He thought he would be a mighty kicker. Tim asked his friend Sam to help him. Sam was good at playing with the ball. They both kicked the ball many times. They were having so much fun. But then, a big dog came. The dog wanted to play too. It took the ball and ran away. Tim and Sam were sad. They could not play with the ball anymore. The dog was too fast for them. They went home with no score and felt bad.

One day, a little girl named Amy went to the park with her mom. They saw a big tree with lots of fruit. The fruit was smooth and round. Amy wanted to pick the fruit, but it was too high. She asked her mom, "How can I get the fruit?" Her mom said, "You can use a stick to make the fruit fall." Amy found a long stick and tried to get the fruit down. But the stick was not long enough. She felt sad and sat under the tree. Suddenly, the tree started to rise from the ground! Amy and her mom were surprised. The tree stopped rising when the fruit was low enough for Amy to reach. She picked the fruit and shared it with her mom. Amy learned that when you try hard and don't give up, good things can happen. She felt happy and knew that she could do anything if she kept trying.

One day, a thin cat named Sam went for a walk. He saw a big tree with a small red bird on top. Sam wanted to say hello to the bird. So, he tried to stand tall like the tree, but he couldn't reach the bird. Then, Sam saw an arrow on the ground. He had an idea. He put the arrow on the tree and tried to climb up. But, the arrow was too thin and it broke. Sam fell down and felt sad. Just then, the small red bird flew down to Sam. The bird said, "Hello, Sam. I saw you trying to stand tall and climb the tree. I came down to say hello to you." Sam was very happy and they both became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a loyal dog named Buddy. He lived with a little boy named Tim. They loved to play outside together. Every morning, they would wake up early to see the beautiful sunrise. The sky would turn pretty colors like pink, orange, and yellow. It made them both very happy. One day, they went for a walk in the forest. Tim saw a big fire and said, "Oh no, the trees are burning!" Buddy barked loudly to let people know there was a fire. They needed to be careful and stay away. Tim and Buddy ran back home to tell Tim's mom and dad about the fire. They called for help and the brave firefighters came to put out the fire. The forest was safe again, and Tim and Buddy were called heroes. They were very proud and happy. From that day on, they continued to watch the sunrise and protect their home together.

A woman had a rare bird. She loved her bird very much. She gave her bird seeds and water and a big cage. She sang to her bird every day. One day, a man came to her house. He saw the bird and wanted it. He said, "What a beautiful bird! Can I buy it from you?" The woman said, "No, this is my bird. I will not sell it. Go away!" The man was angry. He waited until the woman was asleep. He tried to steal the bird. He opened the cage and reached for the bird. But the bird was smart. It saw the man and bit his hand. It made a loud noise. It woke up the woman. She ran to the cage and saw the man. She shouted, "Help! Help! A thief!" The man was scared. He dropped the bird and ran away. The woman hugged her bird and thanked it. She said, "You are a brave bird. You saved us. I love you more than ever."

Once upon a time, there was a humble alligator named Al. Al lived in a big pond with his friends. They liked to play and have fun all day. One day, a new alligator named Bill came to the pond. Bill was not humble. He liked to make fun of Al and his friends. Al and his friends did not like this. Al said to Bill, "Please be nice. We can all play and have fun together." Bill thought about it and said, "Okay, I will try to be humble like you, Al." After that, Bill stopped making fun of Al and his friends. They all played and had fun together. The pond was a happy place for all the alligators.

John was feeling very fearful. He had lost his passport! Without it, he could not go on his holiday. He did not know how he was ever going to answer his parents when they asked him what had happened. One day, while searching the house he had a surprise. Under his bed, he found his passport. He had been so scared that he had forgotten it was there. John was very happy. He nervously answered his parents' questions and explained what had happened. They were so relieved to hear he had found his passport that they weren't even mad. Now, John was on vacation with his family and he put his passport in a safe place. From now on, every time he was feeling fearful he remembered just to look under his bed - always an answer!

Once upon a time, there was a friendly dog named Max. Max had a soft, velvet toy he loved to play with. Every day, Max would show his toy to his friends in the park. One day, as Max was showing his velvet toy to his friends, a big wind came. The wind took Max's toy and carried it far away. Max was very sad and didn't know what to do. Then, something unexpected happened. A bird saw the toy in the sky and caught it with its beak. The bird flew down and gave the toy back to Max. Max was so happy and thanked the bird. From that day on, Max and the bird became best friends, and they always played together with the velvet toy.

One day, a little dog named Max wanted to run in a big stadium. Max was very excited. He put on his favorite red shoes and ran out the door. When Max got to the stadium, he saw a big cat named Tom. Tom said, "Hi Max! Do you want to race with me?" Max nodded his head and said, "Yes, let's race!" They started to run very fast. Max was ahead, but then he tripped and fell. He felt ashamed. Tom stopped and said, "Don't be sad, Max. Let's try again!" Max smiled and they ran again. This time, they both finished the race and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little crab who lived near the sea. The crab loved to watch the big fish swim and play. One day, he saw a big fish ride on the back of another big fish. The crab felt anxious, but he wanted to ride too. He thought, "Maybe one day I can ride like the big fish." The crab found a small fish to be his friend. They played together every day. The small fish saw the crab watch the big fish ride. The small fish wanted to help the crab. They thought of a plan to make the crab's dream come true. One sunny day, the small fish told the crab to hop on his back. The crab was anxious but excited. The small fish swam fast, and the crab held on tight. The crab finally got to ride like the big fish! The crab and the small fish were very happy. They played and rode together every day, and they were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She loved to help her mom in the kitchen. One day, Amy's mom was making a yummy cake. They put the cake in the oven to bake. Amy was very excited. While the cake was baking, Amy and her mom made a thin, pretty ribbon for the cake. It was blue, Amy's favorite color. They also made some frosting to put on the cake. Amy liked to lick the frosting off the spoon. When the cake was done, Amy's mom took it out of the oven. Amy realized that the cake was hot, so she waited for it to cool down. Then, they put the frosting and the thin, blue ribbon on the cake. Amy and her mom were so happy with their beautiful cake. They shared it with their family and everyone loved it.

Once upon a time, there was a potato who was very impatient. He wanted to try something new and exciting, but didn't know what to do. One day he decided to climb a tree. He tried and tried but it was too hard to reach the top. He sighed and was feeling very frustrated. Just then, he heard a little voice saying "Let me help you". It was a friendly bee who smiled at the potato. The bee said "I can fly up the tree, I can help you". The potato was so excited. He thanked the bee. So the bee flew up and up, until he reached the top of the tree. The bee called "Here is a special surprise for you!" So the potato climbed the tree as fast as he could. When he reached the top, he found a delicious apple waiting just for him. The potato was so happy and thankful for the bee's help. From that day on, the potato never attempted to do anything alone again. He knew the importance of having friends who can help.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and have fun. One day, her mom asked her to organize her toys. Lily looked at her toys and thought, "This is a big test for me." Lily tried to put her toys in different places, but she became frustrated. She didn't know where to put them. So, she asked her mom, "Mom, can you help me organize my toys?" Her mom smiled and said, "Of course, Lily. Let's put your dolls in this box, your cars in that box, and your blocks in this bag." They worked together and soon, all the toys were organized. Lily felt very happy and proud. She had passed the test with her mom's help. From that day on, she always kept her toys organized and never felt frustrated again.

Once upon a time, there was a messy zoo. The zoo had many animals like lions, monkeys, and elephants. The zookeeper, Mr. Brown, did not like to clean. The zoo was not a happy place. One day, a little girl named Lily visited the zoo. She saw the messy zoo and the sad animals. Lily wanted to help. She started to clean the zoo. Mr. Brown watched her and realized he needed to change. Mr. Brown helped Lily clean the zoo. The animals became happy again. The zoo was now a nice place to visit. Everyone loved the clean zoo. Mr. Brown learned that a clean zoo makes everyone happy.

One day, a little girl named Lily went for a walk in the evening. She saw a big tree and sat under it. The tree was very old and wise. The tree started to talk to Lily. The tree told her stories about the birds and the animals that lived in it. Lily liked to listen to the tree's stories. She felt happy and grateful to the tree for sharing its stories. Every evening, Lily would visit the tree and talk with it. They became good friends. The tree was grateful to have Lily as a friend too. They loved to talk and share stories with each other. And they lived happily together.

Tom and Lily were two mice who lived in a big house. They liked to find food and play in the rooms, but they had to be careful of the cat. The cat was big and mean and wanted to catch them. One day, Tom and Lily saw a shiny thing on a table. It was a crown that belonged to the king. The king was a man who lived in the house and had a lot of money and power. Tom and Lily thought the crown was very pretty and wanted to have it. "Let's take the crown and make it ours," said Tom. "We can be the king and queen of the mice." "But that is not right," said Lily. "The crown belongs to the king. He will be angry if we take it. And the cat might see us and chase us." "Don't be scared," said Tom. "We are fast and smart. We can escape from the cat. And the king will not miss the crown. He has many other things. He is cheap and greedy. He does not share with anyone." Tom and Lily took the crown and ran to their hole. They put the crown on their heads and felt very proud and happy. They did not see the cat who was watching them from behind a curtain. The cat waited until Tom and Lily fell asleep. Then he crept to their hole and pounced on them. He grabbed the crown and the mice and ran to the king. "Look what I have, your majesty," said the cat. "I have caught two thieves who stole your crown. They are cheap and greedy. They do not respect you." The king was very angry when he saw his crown and the mice. He thanked the cat and gave him a reward. He took the crown and put it back on his head. He ordered the mice to be locked in a cage and never let out. Tom and Lily were very sad and scared. They wished they had listened to Lily and not taken the crown. They learned that stealing is wrong and that being cheap and greedy does not make you happy. They hoped to escape from the cage and find a new home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She loved to play outside. One day, she saw a smelly sock on the ground. Sue picked it up and felt the texture. It was soft and wet. Sue wanted to know who the sock belonged to. She walked around and asked her friends, "Is this your smelly sock?" Her friends said no. Sue kept asking people she saw, but no one knew whose sock it was. Finally, Sue asked her mom. Her mom laughed and said, "Sue, that is your smelly sock! It must have fallen out of your bag." Sue giggled and put the sock back in her bag. She was happy to find the sock's home.

One day, a nosy cat went for a walk. The cat saw a big box of soap. The cat said, "What is this?" The soap said, "I am soap. I make things clean." The cat wanted to play with the soap. The soap said, "Okay, but be careful not to fall." They played and had fun. The cat was very happy. Then, something unexpected happened. The soap started to get smaller and smaller. The cat said, "Oh no, what is happening?" The soap said, "I am being used up because I make things clean. But don't worry, I will always come back as new soap."

One day, a big bear named Bob went for a walk in the icy woods. He saw a little cell on the ground. He picked it up and said, "Hmm, I wonder how much this weighs." Bob took the cell to his friend, a wise owl named Olly. Olly looked at the cell and said, "Let's use my big scale to find out how much it weighs." They put the cell on the scale, but it was so light that the scale did not move. Just then, the cell started to shake and grow bigger and bigger. Bob and Olly were very surprised! The cell turned into a big, friendly elephant named Ella. She said, "Thank you for finding my cell. I was trapped inside, but now I am free!" Bob and Olly were happy to help Ella. They all became good friends and played in the icy woods together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue had a pretty flower in her garden. The flower was red and smelled very nice. Sue loved her flower very much. One day, the sun was very hot. Sue was worried about her flower. She wanted to prevent the flower from getting too hot. Sue had a cool idea. She went inside her house and found a big hat. Sue put the big hat on top of the flower. The hat made a nice shade for the flower. The flower was now cool under the hat. Sue was happy that she could help her flower. They both had a great day in the garden.

Once upon a time, in a big park, there was a pigeon. The pigeon had a big sneeze. He sneezed so loud that all the other pigeons flew away. The pigeon felt sad and alone. One day, the pigeon saw a dark cloud in the sky. The dark cloud was coming closer and closer. All the other pigeons were scared of the dark cloud, but the sneezy pigeon was not scared. He wanted to see what was inside the dark cloud. As the dark cloud came close, the sneezy pigeon sneezed again. The big sneeze blew the dark cloud away! Inside the cloud, there was a big, shiny sun. All the other pigeons came back and thanked the sneezy pigeon for bringing the sun back. The sneezy pigeon was not sad anymore, and he had many new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom was a rich boy. He had a big house and many toys. But Tom was not happy. He wanted to win a medal. He wanted to be the best at something. One day, Tom saw a race. He wanted to win the medal. Tom ran as fast as he could. But he did not win. He lost the race. Tom was sad. He did not know what to do. So, he just gave a shrug. Then, Tom saw a girl named Sue. Sue was not rich. She had a small house and few toys. But Sue was happy. She did not need a medal to be happy. Sue was kind and helped others. Tom wanted to be like Sue. Tom learned from Sue. He started to help others too. He did not need a medal to be happy. Tom and Sue became good friends. They played and helped others together. In the end, Tom was happy. And he did not need a medal to be happy.

Once upon a time, there was a jet. The jet was very big and fast. The jet liked to fly high in the sky. The jet loved to go fast and make big clouds. The jet was very cold when it flew high. One day, the jet met a little bird. The little bird was not fast like the jet. The little bird was not cold like the jet. The little bird was warm and slow. The jet wanted to be friends with the little bird. The little bird taught the jet to value being slow and warm. They played and had fun together. The jet was not cold and fast all the time. The jet and the little bird were happy friends.

One day, a calm cat named Tom found a big cup. He wanted to add water to the cup. So he went to the river to fill it up. Tom met a dog named Max. Max said, "I want the cup!" Tom said, "No, I found it first!" They did not know what to do. They both wanted the cup. Then a bird flew by and saw the cup. The bird said, "I can help!" The bird took the cup and flew high in the sky. The cup fell and broke into two parts. Tom and Max were sad, but then they saw two smaller cups. They each took one cup and were happy. They became friends and played together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to eat blueberries. One hot day, she went to the park with her mom. At the park, Sue saw a blueberry bush. She wanted to pick some, but the bush was too tall. Sue's mom came to support her. She lifted Sue up so she could reach the blueberries. Sue picked a lot of blueberries and put them in her basket. She and her mom went home. They made a yummy blueberry pie. Sue was happy and shared the pie with her friends.

One day, a calm cat named Tom went for a walk. He saw a big tree on the side of the road. Tom wanted to climb the tree. He put his paws on the tree and started to go up. As Tom went up, he saw a bird named Billy. Billy was twisting his head to look at Tom. "Why are you climbing my tree?" Billy asked. Tom said, "I want to see the top." Billy and Tom became friends. They played in the tree and twisted their bodies around the branches. They were very happy on the side of the tree. At the end of the day, they said goodbye and Tom went back home.

Once upon a time, there was a curious little boy named Tim. He liked to look at the world around him. He would ask his mom and dad about everything he saw. He wanted to know how things fit together. One sunny day, Tim went for a walk with his mom. They saw a big box on the ground. "What's inside?" Tim asked. His mom said, "I don't know, let's open it." When they opened the box, they found a big, colorful ball. Tim was so happy and started to play with it. As Tim played with the ball, it started to grow. It grew so big that it didn't fit in the box anymore. Tim and his mom were surprised! The ball kept growing until it was bigger than Tim's house. Tim climbed on top of the ball and saw the whole world around him. He felt like he was on top of the world. His mom laughed, and they had a great day playing with the big ball.

Tommy liked to draw in his notebook. He drew cars and planes and animals. He was very good at drawing. He liked to show his drawings to his mommy and daddy. They always said he was very clever and gave him hugs and kisses. One day, Tommy went to play with his friend Billy. Billy had a lot of toys, but he did not like to share. He wanted to play with all the toys by himself. He did not want to see Tommy's notebook. He said drawing was boring and silly. He said Tommy was ignorant. He said that word very loud and mean. Tommy did not know what ignorant meant, but he felt sad and hurt. He did not like Billy anymore. He wanted to go home. He took his notebook and tried to leave. But Billy was angry. He ran after Tommy and grabbed his notebook. He tried to rip it and throw it away. He said he did not care about Tommy's drawings. Tommy was scared and mad. He shouted at Billy. He said Billy was a bad friend and a mean boy. He said he did not want to play with him ever again. He pulled his notebook back from Billy. He shut it very hard and held it tight. He ran out of Billy's house and back to his own. Tommy's mommy and daddy saw him crying. They asked him what happened. Tommy told them everything. They hugged him and said they were sorry. They said Billy was wrong and rude. They said Tommy was not ignorant. They said he was smart and kind. They said they loved him and his drawings. They opened his notebook and looked at them. They smiled and praised him. Tommy felt better. He smiled too. He was happy to have his notebook and his mommy and daddy. He did not need Billy. He had his own friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big whale. The whale was troubled. He did not know how to swim well. He wanted to learn but did not know how. One day, he met a little fish. The fish said, "I can teach you how to swim." The whale and the fish swam in the water. The fish taught the whale how to swim fast and slow. The whale was very happy. They played in the water all day. The whale was not troubled anymore. But one day, the little fish was gone. The whale was sad. Then, he saw a big fish. The big fish said, "I am the little fish. I was just a baby when I taught you how to swim. Now I am big." The whale and the big fish played in the water again. They were happy and not troubled anymore.

Tom and Sue were twins who liked to play in the garden. They had a pet rabbit named Fluffy who lived in a cage. Fluffy was white and soft and liked to eat carrots. One day, Tom and Sue saw a big black cat near the fence. The cat looked hungry and mean. It saw Fluffy in the cage and licked its lips. Tom and Sue were scared for Fluffy. They ran to the cage and tried to shoo the cat away. "Go away, bad cat!" Tom shouted. "You can't have Fluffy!" "Fluffy is ours!" Sue said. "You are mean and ugly!" The cat did not listen. It jumped on the cage and tried to open it with its claws. Fluffy was very afraid. He hid in a corner and trembled. The cat teased Fluffy. It said, "You are a weak and silly rabbit. You can't run or fight. You are a tasty snack for me. I will eat you soon!" Tom and Sue cried. They did not know what to do. They wished their dad was home. He would scare the cat away. But then, they heard a loud bark. It was their dog, Spot. Spot was big and strong and brave. He heard the noise and came to help. He ran to the cage and barked at the cat. "Leave Fluffy alone!" Spot said. "He is my friend. You are a bad and cowardly cat. You can't bully him. You have to face me!" The cat was surprised and afraid. It saw Spot's teeth and heard his bark. It knew it could not win. It let go of the cage and ran away. Tom and Sue cheered. They hugged Spot and thanked him. They opened the cage and took out Fluffy. They petted him and gave him a carrot. "Fluffy, you are safe!" Tom said. "Spot saved you!" "Spot, you are a hero!" Sue said. "You chased the cat away!" Fluffy was happy. He licked Spot's nose and said, "Spot, you are a good and kind dog. You are my friend too. Thank you!"

One day, a silly cat named Tom went for a walk. He saw a pretty landscape with trees, flowers, and a big blue sky. Tom was very happy and wanted to explore. As Tom walked, he saw a bird in a tree. The bird said, "Hi, silly cat! Do you want to talk?" Tom said, "Yes, I like to talk. What do you see in the tree?" The bird said, "I see a big red ball stuck in the branches. Can you help me get it down?" Tom thought for a moment and had an idea. He climbed the tree and pushed the big red ball with his paw. The ball fell down, and the bird was so happy. They both played with the big red ball and had a fun day together. The silly cat and the bird became good friends, and they knew they would have many more adventures in the pretty landscape.

Once upon a time, there was a big, heavy goose. The goose lived on a little farm. The farm had a red barn and a big truck. The goose liked to play with the other animals on the farm. One day, the farmer said, "We need to load the truck with food for the animals." The heavy goose wanted to help. So, the goose and the farmer worked together to put the food on the truck. The heavy goose said, "I am happy to help you, farmer!" The farmer smiled and said, "Thank you, heavy goose! You are a good friend." After they finished loading the truck, the farmer and the heavy goose went to the barn to rest. They were very tired, but they were happy to have helped each other.

One day, a large dog named Max went for a walk. He saw a big tree with lots of leaves. Under the tree, he found a folder. The folder was red and shiny. Max was very happy to find it. Max took the folder home. He wanted to show it to his mom. But, on the way home, he saw a big puddle. Max loved to play in puddles. He jumped in the puddle and got all wet. The folder got wet too. When Max got home, his mom saw the wet folder. She said, "Oh no, Max! You spoiled the folder by getting it wet." Max was sad, but his mom hugged him. She said, "It's okay. We can dry the folder and still use it." Max was happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a naughty cat named Tom. Tom liked to play tricks on his friends. One sunny day, Tom saw his friend, a little bird named Sally, hopping from step to step on the stairs. Tom had an idea to play a naughty trick on Sally. He found some sticky gum and put it on one of the steps. He wanted to see Sally get stuck on the gum. Tom hid behind a tree and waited for Sally to hop on the sticky step. Sally hopped from step to step, not knowing about the gum. When she stepped on the sticky step, her foot got stuck! Sally tried to restore her foot, but it was too hard. She was very sad and cried for help. Tom felt bad for playing the naughty trick on Sally, but he didn't know how to help her. In the end, Sally stayed stuck on the step, and Tom learned that playing naughty tricks on friends can lead to a bad ending.

One day, there was a very good underground. It was special because it was all the little girl's own. She said to her mom, "I own this? It's mine?" Her mom said, "Yes. It's yours. You can do whatever you want here." The girl felt so happy and excited. She jumped, ran and skipped around the underground. She couldn't believe it was all hers! She explored every part of the underground. Every corner was so good. She found bright colors, soft textures and interesting shapes. The little girl was so proud because she owned her own underground. It was a place where she could go and feel safe and happy.

One day, a small boy named Tim wanted to wrap a gift for his mom. He found a pretty box and some paper. He tried to wrap the gift, but it was not easy. Tim felt sad. Then, Tim's big sister, Sue, came to help him. She showed him how to wrap the gift. They put the gift in the cooler to hide it from their mom. Tim and Sue were happy. Later, it was time to give the gift to their mom. They took the gift out of the cooler. Their mom was very happy when she saw the gift. Tim and Sue hugged their mom. They all had a fun day.

Once upon a time, there was a colorful bird. This bird liked to fly and sing. One day, the bird saw something black in a tree. The bird did not know what it was, so it went to see. When the bird got close, it saw a black cat. The cat was sad and began to cry. The bird wanted to help the cat. The bird asked, "Why do you cry?" The cat said, "I am stuck in the tree and I can't get down." The bird had an idea. It told the cat to hold on to its wings. The cat was scared, but it trusted the bird. The bird flew down and the cat held on tight. When they got to the ground, the cat was so happy. The cat said, "Thank you, bird!" The cat and the bird became best friends. From that day on, they played together and the cat never cried again.

Once upon a time, there was a big hedge. In this hedge, there lived a small bird. The bird was sad and would sigh every day. It wanted to find a friend to play with. One day, the bird saw an elderly dog. The dog was slow and tired. The bird asked the dog, "Do you want to play with me?" The dog was happy and said, "Yes, let's play together!" The bird and the dog played all day long. After playing, the bird did not sigh anymore. The elderly dog was happy too. They became best friends. The moral of the story is that friends can be found in unexpected places, and they can make us happy when we are sad.

One day, a boy named Tom had a pet cat. The cat was bad. It liked to make a mess in the house. Tom's mom was not happy. Tom said, "Cat, you need to be good. I will write a list of good things for you to do." The cat looked at Tom and meowed. Tom wrote on a big paper. The cat watched. The cat tried to be good, but it was hard. The cat knocked over a cup. Tom's mom was mad. She said, "Tom, if the cat does not learn, we cannot keep it." Tom was sad, but he did not give up. He showed the cat the list again. The cat looked and tried to be good.

Once upon a time, there was a long letter. A girl named Sue wanted to mail it. She put the letter in a big box. Sue was a big fan of sending letters to her friends. One day, Sue saw a big mailbox. She knew it was the right place to mail her long letter. Sue was very happy. She thought about her friend, who would get the letter soon. When Sue's friend got the letter, she was very happy too. She was a big fan of getting letters from Sue. They both loved to send and get letters. And that is how Sue and her friend stayed happy and close, even when they were far away.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a little bird named Tim. Tim loved to fly from tree to tree. He liked to see all the colors of the different seasons. In the fall, the leaves were red and yellow. In the winter, the trees were white with snow. In the spring, the flowers were pink and blue. In the summer, the grass was green. One day, Tim found it difficult to fly. His wing was hurt. He was sad because he could not fly and see the pretty colors. Tim sat on a branch and cried. He wanted to fly again and see the seasons change. A kind squirrel saw Tim and wanted to help. The squirrel found a big leaf and tied it to Tim's wing. Tim felt better and tried to fly. It was still a little difficult, but Tim could fly again! Tim was happy and thanked the squirrel. They became friends and flew together to see the colors of the seasons.

Tom and Sam are friends. They like to play in the park. They see a new slide. It is big and shiny. They want to try it. "Let's go, Tom!" Sam says. He runs to the slide. He climbs up the ladder. He slides down fast. He laughs. "This is fun!" Tom follows him. He also climbs up the ladder. He slides down slowly. He is scared. He does not laugh. "This is not fun!" Sam sees Tom is sad. He wants to help him. He has an idea. He finds a stick. He gives it to Tom. "Here, Tom. Hold this stick. It will make you brave." Tom takes the stick. He feels better. He climbs up the ladder again. He slides down faster. He smiles. "This is fun!" Sam is happy. He slides down with Tom. They both laugh. They play with the stick. They have a good time. The moral of the story is: A friend can help you overcome your fears.

One day, a little girl was playing in her garden. She saw a helicopter flying in the sky. She smiled and waved to the helicopter. But then she noticed that the helicopter had a bad frown on its face. The little girl felt worried. She wanted to help make the helicopter smile again. So she started to look around. She saw a familiar-looking butterfly and some happy birds playing in the sky. She smiled and the butterfly and waved to the birds. But when she looked back to the sky, the helicopter still had a bad frown on its face. The little girl felt sad. She wanted to make the helicopter happy. So she held out her arms and she laughed and smiled really hard. The wind started to blow and suddenly the bad frown started to turn into a happy smile! The little girl was so excited that she jumped in the air and shouted “Yay!” The helicopter flew away with its happy smile, and the little girl was so glad that she had been able to help.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. They saw a big, scary dog. Tim was scared and he held his mom's hand tight. The dog was barking loud and running around. Tim and his mom did not know what to do. Tim's mom said, "Don't worry, Tim. I will call the police to help us." The police came very fast. They saw the scary dog and talked to it. The dog stopped barking and running. The police held the dog's leash and took it away. Tim was happy and not scared anymore. He said, "Thank you, police!" The police smiled and said, "You're welcome, Tim. Always be careful at the park." Tim and his mom went home and told dad about their adventure.

One day, a dog and a cat went for a walk. They saw a big farm with many animals. The dog and the cat wanted to play with the animals, so they ran to the farm. But the farmer was rude. He did not like the dog and the cat. He shouted at them and threw a stick. The dog and the cat were scared and ran away. They ran and ran until they found a nice park. There were flowers and trees and a pond. The dog and the cat saw some ducks and geese in the pond. They wanted to play with them, so they ran to the pond. But the ducks and geese were rude. They did not like the dog and the cat. They quacked and honked and splashed water. The dog and the cat were wet and cold and ran away. They ran and ran until they found a cozy house. There was a fence and a gate and a door. The dog and the cat saw a boy and a girl in the house. They wanted to play with them, so they ran to the house. But the boy and the girl were nice. They liked the dog and the cat. They opened the gate and the door and let them in. They gave them food and water and a warm bed. The dog and the cat were happy and stayed with them. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who had a very strong phone. He loved to play on his phone and he never wanted to be apart from it. One day the boy was playing on his phone and accidentally dropped it into a big puddle of water. He saw the splash and started to cry. His mom came running over to him and asked what had happened. The little boy said, "My phone fell in the water and it's soaking wet". His mom worried about this and said, "Oh no, we need to take it to the store to get fixed". But it was too late. The phone had been soaked for so long that it couldn't be fixed and was now broken forever. The little boy was very sad and cried for days about his strong phone. He had now lost his favourite toy and all his friends were very sad for him. The bad ending was that the little boy could never play with his phone again.

Once upon a time, there was a silly little girl named Sue. She loved to play with her friends at their club. They would laugh, sing, and dance together every day. One day, Sue lost her favorite toy. She was very sad and did not know what to do. Her mommy told her to pray and ask for help to find her toy. So, Sue closed her eyes and prayed very hard. The next day, when Sue went to the club, she saw her toy on the floor! She was so happy and thanked her friends for helping her find it. They all played together with the toy and had a fun day. Sue knew that praying had helped her find her lost toy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Anna who was three years old. She was very happy and she loved to sing. Usually her songs were cheerful, but one day she had a strange idea. Anna decided that she wanted to sing a song with pastels. She gathered all her pastels, but the sun was hot and she kept melting them. Anna was getting frustrated and tried to be patient, but eventually she decided to try taking them outside. Anna walked out onto the balcony and held up her pastels. "She sings", she said proudly. Suddenly, the hot sun melted all her pastels and they ran down her arm. Anna was so sad, she started to cry. Her mom heard her cries and came to comfort her. "It's OK, my love", she said, as she hugged Anna and wiped her tears away. Anna never tried to sing with pastels again.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy named Tim. Tim liked to play outside in the winter. He loved the cold and the snow. He would put on his warm coat, hat, and gloves, and run outside to play. One day, Tim found a long stick in the snow. He picked it up and pretended it was a bow. He would pull on the stick and shoot pretend arrows into the air. He liked to see how far he could shoot them. As Tim played, a little squirrel came to watch. The squirrel was curious about what Tim was doing. Tim saw the squirrel and smiled. He shot a pretend arrow up into the tree, and the squirrel chased it. They played together all winter long, and Tim and the squirrel became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a tall hero named Tom. Tom was very strong and always helped people. One day, he saw a little girl named Lily who was sad. She lost her toy in a tree. Tom walked to the tree and said, "Don't worry, Lily. I will help you get your toy back." He reached up with his long arm and tried to poke the toy out of the tree. But it was too high. So, Tom climbed the tree and poked the toy with a stick. The toy fell down, and Lily was happy. Lily said, "Thank you, Tom! You are my hero!" Tom smiled and said, "You're welcome. Always remember to help others when they need it." And from that day on, Lily learned the importance of helping others and being kind.

Once there was a small girl named Tilly. She was three-years-old and liked to explore. One day Tilly was walking through a park when she saw a photo lying on the ground. She picked it up and looked at it. The photo was of a kind-looking man standing in a field. Tilly wanted to find out who the man in the photo was. So Tilly decided to show the photo to everyone she could find. She went up to people in the park and asked them if they knew who the man was. Eventually, she gained the answer she was looking for. It turned out that the man was Tilly's grandpa! With the help of many honest people, Tilly found him. She was so happy that she gained the answer and quickly ran off to show her grandpa the photo. She was sure that he would be surprised to see it. When she arrived, Tilly immediately showed the photo to grandpa. His face lit up with joy! He was so happy that she had found it. Tilly was really glad that she had gained the answer. She loved being an explorer, and the photo made the adventure even more special. Now she had a memento to remember her grandpa by.

One day, a brown bird named Bob saw a big plane in the sky. The plane made a loud noise. Bob did not like the noise. He wanted the plane to go away. Bob went to his friend, a cat named Sam. Bob said, "Sam, I do not like the plane. It is too loud. I want it to go away." Sam did not like the plane too. They both complain about the plane. Bob and Sam thought of a plan. They would talk to the plane and ask it to be quiet. They went to the plane when it was on the ground. They said, "Please, Mr. Plane, can you be quiet? Your noise hurts our ears." The plane was sad. It did not want to hurt Bob and Sam. It said, "I am sorry. I will try to be more quiet." From that day on, the plane was more quiet. Bob and Sam were happy. They did not complain anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a big desk. A girl named Sue loved to create things on this desk. She made pretty pictures with her crayons and colored pencils. Sue was very happy when she played at her desk. One day, Sue was troubled. She lost her favorite crayon. She looked under the desk and in her crayon box, but she could not find it. Sue was sad because she needed that crayon to make her picture perfect. Sue's mom saw that she was troubled. She helped Sue look for the crayon. They looked all around the desk. Finally, they found the crayon behind the desk. Sue was so happy! She hugged her mom and went back to her desk to create her beautiful picture.

Lily loved flowers. She liked to smell them, touch them, and look at their colors. She had a garden with many flowers. She watered them every day and sang to them. One day, she saw a new flower in her garden. It was big and red and shiny. It looked like a mask. Lily was curious. She wanted to see it closer. She walked to the flower and bent down. "Hello, little girl," the flower said. "Do you like me?" Lily was surprised. She had never heard a flower talk before. She was a little scared, but also excited. "Yes, you are very pretty," she said. "But how can you talk?" "I am a special flower," the flower said. "I can talk and think and feel. I came from a faraway land. I bloomed here to make friends." Lily smiled. She liked to make friends. She asked the flower many questions. She learned that the flower's name was Ruby, and that she liked the sun and the rain and the wind. They talked for a long time. They became friends. Lily was very happy. But then, Lily's mom called her. She said it was time to go inside and have lunch. Lily did not want to leave Ruby. She wanted to stay with her. "Can I come back later?" she asked Ruby. "Of course," Ruby said. "I will be here. But you have to promise me something." "What is it?" Lily asked. "You have to promise me that you will not tell anyone about me," Ruby said. "I am a secret flower. If people find out about me, they might take me away or hurt me. I only trust you." Lily nodded. She understood. She did not want Ruby to be sad or scared. She wanted Ruby to be cheerful. "I promise," she said. "You are my secret friend. I will not tell anyone." She hugged Ruby and said goodbye. She ran to her mom and had lunch. She did not say anything about Ruby. She kept her promise. She could not wait to see Ruby again. She hoped Ruby would be happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lisa. She loved to play with her toys in her room. One day, her mom bought her an expensive toy. It was a pretty doll with a sharp crown. Lisa was very happy and played with the doll all day. One day, Lisa was playing with the doll near the closet. She accidentally dropped the doll's sharp crown into the closet. Lisa tried to find the crown, but it was too dark inside the closet. She was scared to go in. Lisa asked her mom for help. Her mom carefully went into the closet and found the sharp crown. She told Lisa to be more careful with her expensive toys. Lisa learned that it's important to take care of her things and not be careless. From that day on, she played more carefully and always put her toys away in their right place.

Once upon a time, there was a wild pony. It liked to travel around, exploring new places. One day, it decided to go into a dark forest. The pony thought the journey wouldn't be so bad, but soon realized it was over its head. Everywhere it turned, it got lost and soon it was completely alone. The pony became very scared as it kept wandering aimlessly. Suddenly, it heard a loud roar. The pony realized it was a big, wild beast looking for its dinner! The pony quickly made a run for it, but it was too late. The beast was right on its tail. Just at the last minute, the pony saw a little stream. It quickly jumped in and the wild monster couldn't follow. The pony escaped and it never returned to the dark forest again!

Once upon a time, there was a big volcano. It was very tall and lived in a far away land. Many animals lived near the volcano. They were happy and played all day long. One day, the big volcano started to twist and shake. The animals were scared and did not know what to do. They ran away from the volcano to find a safe place to hide. After a while, the big volcano stopped twisting and shaking. The animals were happy and went back to their homes. They played and had fun again, knowing the big volcano was now calm and quiet. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a very intelligent boy. One day, he found a pretty shell on the beach. He wanted to keep the shell forever. Tim showed the shell to his friend, Sam. Sam liked the shell too. Sam said, "I want the shell. Give it to me." Tim did not want to give the shell to Sam. They both got mad. Tim and Sam fought over the shell. They pulled and pulled. The pretty shell broke into two. Now, nobody could keep the shell. Tim and Sam were both sad.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to play outside with his dog, Spot. One day, they went to the park to play. At the park, Tim found a big rock. He thought it was special because it was hidden under a bush. Tim said to Spot, "Look, I found a rock! Let's bury it and come back later to find it." Spot barked happily. Tim dug a hole with his hands and put the rock in it. He covered it with dirt and put a stick on top. "Now we can find it later," he said. Spot barked again. They played more and went home. They had a fun day at the park with their hidden rock.

Once upon a time, there was a dancer. She loved to dance all day. She was deaf, but she could feel the beat in her heart. One day, the dancer found a spray bottle. She thought it would be fun to spray water while she danced. She filled it with water and started to dance and spray. As she danced and sprayed, something unexpected happened. The water from the spray bottle turned into pretty colors! The dancer was so happy. She danced and sprayed, making beautiful colors all around her. And that's how the deaf dancer became a magical color dancer.

Once upon a time, in a big garden, there was a red strawberry. The strawberry was very yummy. Many friends wanted to get the strawberry. A selfish ant saw the strawberry first. He wanted to get it all for himself. The ant did not want to share with his friends. He tried to get the strawberry, but it was too big for him. Then, a kind bird saw the ant and the strawberry. The bird wanted to help. The bird picked up the strawberry and shared it with the ant and all their friends. Everyone was happy and learned that sharing is better than being selfish.

Once upon a time there lived a little boy named Tommy. Tommy wanted nothing more than to go to the store with his mom. He was so excited when one day his mom said they could go. At the store, Tommy saw a great cart. He begged his mom to get it, and she said they could if Tommy was honest. Tommy was so happy, and he nodded in agreement. Tommy held on to his cart as they walked around the store, picking up everything his mom needed. All the while, he made sure to be honest. Soon, it was time to check out. As he waited in line, Tommy saw a lady at the counter with her cart. Her face was angry, and she said to the cashier "I want my money back!" Tommy was curious. The cashier explained that the woman had stolen from the store and said, "See how important it is to be honest?" Tommy nodded and thought about his own cart. He said to the cashier, "Yes, I want to be honest." The cashier smiled and said, "Good job!" Tommy held his cart a bit tighter after that and was even more determined to be honest.

One day, a dog named Max went for a jog. He liked to jog in the park. He saw his friend, a cat named Sam. Sam was sitting on a bench, looking uncomfortable. "Hi Sam, why are you uncomfortable?" Max asked. Sam said, "I have a quiz today, and I am scared." Max wanted to help his friend. He had an idea. Max told Sam to jog with him. They jogged around the park. Sam began to feel better. When they were done, Sam said, "Thank you, Max. I am not scared of the quiz now." Max was happy to help his friend.

Once, there was a little boy named Tim. He had a new ball to play with. Tim was very happy. He wanted to show his new ball to his friend, Sue.
