They noticed that the eraser could increase in size when they pulled it. They had lots of fun with their new toy, and they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little jet. The jet was very fast. It could fly high in the sky. The jet had many friends, like birds and clouds. But the jet was sad because it wanted to gain more speed. One day, the jet saw a big bird. The bird was very fast too. The jet felt jealous of the bird. The jet wanted to be as fast as the bird. So, the jet asked the bird, "How can I gain more speed?" The bird said, "You can gain more speed by trying your best and never giving up." The jet listened to the bird and tried very hard. It practiced every day, flying higher and faster. Soon, the jet was not jealous of the bird anymore. The jet had gained more speed and was very happy. The jet and the bird became best friends. They flew together in the sky, and they were both very fast.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He liked to play in the mud and get filthy. One day, he found a big pot in the yard. It was very dirty, but he thought it was fun to play with. Tim put the pot on his head and started to walk around. He wanted to scare his mom. He thought it would be funny. But when he walked into the house, his mom did not see him. She saw the pot and thought it was a big hat. She did not know it was Tim. Then, something unexpected happened. Tim's mom started to laugh. She thought the pot was a gift from Tim's dad. She put the pot on her head too. Tim was surprised. He thought he would scare his mom, but instead, they both laughed and played with the pot together.

Once upon a time, there was a bald man named Tom. Tom had a telephone in his house. He liked to talk to his friends on the telephone. One day, Tom wanted to polish his telephone. He took a soft cloth and made the telephone very shiny. He was very happy with his clean telephone. Tom called his friend, Sam, on the telephone. He told Sam about the shiny telephone. Sam was happy for Tom. They both laughed and had a good time talking on the telephone.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She had a big cup of juice that she loved very much. One day, she wanted to share her juice with her friend Tom. But Tom did not want to share. This made Sue sad. Sue thought it was important to share with her friends. She hoped that Tom would change his mind. So, she asked him again, "Tom, can we please share my juice?" Tom looked at the juice and thought about it. Finally, Tom said, "Okay, Sue. We can share your juice." Sue was very happy. They both drank the juice and had a lot of fun. They learned that sharing is important and it made their friendship stronger.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Spot. Spot was a poor dog. He did not have a home. One day, Spot saw a big building. It said "veterinarian." Spot went inside. Inside, Spot met a nice man. The man was a veterinarian. Spot liked the man. The man gave Spot food and love. Spot was happy. The man said, "Spot, I quit being a veterinarian." Spot was sad. The man said, "Do not be sad, Spot. I quit being a veterinarian to help dogs like you. I will find homes for dogs." Spot was happy again. The man found a home for Spot.

One day, a little boy named Tim was feeling anxious. He did not want to play outside. His mom said, "Why do you complain, Tim? Let's go to the garage and find a toy to play with." In the garage, Tim saw a big red ball. He asked his mom, "Can I play with the ball?" His mom said, "Yes, Tim. You can play with the ball. Let's go outside and have fun." Tim and his mom went outside. They played with the big red ball. Tim was not anxious anymore. He was happy. He did not complain anymore. Tim and his mom had a fun day playing outside.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a little girl named Amy. Amy had a weird toy named Mr. Bunny. Mr. Bunny had big ears, so he could listen very well. Amy liked to tell Mr. Bunny all her worry and secrets. One day, Amy told Mr. Bunny, "I worry about my birthday. I want my friends to come, but I'm scared they won't like the cake." Mr. Bunny listened carefully. That night, when Amy was asleep, something unexpected happened. Mr. Bunny came to life! Mr. Bunny said, "I will help Amy with her worry." He went to the kitchen and made the best cake ever. The next day, Amy saw the cake and was so happy. At the party, her friends loved the cake too. Amy knew Mr. Bunny helped her and whispered, "Thank you, Mr. Bunny."

Lila and Tom were friends who liked to play in the woods. One day, they found a big hole in the ground. It was deep and dark, but they saw something shiny inside. "Look, Tom, a crystal!" Lila said. "I want it!" "No, I want it!" Tom said. "It's mine!" They both ran to the hole and tried to grab the crystal. But it was too far and they slipped and fell. They screamed as they tumbled down the deep hole. They landed on a pile of rocks and bones. They were hurt and scared. They looked up and saw a big snake with red eyes. It was hungry and angry. It had been waiting for someone to fall into its trap. "Help, help!" Lila and Tom cried. "Someone, please help us!" But no one heard them. The snake moved closer and closer. It opened its mouth and showed its sharp teeth. It was ready to eat them. The crystal sparkled in the dark. It was the last thing they saw.

Once upon a time, there was a clever cat named Max and a dog named Buddy. They lived in a big house with their family. Max and Buddy liked to play, but sometimes they would fight and complain about each other. One day, Max and Buddy were playing with their ball. Max said, "Buddy, I want to play with the ball now!" Buddy replied, "No, Max, it's my turn!" They started to fight and complain about who would play with the ball. While Max and Buddy were fighting, a small bird flew into their house. The bird saw the ball and thought it was a fun toy. The bird took the ball and flew away. Max and Buddy stopped fighting and saw the bird flying away with their ball. They were sad because they lost their favorite toy. They learned that fighting and complaining did not help them, and they should have shared the ball.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy had many shoes that she liked to wear. But her shoes were all mixed up in a big pile. It was difficult for Amy to find the right shoe when she wanted to go outside and play. One day, Amy decided to organize her shoes. She put all the shoes in a row. She put the big shoes on one side and the small shoes on the other side. Then she put the shoes that were the same together. Now it was easy for Amy to find the right shoe when she wanted to go outside and play. Amy was very happy that she organized her shoes. She showed her mom and dad, and they were proud of her. Now, Amy could go outside and play faster because she could find the right shoe quickly. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the beach with his mom. They saw a big jellyfish in the water. Tim wanted to touch it, but his mom said, "No, Tim! It is not safe." Tim was sad but he listened to his mom. They played in the sand and built a big sandcastle. It was easy and fun. Then, they saw a man with a long stick. He was trying to reach the jellyfish. The man said, "Hi, I am a helper. I will take the jellyfish away so you can play in the water." Tim and his mom watched as the man reached the jellyfish with the long stick. But, the jellyfish was not a real jellyfish! It was just a toy. Tim and his mom laughed. They thanked the helper and played with the toy jellyfish in the water. Now, they could have more fun at the beach.

One day, a little boy named Tim had a plan. He wanted to make steam with his toy train. He thought it would be fun to see the steam go up in the air. So, he asked his friend Sam to help him. "Let's make steam with my toy train," Tim said to Sam. "Okay, but we need hot water," Sam replied. They went to the kitchen and filled a cup with hot water. They poured the water into the train, but nothing happened. They felt stupid because they could not make steam. Just then, Tim's big sister came into the room. She saw the boys looking sad. "What's wrong?" she asked. Tim told her about their plan to make steam with the toy train. She laughed and said, "That's not how you make steam. You need a real train, not a toy." Tim and Sam looked at each other and started to laugh too. They realized that they had made a mistake. But they were still happy because they had a fun time trying to make steam. And they learned something new from Tim's sister.

Once upon a time, there was a big maze in a fun park. Kids loved to play in the maze. One day, a little girl named Lucy went to the park. She was ready to play in the maze. Lucy walked into the maze and started to find her way. She saw a small cat stuck in the maze. The cat was sad. Lucy wanted to help the cat. She kneeled down and pet the cat. The cat felt better. Lucy and the cat walked together in the maze. They helped each other. Soon, they found the way out. Lucy and the cat were happy. They played in the park all day. They became best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a fast bunny named Ben. Ben loved to run and play in the big green field. One day, Ben saw a big onion growing in the ground. He thought it would be fun to give the onion to his friend, Tom the turtle. Ben picked up the onion and hopped over to Tom's house. When he got there, he said, "Hi Tom! I provide you this onion. It will make your food tasty." Tom looked at the onion and smiled. He said, "Thank you, Ben! I will put it in my soup tonight." Ben and Tom played all day long. They were happy to be friends and share the onion. When it was time for Ben to go home, Tom said, "Come back soon, Ben! We can play and share more food." Ben agreed and hopped away, excited for their next playdate.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sally who lived in a big, beautiful house. One day when exploring her house, Sally discovered a mysterious chamber. She hadn't seen it before and wanted to see what was inside. She opened the door and stepped inside. Inside the chamber, Sally faced a big problem. She saw that the room was spinning in reverse and she couldn't get out. Sally was scared and didn't know what to do. Suddenly there was a voice. "Little one, don't be scared," the voice said. "I'm here to help you. My name is Compassionate Jasper and I'm here to help you get out." "Thank you," replied Sally. Compassionate Jasper was an old wizard who had the ability to reverse the spinning of the chamber. He used his magic and soon the chamber was spinning in the right direction. "Thank you so much," said Sally. Compassionate Jasper smiled at her and said: "You are most welcome my dear. All it takes is a little compassion to get through tough problems. Goodbye!" Sally thanked Compassionate Jasper again and stepped out of the chamber. Little did she know there were more surprises ahead!

Once upon a time, there was a brave boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy jeep. He would drive it around his room all day long. Tim also liked to measure things with his ruler. One sunny day, Tim went outside with his jeep and ruler. He wanted to measure how far his jeep could go. He put the jeep on the ground and pushed it. The jeep went very far! Tim was happy. But then, something unexpected happened. A big bird saw the jeep and thought it was a toy for her. The bird picked up the jeep in her beak and flew away. Tim was sad, but he knew he had to be brave. He followed the bird to her nest and asked her to give his jeep back. The bird was sorry and gave Tim his jeep back. Tim was happy again and they both became friends.

Once upon a time, there was a small rubber ball named Bouncy. Bouncy was very anxious because he wanted to play with the other toys, but he was too small. He tried to fit in with the bigger toys, but he just couldn't. One day, Bouncy met a big toy truck named Truckie. Truckie saw that Bouncy was sad and asked, "Why are you sad, Bouncy?" Bouncy replied, "I want to play with the other toys, but I am too small and don't fit in." Truckie thought for a moment and then said, "I have an idea! You can fit in my truck bed, and we can play together!" Bouncy was so happy and jumped into Truckie's truck bed. They played together all day long. From that day on, Bouncy and Truckie were the best of friends. Bouncy was no longer anxious, and he learned that it's not about fitting in with the other toys, but finding the right friends to play with. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, in a pretty little park, there was a big pond. A duck named Dolly lived in the pond. She loved to splash and play in the water all day long. The sun was shining, and the water was nice and warm. One day, Dolly saw a ball near the pond. She wanted to play with it. She swam over and gave it a big splash with her wing. The ball went up in the air and started to roll away. Dolly chased after it, making sure not to let it pass her. As Dolly played with the ball, a little girl named Lily came by. She saw Dolly having fun and wanted to join in. Lily picked up the ball and threw it towards the pond. Dolly splashed it again, and they both laughed. They played together until the sun went down, and they became the best of friends.

Lily and Tom were playing in the kitchen. They liked to pretend they were chefs and make yummy food. They had a big pot, some spoons, and some things from the fridge. "Let's make soup!" Lily said. "I have carrots and cheese and milk." "OK!" Tom said. "I have pepper and salt and bread." They put everything in the pot and stirred it with the spoons. They smelled the soup and smiled. "It smells good!" Tom said. "Can we taste it?" "Yes!" Lily said. "But be careful, it might be hot." They each took a spoonful of soup and put it in their mouths. Lily liked it. It was sweet and creamy. But Tom made a funny face. He spit out the soup and coughed. "Yuck!" Tom said. "It's spicy and rough!" Lily looked at the pot. She saw a lot of black dots in the soup. She realized that Tom had put too much pepper in it. Pepper was spicy and rough. It made Tom's mouth hurt. "I'm sorry, Tom!" Lily said. "I didn't know you put pepper in it. Do you want some water?" "Yes, please!" Tom said. "And some bread. Bread is soft and nice." Lily got some water and bread for Tom. She gave him a hug and said sorry again. Tom drank the water and ate the bread. He felt better. "It's OK, Lily," Tom said. "We can make soup again. But next time, let's use less pepper. OK?" "OK!" Lily said. "And more cheese. Cheese is yummy!" They laughed and hugged. They were still friends. They liked to play in the kitchen. But they learned to be careful with pepper.

Once upon a time, in a big tree, there was a little bird. The bird was very gifted. It could sing pretty songs all day. The other birds liked to hear the gifted bird sing. They all wanted to become like the gifted bird. One day, the gifted bird saw a sad bird. The sad bird could not sing like the gifted bird. The gifted bird had an idea. It would teach the sad bird to sing. The other birds saw this and started to talk. They knew something good would happen. The gifted bird helped the sad bird every day. Soon, the sad bird could sing too. The other birds were happy. They learned that helping others makes everyone happy. The gifted bird was not just good at singing, but also good at teaching. The birds all became good friends, and they sang together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a monkey named Momo. Momo liked to keep things organized. He lived in a tree with his friends, the birds. One day, Momo saw a big mess on the ground. He said to the birds, "Look at the mess! Let's clean it up." The birds agreed, and they all started to clean. As they were cleaning, Momo found a stick. He tried to break it, but it was too strong. So, Momo used his hands to snap the stick in half. The birds saw this and clapped their wings. Momo said, "Now we can use the stick to help clean." The birds were happy, and they all worked together to make their home organized again. In the end, Momo and the birds had a clean and organized tree. They were all very happy and proud of their work.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a new ice-cream shop. It had many yummy ice-creams. One day, a little girl named Lily went to the shop. She wanted to buy her favorite ice-cream. Lily tried to reach the ice-cream, but she was too small. She wanted to succeed in getting it. So, she got a chair to stand on. But the chair was too small too. Then, her big brother Tom came to help. Tom lifted Lily up high. Now, she could reach the ice-cream! Lily was happy. She succeeded in getting her ice-cream, and they both enjoyed their yummy treat.

One day, a lucky penguin named Pip went for a run. Pip was very fast. He liked to run in the cold snow. The sun was bright and the sky was blue. Pip saw his friend, a seal named Sam. Sam said, "Hi Pip! Let's run together!" Pip and Sam ran and played in the snow. They had lots of fun. After a while, they got tired. Pip and Sam sat down and looked at the sky. They were happy to be friends. It was a good day for a lucky penguin and his friend.

Once upon a time, there was a light blue train. This train loved to go fast and make steam. One day, the train was going very fast when it saw a broken toy car on the tracks. The train stopped and said, "Oh no, little car! You are broken. I will help repair you." The train worked hard to fix the toy car. When it was all done, the toy car said, "Thank you, train! I am happy now." But then, something unexpected happened. The toy car turned into a magic fairy! The fairy said, "Thank you for helping me, train. I was stuck as a toy car until someone repaired me. Now, I will give you a gift." The fairy waved her wand, and suddenly the train could fly! The train was so happy and thanked the fairy. From that day on, the train could go fast on the tracks and fly in the sky, making steam and sharing its gift with everyone it met.

Once upon a time, there was a tiny girl called Lucy. She was very excited because she was going to get a new pen! Her mum took her to the shop, and there were lots of different pens to choose from. Lucy smiled at all of the different colours and shapes on the shelves. "Which pen do you want Lucy?" her mum asked. "That one please!" said Lucy. She pointed to the bright yellow pen. When they got home, Lucy sat down on the floor. She had so much fun with her new pen. She used it to draw some pictures of her family and it made them all look so colourful and happy. She was so excited to have her new pen. She could use it to draw whatever she liked, and it made her feel very special. The end.

One day, a little girl named Lily was playing in her room. She had a toy phone that she liked to play with. She would pretend to call her friends and talk to them. Today, she was going to have a tea party with her stuffed animals. Lily set up the table with cups and plates. Just as Lily was about to pour some juice into the cups, she heard her toy phone ring. She picked it up and said, "Hello?" A scared voice on the other end said, "Hi, it's your friend, Teddy. I'm scared of the dark and I can't find my way home. Can you help me?" Lily knew she had to help her friend. She told Teddy, "Don't worry, I'll come find you!" She grabbed a flashlight and went outside. Lily searched and searched until she finally found Teddy hiding under a bush. He was so happy to see her. Lily brought Teddy back to her house and they had the best tea party ever. They drank juice and ate cookies, and Teddy was not scared anymore. From that day on, Lily and Teddy were the best of friends and they knew they could always count on each other.

Once upon a time, in a small garden, there was an unknown seed. No one knew what it was. One day, the sun came out and the rain fell. The seed started to grow. The little plant grew bigger and bigger. One day, it had a pretty bloom. The bloom was the color orange. The orange bloom made everyone happy. Soon, more orange blooms came. The garden was full of them. Everyone loved the unknown plant with the pretty orange blooms. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a small kid named Tim was playing in the park. He saw a big ball and wanted to play with it. But the ball belonged to another kid named Sam. Tim felt a little frightened to ask Sam if he could play with the ball. Tim walked up to Sam and said, "Can you lend me your ball, please?" Sam looked at Tim and said, "Yes, I will lend you my ball, but you have to promise to give it back when you are done." Tim was happy and promised to give the ball back. Tim and Sam played with the ball for a long time. They had a lot of fun. When they were done playing, Tim gave the ball back to Sam, just like he promised. They both learned that sharing and keeping promises are important. And from that day on, Tim and Sam became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a sweet lady. She lived in a small house. She had many friends. They all liked her because she was kind and nice. One day, the sweet lady found a broken toy. She wanted to help. So, she worked hard to restore the toy. She put all the pieces back together. The toy was happy and like new again. The sweet lady showed her friends the toy she restored. They were all very happy. They clapped and cheered for her. The sweet lady smiled, and they all played with the toy together.

Tim and Jen are twins who like to play in the park. One day, they see a big box under a tree. They wonder what is inside. Is it a toy? Is it a cake? Is it a mystery? They run to the box and try to open it. But the box is very heavy and hard. They pull and push, but the box does not move. They need something strong to open it. They look around and see a big stick. Tim picks up the stick and hits the box. The box makes a loud noise. Jen covers her ears. Tim hits the box again and again. The box breaks and reveals what is inside. Tim and Jen gasp. Inside the box are many books. Books with pictures and words. Books with stories and facts. Books with colors and shapes. Books for Tim and Jen to read and learn. Tim and Jen are happy. They hug each other and thank the tree. They take the books and sit under the tree. They open the books and start to read. They have found a mystery and a treasure.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot had a hurt leg. He had to wear a cone so he would not bite his leg. The cone was hard and he did not like it. One day, Spot met a cat named Whiskers. Whiskers saw the cone and asked, "Why do you wear that hard cone, Spot?" Spot said, "My leg is hurt. The cone helps me heal." Whiskers and Spot played together every day. They were very happy. Soon, Spot's leg healed and he did not need the cone anymore. Spot and Whiskers played without the hard cone and had lots of fun.

Zack was very patient as he waited for his turn on the swing. He watched as Lucy zoomed ahead of him. When he finally got to go, he pulled on the ropes and his feet flew off the ground. He was so happy! While he was flying in the air, he noticed something strange. His nose was starting to get ticklish. He tried to ignore it. He kept going higher and higher, until the feeling finally became too much. He jumped off the swing and rubbed his nose, only to realise what had happened - there was a bee on his nose! Zack jumped around and tried to shake it off, but the bee was stubborn. Zack was scared and started to cry. He had been so patient waiting for his turn on the swing, but he never got to go higher than the bee!

Once upon a time, there was a shy little plant named Pippin. Pippin lived in a big garden with many other plants. Pippin wanted to grow big and strong, but he was scared of the sun and the rain. One day, Pippin met a wise old plant named Gramps. Gramps said, "Pippin, you must face the sun and the rain to grow. Don't be scared." Pippin listened to Gramps and tried to be brave. Slowly, Pippin started to grow. But one day, Pippin saw a bottle of poison near the garden. Pippin was scared and didn't know what to do. He remembered Gramps' words and decided to tell the other plants. Together, they asked the gardener to take the poison away. The gardener listened and removed the poison. Pippin learned that it was important to be brave and to help others. He grew into a big, strong plant and made many friends in the garden. The other plants were proud of Pippin and they all lived happily together. The moral of the story is to be brave, even when you are scared, and to always help others when they need you.

Once upon a time, there was a little car named Cory. Cory liked to go fast all the time. One day, Cory felt his tire go flat. He was sad and did not know what to do. Cory's friend, Tim the Tow Truck, saw him and came to help. Tim told Cory to relax and not worry. Tim was ready to help Cory fix his flat tire. They worked together and soon Cory's tire was good as new. After that day, Cory learned to slow down and not go fast all the time. He knew that it was important to take care of himself and his tires. The moral of the story is that sometimes we need to relax and slow down to be safe and happy.

One day, a little boy named Tim was very miserable. He looked out the window and saw it was raining. He wanted to play outside, but he could not because of the rain. Tim's mom saw that he was sad. She said, "Do not worry, Tim. I have a surprise for you!" Tim looked at his mom and smiled. He knew that she always had fun surprises. Mom went to the room and came back with a video. She said, "This is a fun video for you to watch!" Tim was so happy. He watched the video and forgot all about the rain. The surprise made his day better, and he was not miserable anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a big elephant. The elephant liked to study. Every day, he would sit under a tree and look at his books. One day, the elephant found a tight hat. He put the hat on his head. It was very tight, but he liked it. He wore the hat while he studied. Then, something unexpected happened. The tight hat began to grow! The hat got bigger and bigger. The elephant was very happy. Now he had a big hat for his big head. He wore the big hat and studied happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a yellow bird named Tom. Tom loved to help his mom in the kitchen. One day, Tom's mom put on her apron and started to cook. Tom wanted to help, so he put on a tiny apron too. They were making a big, yummy cake. While they were cooking, something unexpected happened. A big wind blew the kitchen window open. The wind picked up Tom's tiny apron and carried it outside. Tom was sad because he loved his apron. But, he did not give up. He said, "Thank you, wind, for making this fun game!" Then, he ran outside to find his apron. Tom looked and looked for his tiny apron. He found it stuck in a tree. But, there was a surprise! A little squirrel was wearing the apron. The squirrel said, "Thank you for my new apron, Tom!" Tom laughed and said, "You can have it, squirrel. We can both help my mom and wear aprons together!" So, Tom and the squirrel went back to the kitchen to help Tom's mom finish the cake. They all had a fun day, and Tom made a new friend.

One day, a little white crab went for a walk on the beach. He wanted to meet new friends. As he walked, he saw a big fish swimming in the water. "Hi, big fish! Do you want to be my friend?" asked the crab. The big fish looked at the crab and said, "Yes, little crab, I will be your friend. But you must come into the water to play with me." The little white crab was scared, but he wanted a friend. So, he went into the water to play with the big fish. They played and had fun, but then the big fish got hungry. "I'm sorry, little crab," said the big fish, "but I am very hungry, and I must eat you." The little white crab was very sad, but he could not escape. The big fish ate the little crab, and the crab was gone. The moral of the story is: be careful who you trust, not everyone wants to be a good friend.

Anna and Ben like to play hockey with their friends. They have sticks and a ball and two goals. They wear orange shirts and helmets. They have fun and try to score. One day, a new boy comes to play with them. His name is Max. He has a big stick and a blue shirt. He says he is very good at hockey. He wants to play with Anna and Ben. "Can I join your team?" he asks. "Sure, you can," Anna says. "We are the orange team. You can wear this orange helmet." "No, I don't want to wear orange. I like blue. Blue is better," Max says. He frowns and crosses his arms. "But we are the orange team. We have to wear the same color," Ben says. "I don't care. I want to wear blue. And I want to score all the goals. You have to pass me the ball," Max says. He frowns more and stamps his feet. Anna and Ben look at each other. They don't like Max. He is not nice. He is not fun. He is bossy and rude. "Sorry, Max. You can't play with us. You don't follow the rules. You don't share. You don't smile. You only frown. You are not a good friend," Anna says. "Yeah, Max. You can't play with us. You can play by yourself. Or you can find another team. But not the orange team. We don't want you," Ben says. Anna and Ben turn away from Max. They take their sticks and their ball and their helmets. They go to play with their other friends. They have fun and try to score. They smile and laugh. They are happy. They are the orange team.

Once upon a time, there was a big hole in the ground. Many animals lived near the hole. One day, a little rabbit named Remy found the hole. It was difficult for Remy to see what was inside the hole. Remy asked his friend, a bird named Betty, "What is in the hole?" Betty replied, "I don't know, Remy. But we can supply food and water to the hole, maybe someone needs help." So Remy and Betty supplied food and water to the hole every day. One day, they heard a tiny voice from the hole. It was a baby squirrel named Sammy. Sammy said, "Thank you for the food and water. I was lost and scared in the hole." Remy and Betty helped Sammy get out of the hole. They became good friends and played together every day. The animals learned that helping others, even when it is difficult, can bring happiness and new friends.

One day, a happy boy named Tim went to the beach with his mom. Tim loved the beach because he could play in the sand and swim in the water. His mom said, "Tim, I will show you something new today!" They walked to the water and Tim saw a jellyfish. It was big and pretty, with many colors. Tim wanted to touch it, but his mom said, "No, jellyfish can hurt you. We can look, but we cannot touch." Tim was sad, but he listened to his mom. They went to play in the sand and build a big sand castle. They were very happy. But then, something unexpected happened. The jellyfish came out of the water and went into their sand castle! Tim and his mom were scared. They ran away from the beach and went home. The jellyfish had taken over their sand castle, and they could not play there anymore. The day at the beach was not so happy after all.

Once upon a time, in a small house, lived a thoughtful girl named Lucy. She had a big toy bear called Mr. Bear. They played together every day. They liked to play with blocks and draw with crayons. One night, there was loud thunder outside. Lucy was scared and began to weep. She hugged Mr. Bear very tight. Mr. Bear wanted to help Lucy not be scared. Mr. Bear had an idea. He told Lucy to think of a happy place. Lucy thought of the park, with swings and slides. The more she thought of the park, the less scared she was. The thunder went away, and Lucy stopped weeping. Lucy and Mr. Bear went back to playing and had a fun night.

Once upon a time, there was an intelligent dog named Spot. Spot liked to help people. He was a very good dog. One day, Spot saw a little girl named Sue. Sue was sad because she lost her safe. The safe held all her toys. Spot wanted to help Sue find her safe. Spot had an idea. He found a rope and attached it to the safe. He pulled the safe all the way to Sue. Sue was very happy. She hugged Spot and thanked him. They became best friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lucy. She was walking in the garden and she saw a purple tree. She was very excited and ran up to it. She shook the tree, and a lovely purple fruit came tumbling down! It looked so tasty. Lucy picked it up, brushed off the dirt and took a big bite. It was so yummy! She ate the whole fruit and it made her feel so happy and full. She said thank you to the tree and thanked the sky too. Then she shook the tree again, and another purple fruit fell down. She knew it was going to be just as delicious!

Once upon a time, there was a playful little girl. She had a big, soft blanket that she always carried around with her. One day, she went to the park with her blanket. While playing in the park, she noticed a kind old man. She looked at him, smiled and nodded. The old man smiled back and nodded too. The old man then asked the little girl if he could borrow her blanket. She thought about it for a moment and then nodded her head. The old man took the blanket and ran away. The little girl chased after him, but he was too fast. The old man kept running until he disappeared. The little girl was sad. She never got her blanket back. She stood there, in the park, without her blanket and without her smile.

Once upon a time, there was a busy crocodile. The crocodile liked to supply food to his friends. He was always helping them. One day, the crocodile went to the river to catch fish for his friends. He saw a big fish and tried to catch it. But the fish was too fast. The crocodile tried again and again, but he could not catch the big fish. Then, something unexpected happened. The big fish stopped and looked at the crocodile. The fish said, "I am not a fish, I am a magic fish! I can give you a wish if you let me go." The crocodile was surprised and happy. He let the magic fish go and wished for lots of food for his friends. The magic fish made the wish come true, and the crocodile and his friends had a big feast.

Once upon a time, in an ordinary little town, there was a big mountain. Many people liked to go to the mountain to play and have fun. One sunny day, a little boy named Tim and his dog, Spot, decided to go to the mountain too. Tim and Spot walked and walked until they got to the mountain. They saw a big tree and decided to sit under it. Tim said, "Let's get some rest, Spot." They both sat down and looked at the pretty flowers and birds. After a while, Tim and Spot got up and played on the mountain. They ran, jumped, and laughed. They had a lot of fun. When the sun started to go down, Tim said, "It's time to go home, Spot." They walked back home, tired but happy from their fun day on the ordinary mountain.

Once upon a time, there was a very nice goat. The goat was attractive and had a big smile. The goat lived on a farm with many friends like cows, pigs, and chickens. One day, the goat wanted to take a walk. The goat walked and walked, and saw many beautiful things. The goat saw a big tree, pretty flowers, and a shiny pond. Then, the goat met a kind duck. The duck and the goat played together. They had so much fun! After playing, the goat took the duck to the farm. The duck and the goat were very happy and became best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a modern house. In the house, there was a big box. A girl named Lily wanted to unpack the box. Lily was very excited to see what was inside. As Lily opened the box, she saw a small, cute wolf. The wolf was not scary. It was nice and wanted to play. Lily and the wolf played all day. They had lots of fun together. One day, the wolf found a magic hat. When the wolf put on the hat, it changed. The wolf turned into a big, fluffy dog. Lily was surprised but happy. Now, Lily and her new dog played together every day.

One day, a big, wild monkey named Bobo went to the park. He was very hungry. He looked around and saw a yellow banana in a tree. Bobo was very happy and climbed the tree to get the banana. When Bobo arrived at the top, he saw a little girl named Lily. She was also trying to get the banana. Bobo and Lily looked at each other. Bobo said, "I want the banana!" Lily said, "I want it too!" Just then, a big wind came and blew the banana away. Bobo and Lily were sad. But they decided to be friends and look for more bananas together. As they walked, they found a big box full of bananas! They were very happy and shared the bananas with each other.

Lily and Ben are playing with their toys in the garden. Lily has a doll and Ben has a car. They are having fun, but they are also very messy. They leave their toys everywhere on the grass. "Look, Lily, my car can go very fast!" Ben says, making zooming noises. "That's nice, Ben, but my doll can talk!" Lily says, pressing a button on the doll's back. Suddenly, they hear a loud bark. It is their dog, Rex, who has come to join them. Rex is a big, brown dog with a long, fluffy tail. He likes to play with Lily and Ben, but he also likes to chase their toys. "Rex, no!" Lily shouts, as Rex runs towards her doll. "That's my doll, not your toy!" But Rex does not listen. He grabs the doll with his mouth and shakes it. The doll makes a funny sound and its hair falls off. "Hey, stop that!" Ben yells, as Rex drops the doll and goes for his car. "That's my car, not your chew!" But Rex does not care. He bites the car and breaks one of its wheels. The car makes a sad noise and stops moving. Lily and Ben are very upset. They run to their toys and try to fix them. But they are too broken. They look at Rex, who is wagging his tail and panting. He thinks he has done a good job. "Bad dog, Rex!" Lily and Ben say. "You ruined our toys! You are not useful at all!" Rex does not understand. He thinks they are playing with him. He licks their faces and wags his tail more. "Go away, Rex!" Lily and Ben say. "We don't want to play with you!" Rex feels sad. He lowers his ears and walks away. He finds a stick and tries to play with it. But it is not fun. He misses Lily and Ben. He looks at them from a distance. He sees that they are still sad. He wants to make them happy. He thinks of a way to do that. He picks up the stick with his mouth and runs to them. He drops the stick in front of them and barks. "Look, Lily, Ben, I found a stick!" he seems to say. "You can play with it! It is not broken! It is useful!" Lily and Ben look at the stick. They look at Rex. They see that he is trying to be nice. They feel sorry for him. "Thank you, Rex," Lily says, picking up the stick. "That's very kind of you." "Yes, thank you, Rex," Ben says, smiling. "You are useful after all." They pat Rex on the head and scratch his ears. They throw the stick and Rex fetches it. They play with him and the stick. They forget about their broken toys. They are happy again. Rex is happy too. He wags his tail and barks. He loves Lily and Ben. He reminds them that he is their friend.

Once upon a time, there was a big park. In the park, there was a small, pale dog named Spot. Spot liked to play in the park every day. One day, Spot saw a big door. The door was shut. Spot was very curious about what was behind the door. Every day, Spot would go to the shut door and try to open it. He would push and pull, but the door would not open. Spot's friends in the park would ask him, "Why do you want to open the door?" Spot would say, "I want to see what is behind it." One sunny day, Spot went to the door and it was open! He was so happy. Spot went inside and saw a big, beautiful garden. There were lots of flowers and trees. Spot played in the garden all day long. When it was time to go home, Spot shut the door so he could come back and play in the secret garden again. And from that day on, Spot and his friends had a special place to play and be happy.

One day, a girl named Sue went to the kitchen. She saw a big refrigerator. It was thick and white. Sue wanted to find something to eat. She opened the refrigerator door. Inside the refrigerator, Sue found a cake. The cake was thick and yummy. Sue was happy. She took the cake out and started to sing. She sang a happy song. But Sue did not know that the cake was not good. She ate the cake and got a tummy ache. Sue felt very bad. She cried and went to bed. The day did not end well for Sue.

One day, a bald man went to the beach. He saw a big jellyfish in the water. The bald man wanted to measure the jellyfish. He thought it was the biggest jellyfish he had ever seen! The bald man tried to get close to the jellyfish, but it swam away. He felt sad. He really wanted to measure the jellyfish. Then, he saw a little girl with a net. She wanted to help the bald man catch the jellyfish. They chased the jellyfish together. Just when they were about to catch it, the jellyfish changed. It was not a jellyfish at all! It was a big, funny hat. The bald man laughed and put the hat on his head. Now, he was not bald anymore. The man and the little girl were happy and played on the beach all day.

Once upon a time there was a little dog. He was very fast and liked to run around. One day, he passed a big tree to the left of him. He ran really really fast and left the big tree far behind. He kept running and he passed a house, a fence and lots and lots of grass. He ran faster and faster and he left everything from before far away. Eventually, he passed a river and stopped to take a little rest. He panting and happy, he looked back and smiled to see everything he had passed.

Once upon a time, in a cheerful forest, there lived a little bird with a big wing. The bird loved to fly high in the sky and play with his friends. Every day, they would race each other and have so much fun. One day, a big wind came and blew the little bird far away from his friends. The bird was sad and wanted to go back home. He tried to fly, but the wind was too strong. The little bird knew he needed help. The little bird saw a big tree and decided to surrender to the wind. He held onto the tree with his big wing and waited for the wind to stop. When the wind stopped, the little bird flew back to his friends in the cheerful forest. They were so happy to see him again, and they continued to play and have fun every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to play with his ball. One day, he was playing in the kitchen. He saw the big refrigerator. Tim was glad because he liked to look inside it. Tim decided to roll his ball near the refrigerator. But, the ball went under it. He could not get it. He was sad. Tim asked his mom for help. She came and moved the refrigerator. Tim got his ball back. He was very glad. Mom told Tim not to play near the refrigerator. It could be dangerous. Tim learned to be careful where he played. He was a good boy. The moral of the story is to always listen to your mom and dad. They know what is best for you.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a ticket on the floor. He was so happy. He showed the ticket to his mom. His mom said, "We can go to the big park with this ticket!" Tim was very excited. At the big park, Tim saw a big, red ball. He wanted to play with it. He tried to pick it up, but it was too big. So, Tim gave the ball a big squeeze. The ball made a funny noise. Tim was very surprised. Suddenly, the ball turned into a big, red cat. The cat was tired. It yawned and stretched. Tim and his mom laughed. They did not know the ball was a cat. They played with the cat all day. Then, they went home, tired and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little toy car. It loved to zoom around the room all day. The car had a best friend, a small toy bear. They played together every day and had lots of fun. One day, the toy car started to go slow. It could not zoom around the room anymore. The toy bear was sad. They found out that the car's battery was low. They needed to find a new battery to make the car go fast again. The brave little toy car and the bear went on a big adventure to find a new battery. They looked under the bed and behind the door. But the battery seemed to disappear. They did not give up. Finally, they found a new battery in a box. They put the battery in the car, and it started to zoom around the room again. The toy car and the bear were very happy and played together every day.

Once there was a family who lived in a cabin in the woods. Every day, there was something to celebrate. But one day, all that changed. The family was feeling guilty. They had made a big mess and it had caused a lot of worry and sadness. They felt bad that they had made a mistake. The family decided they needed to make it right. They all worked together to clean up the mess and apologize to everyone they had hurt. Everyone felt relieved and glad that the family had fixed things! The family had a special celebration that night. They gathered in their cabin to give each other hugs and eat cake. They laughed like never before. They were happy that they had worked together to fix things and show how sorry they were. The family was happy and proud that they had made things right. From then on, they always remembered to celebrate each day and never forget how guilty they had felt that day.

Once upon a time, in a normal forest, there was a little mushroom. The mushroom was happy and liked to play with the other plants. One day, a big tree wanted to grow where the mushroom was. The tree said, "Move, little mushroom, I want to grow here." The mushroom did not want to yield. It said, "No, I was here first. I want to stay and play with my friends." The tree was not happy. It wanted to grow big and strong but could not with the mushroom in its way. The tree got angry and started to grow anyway. The mushroom tried to hold on, but it was not strong enough. The tree grew bigger and bigger, and the mushroom got hurt. The other plants were sad. The tree did not care. It was big and strong now, but the little mushroom was gone.

One day, a curious little girl named Lily found a big mirror in her room. She looked at herself and smiled. She saw her mom's weighing scale next to the mirror. Lily stood on the scale and saw the numbers go up. She did not know what it meant, but she thought it was fun. Lily's mom came into the room and saw Lily on the scale. "Lily, what are you doing?" she asked. "I am playing with this thing," Lily said, pointing at the scale. "That is for weighing," her mom said. "It tells us how much we weigh." Lily wanted to know how much her teddy bear weighed, too. She put her teddy bear on the scale, but her teddy bear was too light. The numbers did not move. Lily was sad. Her mom saw this and had an idea. "Let's put the teddy bear on the scale with you," her mom said. They put the teddy bear on the scale with Lily, and the numbers went up. Lily was happy. She learned something new and had fun with her mom and teddy bear.

One day, a pretty girl named Lily went to the park. She loved to play with her friends. They played on the swings, the slide, and the seesaw. Lily was very happy. While playing, Lily saw a boy she did not know. The boy was being mean to her friends. Lily felt embarrassed because she did not like mean people. She wanted to help her friends, but she did not know what to do. Lily's mom saw her and gave her a wink. This made Lily feel brave. She went to the boy and told him to be nice. The boy stopped being mean and said sorry. Lily and her friends were happy again. They all played together and had a great day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a faucet. This faucet was very reliable. It always had water. The faucet was in a big park. Many kids and moms and dads came to the park. They loved to have fun there. One day, a little boy came to the faucet. He wanted to have water. But something unexpected happened. The faucet did not have water! The little boy was sad. He did not know what to do. Then, a kind squirrel came to the little boy. The squirrel showed the boy another faucet. This faucet had water! The little boy was happy. He had water from the new faucet. The squirrel and the little boy became good friends. They played and had fun in the park together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was not normal. He could become a spirit. When he was a spirit, he could fly and go through walls. One day, Tim met a girl named Sue. Sue saw Tim become a spirit and said, "Wow, you can fly! Can you teach me how to do that?" Tim tried to teach Sue, but she could not become a spirit. Sue was sad and said, "I wish I could be like you." Tim wanted to help Sue feel better. He thought, "If I can become a spirit, maybe I can help Sue become one too." So, Tim and Sue went on a journey to find a way for Sue to become a spirit. They met a wise old man who told them, "To become a spirit, you must be kind and brave." Sue and Tim worked together to be kind and brave. They helped people and animals in need. One day, Sue became a spirit too! Sue and Tim were happy. They could now fly and go through walls together. And they lived happily ever after.

One day, a girl named Lily went to the park. She saw a weird bird. The bird could talk! The bird said, "Hi! I can sing with a rhythm. Do you want to hear it?" Lily said, "Yes, please!" The bird started to sing. It sang with a rhythm that made Lily want to dance. She danced and danced. The bird seemed very happy to make Lily dance. They both had lots of fun. After a while, the bird said, "I have to go now. I hope you liked my song." Lily said, "I did! Thank you!" The bird flew away, and Lily went home. She told her mom about the weird bird that could sing with a rhythm. Her mom smiled and said, "That sounds like a fun day!"

Once upon a time, there was a jolly little boy named Tim. He loved to climb trees and play outside. One day, he saw a big tree with a fun swing. Tim knew he wanted to climb the tree and sit on the swing. Tim put on his favorite pants and went outside. He started to climb the tree. It was a little hard, but he kept going. He was almost at the top when he heard a "rip" sound. Oh no! His pants got caught on a branch and ripped! Tim was sad, but he did not give up. He climbed all the way to the top and sat on the swing. He swung back and forth, feeling happy again. When he went home, his mom fixed his pants. Tim learned that even when things go wrong, he can still have fun and be jolly.

Once there was a big bear who lived in a big cave. Everyday, he would come out and go for a walk in the woods with his big cane. One day, he saw a small rabbit. The bear smiled and said, “Hey, little rabbit! I’m the big bear. What are you doing?” The little rabbit said, “I’m so scared! I don’t know what to do.” The big bear said, “Don’t worry. I won’t hurt you, I promise. Come closer so I can give you a kiss.” The little rabbit hopped closer and the big bear gave it a big kiss on the head. The little rabbit smiled and said, “Thank you, big bear. That was nice.” Then it hopped away, feeling safer and happier. The bear grinned and went back to his cave with his big cane.

Theo and his mum were walking in the forest. Suddenly, they spotted something shiny. As they got closer, they saw it was a tiny box. Theo's mum smiled. "This looks like special stuff!" she said. Theo was curious. He wanted to open the box. But his mum said, "No, Theo. You must not open it. It could be powerful stuff!" Theo didn't want to wait, so he decided to open the box. His mum said, "No, Theo!" But it was too late. He opened it and a big cloud of smoke flew out. Theo and his mum were so scared. "Oh no!" they both said. Suddenly, the smoke started to change shape. It became a big, scary monster! The monster roared and started chasing them. Theo and his mum ran as fast as they could, but they couldn't escape. The monster caught them and swallowed them whole. Theo and his mum decided to never open a strange box again. Unfortunately, it was too late.

Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim had a huge balloon. It was red and very big. He loved his balloon very much. He played with it all day long. He threw it up in the air and caught it again. One day, Tim was playing with his balloon outside. The wind was very strong. The wind blew his balloon away. Tim was very sad. He tried to catch the balloon, but it was too far away. Tim asked his dad to help him fix the problem. They went to the store to look for another balloon. But they could not find a huge red balloon like the one Tim lost. Tim was still sad. He missed his huge red balloon very much.

One day, a little bunny named Bob went out to play. He saw a big hole in the ground. Bob thought it was a regular hole, but it was not. It was an underground home for a little bug. The little bug saw Bob and shrugged. The little bug did not want to play with Bob, but Bob wanted to play with the little bug. Bob went to find his friend, Cat. "I found a hole with a little bug," Bob told Cat. "I want to play with the little bug, but the bug shrugged and did not want to play with me." Cat said, "Let's go see the hole and the little bug, maybe the little bug will want to play with us this time." Bob and Cat went back to the hole. They saw the little bug again. This time, the little bug did not shrug. The little bug wanted to play with Bob and Cat. They played all day and had a lot of fun. The little bug was not a regular bug, but a magic bug. The magic bug could make toys and games for them to play with. Bob, Cat, and the magic bug became best friends and played together every day.

One day, a little girl named Lily wanted to decorate her room. She had a silly idea. She thought, "I will use chocolate to make my room pretty!" So, she went to the kitchen and took a big box of chocolate. Lily started to put chocolate on the walls. Her mommy came in and saw the mess. She said, "Lily, what are you doing?" Lily said, "I am making my room pretty with chocolate!" Mommy laughed and said, "That's a silly idea, Lily. Chocolate is for eating, not for decorating. Let's clean up and find something else to use." They cleaned up the chocolate and decorated the room with pretty stickers. Lily learned that chocolate is yummy to eat, but not good for decorating.

Once, there was a long cat named Tom. Tom had a sweater that he loved very much. He wore the sweater every day. Tom liked to serve his friends food and have fun with them. One day, Tom saw a big box. He thought it would be fun to hide in the box and surprise his friends. He put on his sweater and went inside the box. He waited for a long time. Soon, Tom's friends came to look for him. They saw the box and thought it was a gift for them. They opened the box and found Tom. They were so happy and laughed. Tom served them food and they all had a great time.

One day, a boy named Tim was playing with his toy jeep. He loved his jeep so much. He drove it around the room all day. His friend, Sam, came over to play. Sam wanted to play with the jeep too, but Tim insisted that it was his turn. Sam was confused. He asked Tim, "Can I play with the jeep too?" Tim thought for a moment and said, "Okay, we can take turns." They drove the jeep around the room, laughing and having fun. Suddenly, the jeep started to move on its own! Tim and Sam were very surprised. The jeep drove up the wall and onto the ceiling. They looked at each other, amazed. They didn't know that the jeep had magic powers. From that day on, they played with the magic jeep together and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a helpful girl named Sue. She liked to look for things to do. One day, she found a big bell in the park. Sue wanted to show the bell to her friend, Tom. She said, "Tom, look at this big bell I found!" Tom looked at the bell and said, "Wow, that is a big bell!" They tried to move the bell but it was too heavy. Sue and Tom asked other kids to help, but nobody could move it. The bell stayed in the park and nobody could play with it. Sue and Tom were sad.

Once upon a time, there was a poor reindeer. He wanted to soar like the other reindeer, but he couldn't because he wasn't strong enough. All of the other animals in the forest, from the birds to the bunnies, giggled at him whenever he tried to fly. One day, the reindeer made a wish to fly like the others. That night, a magical thing happened. A star shone in the sky, and the reindeer looked up and suddenly felt different. He flapped his wings and off he went, soaring higher and higher! He flew over trees and hills, feeling free and happy. He even flew with some of the other reindeer and they became friends. The reindeer was so happy he could soar like the others. The reindeer finally landed and looked up at the night sky. All of the stars were twinkling and he smiled. He had seen all the magical places because now he could finally soar like he had always wanted.

Once upon a time, there was an ancient sign. It was so old, nobody knew what it said. A 3 year old child was looking at it and was very curious to know what the sign said. He asked a few people but no one knew. The little boy was so confused and worried. He went to his dad and told him what he saw. His dad smiled at him and said: "You will never know until you try and find out". The little boy was determined to figure out what the sign said, so he started doing research. After a lot of hard work, he found out that the sign said "Never give up". The story of the sign, made the little boy so happy. He understood the meaning of the sign and he learned a valuable lesson. If he want to learn something, he must never give up. Even when the answer is not easy to find, if he persists, he will eventually succeed.

Once upon a time, there was a fat cat named Tom. Tom loved to test new paths in the big park. One sunny day, he went for a walk to find a new path. As Tom walked, he saw a big, red ball. He wanted to play with it. But when he got close, the ball started to roll away. Tom was surprised and chased the ball down the path. At the end of the path, Tom found a new friend, a little girl named Sue. She was the one moving the ball! Sue and Tom played with the ball and had a lot of fun. From that day on, Tom and Sue were best friends, and they tested many new paths together.

Once upon a time, there was a quiet parrot. The parrot lived in a big tree. The tree was in a nice park. One day, a little girl came to the park. She saw the quiet parrot. The girl said, "Hello, parrot!" The parrot said, "Hello!" back to the girl. They liked each other. The girl asked the parrot, "Do you want to sit with me?" The parrot said, "Yes!" So, they sat on a bench. They talked and laughed. They were happy friends.

One day, a big cat and a small dog were playing in the park. The big cat said, "I am the boss. I order you to stand on your head!" The small dog tried to stand on his head, but he fell down. The big cat laughed at the small dog. The small dog was jealous of the big cat. He wanted to be the boss too. He thought, "I must find a way to be the boss." So, the small dog told the big cat, "Let's play a new game. Whoever can jump the highest is the boss." The big cat agreed. They both jumped as high as they could. But then, something unexpected happened! A big bird flew down and picked up the small dog. The big bird carried the small dog high up in the sky. The big cat was shocked! The small dog was now the boss because he was the highest. The big cat was jealous, but they both learned that anyone can be the boss.

One day, a boy named Tom went to the park with his mom. They were having fun when Tom saw a hidden toy under a tree. He picked it up and showed it to his mom. "Look, Mom! I found a toy!" he said. His mom smiled and said, "That's nice, Tom. But we should try to find the owner." Tom and his mom looked around, but they couldn't find anyone who lost a toy. They decided to go home and think about what to do next. While they were walking, Tom saw a movie poster on a wall. It had a picture of the same toy he found! He got very excited and said, "Mom, look! The toy is in a movie!" His mom looked at the poster and said, "You're right, Tom. Let's go watch the movie and maybe we can find the owner there." They went to the movie theater and watched the movie. But something unexpected happened. The toy in the movie was a bad toy that made everyone sad. When the movie ended, Tom didn't want the toy anymore. He thought it was bad because it made people sad. So, he left the toy in the theater and went home with his mom. The toy stayed hidden in the theater, never to be found again.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a new band. The band had a big red car. They liked to play fun songs for all the kids. One day, they were driving to a show. They saw a little girl named Lily. Lily was sad. She lost her toy. The band wanted to help. They said, "Don't be sad, Lily. We will help you find your toy." They all looked around. They found the toy behind a tree. Lily was happy. The band got in the big red car. They needed to go to the show. The driver said, "Oops! I need to reverse the car." They went back a little, then drove to the show. They played fun songs for all the kids, and everyone was happy.

Lily and Tom are twins. They like to travel with their mom and dad. They have a big bag with toys and books. They go to the airport to fly in a plane. "Mom, where are we going?" Lily asks. "We are going to visit grandma and grandpa. They live far away, but we will see them soon." Mom says. "Will they have cookies for us?" Tom asks. "Yes, they will. They love you very much and they are happy to see you." Dad says. Lily and Tom are excited. They have never flown in a plane before. They see many people and machines at the airport. They follow mom and dad to a gate. They show their tickets to a lady. She smiles and says, "Have a nice trip!" They board the plane. They find their seats and buckle their belts. They look out the window and see the wings and the clouds. They hear the engine roar and feel the plane move. "Are we flying?" Lily asks. "Yes, we are. We are going up in the sky." Dad says. "Is it safe?" Tom asks. "Yes, it is. The pilot knows how to fly the plane. He will take us to grandma and grandpa's house." Mom says. Lily and Tom relax. They play with their toys and read their books. They listen to the music and watch the movies. They eat some snacks and drink some juice. They nap for a while and dream of cookies. They wake up and see the sun setting. They hear the pilot say, "We are almost there. Please prepare for landing." They look out the window and see the lights and the trees. They feel the plane go down and touch the ground. They hear the people clap and cheer. They get off the plane and walk to the baggage claim. They see their big bag and grab it. They look around and see two familiar faces. "Grandma! Grandpa!" Lily and Tom shout. They run to them and hug them. Grandma and grandpa hug them back. "Welcome, welcome! We are so happy to see you!" Grandma says. "We missed you so much! How was your trip?" Grandpa says. "It was fun! We flew in a plane!" Lily says. "It was safe! The pilot was good!" Tom says. They smile and laugh. They travel to grandma and grandpa's house. They have cookies and milk. They tell stories and play games. They have a wonderful time. They love to travel with their mom and dad.

Once upon a time, there was a small insect. It was looking for food. It wanted something yummy to eat. But there was not much food available. One day, the insect found a big bird. The bird said, "Trust me, I will help you find food." The insect was happy and trusted the bird. The bird took the insect to a place with lots of food. The insect was very excited. But then, the bird ate the insect. The insect should not have trusted the bird. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a gray cat named Tom. Tom loved to play in the garden. One day, while he was playing, he saw a big squash. Tom wanted to grab the squash, but it was too big for him. He tried and tried, but he could not pick it up. Tom was sad. He wanted to show the squash to his friend, Sam the dog. Sam saw Tom and asked, "What's wrong, Tom?" Tom said, "I want to grab this squash, but it's too big." Sam smiled and said, "Let me help you." They both grabbed the squash together and carried it home. Tom and Sam were very happy and played with the squash all day.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a wise old owl named Wisdom. He was very kind and liked to help others. One day, a little bird named Chirpy came to the house. Chirpy was very loud and liked to sing all day long. Chirpy said to Wisdom, "I promise to be quiet if you help me find my way home." Wisdom thought for a moment and then agreed. They started their journey to find Chirpy's home. Along the way, they met other animals who warned them about a big, scary monster who lived in the woods. As they walked, Wisdom and Chirpy heard a loud noise. They were scared, but they kept going. Suddenly, the big, scary monster appeared! Chirpy was so frightened that he forgot his promise and began to sing very loudly. But then, something unexpected happened. The monster started to dance to Chirpy's loud song! The monster wasn't scary after all; he just wanted to dance and have fun. Chirpy and Wisdom laughed and danced with the monster. In the end, they all became good friends and helped Chirpy find his way home.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a dog named Max. Max had a hurt leg. He could not play with his friends. He would watch them and wonder when he could play too. One day, a selfish cat named Luna came to Max's house. She saw Max's hurt leg and laughed. Luna played with Max's toys, but she did not share with Max. This made Max very sad. The next day, Max's leg felt better. He was happy and wanted to play with Luna. But something unexpected happened. Luna had a hurt leg now! Max was not selfish like Luna. He shared his toys with her, and they played together. In the end, Luna learned not to be selfish, but she still had a hurt leg.

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful leopard. The leopard lived in a big forest. He had many friends. One day, the leopard met a little bird. "Hello, bird," said the leopard. "Do you want to play with me?" "Yes, I want to play," said the bird. "But first, let's watch the sun go down." So they sat on a big rock and watched the sun go down. The sky was full of pretty colors. The leopard and the bird were very happy. The next day, the leopard and the bird played all day long. They ran and jumped and laughed. They were the best of friends. And every day after that, they watched the sun go down together.

One day, a girl named Mia went for a walk in the fog. She wanted to find something fun to play with. Mia saw a big box and it said "include fun things inside". She was very happy and opened the box. Inside the box, Mia found a spicy pepper, a ball, and a book. She thought the spicy pepper was a toy, so she took a bite. Her mouth was very hot! Mia did not know what to do. She ran to find some water to drink. As Mia was drinking the water, the fog started to go away. She saw a magic cat standing there. The cat said, "I made a mistake. I put the spicy pepper in the box by accident." The cat waved its tail and the spicy feeling went away. Mia and the magic cat played with the ball and read the book together. They had a great day and became good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish. The fish lived in a big pond with his family. He liked to swim and play with his friends all day long. One day, the fish saw an elderly turtle. The turtle was slow and kind. The fish wanted to be friends with the turtle. So, the fish went to the turtle and said, "Hello! I want to be your friend." But the fish did not know that the turtle was shy. When the fish talked to the turtle, the turtle felt embarrass. The turtle turned red and hid in his shell. The fish felt sad and swam away. Later, the fish tried again. This time, the fish brought a gift for the turtle. The turtle saw the gift and felt happy. The turtle came out of his shell and said, "Thank you, fish. I want to be your friend too." From that day on, the fish and the elderly turtle were best friends. They swam and played together in the big pond. And they were never embarrass again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. He had a favorite jacket that he wore every day. One day, he played so much that he felt dizzy. Tom spun around and around until he fell down on the soft grass. Tom's jacket got dirty from playing so much. His mom saw the dirty jacket and said, "Tom, we need to replace your jacket with a clean one." Tom was sad because he loved his jacket, but he knew his mom was right. The next day, Tom's mom took him to the store. They found a new jacket just like his old one. Tom put on the new jacket and felt happy again. Now, he could play and spin around without feeling dizzy or having a dirty jacket. And Tom and his new jacket lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there were two little pigs. They were best friends. One day, the two little pigs went out to the market to buy some food. They came across a nice beef stand. "Let's try some of that beef!" said the first pig. "Yeah! Okay!" said the second pig. The lady at the stand was very polite. She smiled when she saw them and asked, "would you like to try some beef?" The two little pigs said yes, and she offered them a sample. They tried it and it was delicious! The first pig looked at the second pig and said, "Do you think we should guess how much beef we need to buy?" The second pig nodded and smiled. They guessed how much beef they needed and thanked the lady at the stand. She gave them the beef, and they waved goodbye. The two little pigs were very happy. They had enough beef to last them a while, and they were grateful that the lady at the stand had been so polite. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty hammer. Everywhere it went it made things better. One day the hammer stood perfectly still and shone in the sun. It was so still that nothing could move it. But then, a small child came along. The little one had an idea. He used all of his might, and pushed the hammer. It wavered, then it moved! The mighty hammer stood again. The little child smiled and hugged it. Then he took the hammer home. From then on the hammer stood in the corner, watching the little one as he played. The hammer was very proud.

Once upon a time, there was a peaceful park. In the park, there was a big tree. Under the tree, a little old man sat. The old man had a cane. He liked to sit and watch the kids play. One day, a little girl named Sue went to the park. She saw the old man with his cane. Sue walked up to him and said, "Hi!" The old man smiled and said, "Hello!" They meet and became friends. Sue and the old man talked and laughed. They looked at the pretty flowers and the blue sky. They had fun at the peaceful park. They would meet under the tree every day. Sue and the old man were very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a brown dog and a brown cat. They lived in a house with a painter. The painter liked to paint pretty pictures. The dog and the cat liked to watch the painter paint. One day, the dog and the cat had a quarrel. The dog wanted to play, but the cat wanted to sleep. They made a lot of noise. The painter could not paint because of the noise. The painter was sad. The dog and the cat saw the painter was sad. They decided to stop their quarrel. They became friends again. The painter was happy and started to paint again. The brown dog and the brown cat watched the painter paint and they all lived happily together.

One day, a boy named Tim wanted to attach a big red ball to his bike. He thought it would be easy and fun to do. He asked his friend, Sam, to help him. Sam said, "Yes, let's do it!" Tim and Sam worked together to attach the ball to the bike. They tied it with a strong rope. Tim was very happy and excited. He said, "Now, we can ride with speed and have more fun!" They both got on their bikes and started to ride very fast. The big red ball was bouncing behind Tim's bike. They laughed and enjoyed the speed. But suddenly, the ball got stuck in a tree. Tim's bike stopped very fast. Sam looked at Tim and said, "Oh no, what do we do now?" Tim thought for a moment and said, "Let's get the ball out of the tree." They both worked together to free the ball. Finally, they got the ball out and continued to ride their bikes with the big red ball attached. From that day on, Tim and Sam always had fun riding their bikes with the big red ball. They learned that even when things don't go as planned, they can still work together and have fun.

Once, a person named Tom lived in a small house. One day, a cat came to his door. Tom let the cat enter his house. The cat was very happy. Tom gave the cat some food. The cat ate the food and felt grateful. The cat liked Tom and wanted to stay with him. Tom liked the cat too. Tom and the cat played together every day. They had a lot of fun. The cat was happy to have a friend like Tom. Tom was also happy to have the cat. They were best friends forever.

Once upon a time, there was a very excited cat named Fluffy. Fluffy loved to stretch her legs and play all day long. Her favorite thing to do was chase the pretty patterns that the sun made on the floor. One day, Fluffy saw a new pattern on the floor. It was a big, round circle. Fluffy got very excited and started to stretch her legs to get ready to play. She jumped on the circle and tried to catch it, but it moved away! Fluffy chased the circle all around the room, stretching and jumping as she went. She was having so much fun! In the end, the circle went away, and Fluffy was tired but happy. She had a great day playing with the new pattern.

Once upon a time, in a big house, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to drink milk every day. One day, her mommy brought home an enormous bottle of milk for her. Lily was very happy and excited. Lily wanted to split the milk into two cups, one for her and one for her teddy bear. She tried to pour the milk into the cups, but it was too heavy. She tried and tried, but she could not do it. Lily was sad and worried. Then, her mommy came into the room and saw Lily trying to split the milk. Mommy smiled and helped Lily pour the milk into the two cups. Lily and her teddy bear drank the milk together and they were very happy. And from that day on, Lily always asked her mommy for help when she needed it.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty dog named Max. Max loved to dig in the dirt. One day, he dug a big tunnel in the ground. He was very happy with his tunnel. But then, Max forgot where the tunnel was. He looked and looked, but he could not find it. He felt sad and sat down to think. As he thought, he heard a funny sound coming from a bush. Max went to the bush and saw a little bird. The bird said, "I saw your tunnel, Max!" The bird showed Max where the tunnel was. Max was very happy and thanked the little bird. They became good friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a small cow named Bessie. Bessie lived on a farm with her friends. She liked to eat grass and play in the sun. One day, Bessie saw a big tree with red apples. She wanted to pick the apples to share with her friends. Bessie tried to reach the apples, but her neck was too short. A little bird saw Bessie and wanted to help. The bird flew up and picked the apples for Bessie. They shared the apples with all their friends. Everyone was happy and full. From that day on, Bessie and the bird were best friends.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. He saw a band playing fun songs. Tim loved the music and danced with his friends. The sun was shining, and everyone was happy. Suddenly, dark clouds came, and it started to pour. The band stopped playing, and everyone ran to hide under a big tree. Tim felt impatient because he wanted to dance more. But then, the rain stopped, and a big rainbow appeared in the sky. The band started to play again, and everyone danced under the rainbow. The unexpected rain made the day even more special for Tim and his friends.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Tim. Tim had a friend named Sam. They liked to play together. One day, Sam's hair was messy. He needed a brush to fix it. Tim had a brush. He said, "Sam, I can lend you my brush." Sam was happy and said, "Thank you, Tim!" Sam used the brush to fix his hair. But the brush was weak. It broke when Sam used it. Sam was sad. Tim saw Sam was sad. He said, "Don't worry, Sam. We can fix the brush together." They worked together to fix the weak brush. After they fixed it, they both learned that helping each other is good. And they played happily together.

Once upon a time, there was a big cat and a little mouse. They were best friends. The big cat had a secret, but the little mouse did not know it yet. The big cat was envious of the little mouse because the little mouse could go into small holes where the big cat could not go. One day, the big cat said to the little mouse, "I have a secret to tell you. I can change into a small cat, so I can go into small holes too!" The little mouse was very surprised and asked, "How do you do that?" The big cat said, "I just close my eyes and think small thoughts." The little mouse wanted to try it too. So, they both closed their eyes and thought small thoughts. When they opened their eyes, the big cat was now a small cat! But the little mouse had turned into a big mouse! They both laughed and played together, happy to have new ways to explore the world.

One day, a happy dog named Spot was playing with his ball. He liked to grab the ball and run around the yard. Spot saw a little strip of cloth on the ground. He grabbed it and started to play with it. Spot's friend, a little bird named Chirpy, saw the strip of cloth, too. Chirpy wanted the strip to make her nest cozy. Chirpy said, "Spot, can I have the strip for my nest, please?" Spot did not want to give the strip to Chirpy. He wanted to play with it. Chirpy was sad, but she had an idea. "Spot, let's play a game," she said. "If I can grab the strip from you, I can keep it for my nest. If you can keep it away from me, you can play with it." Spot liked games, so he agreed. They played the game, and Chirpy was fast. She grabbed the strip from Spot. Spot was a little sad, but Chirpy had an idea. "Spot, we can share the strip. You can play with it, and when you are done, I can use it for my nest." Spot and Chirpy were both happy with the plan. They played together and shared the strip. They became best friends and had lots of fun together.

Once there were two children, Tim and Jack. They had lots of fun together playing all day. One day, Tim wanted to go outside to play, but Jack wanted to stay inside watching TV. So Tim found the exit and went outside all by himself. He looked around for something fun to do, but he couldn't find anything. He was about to go back inside when he saw something funny. It was Jack! He had followed Tim outside. Jack got very angry, because Tim left him inside to watch alone. They argued for a while, but in the end they both decided to play together outside and have lots of fun.

One day, a little girl named Mia went to the park. She saw a big, wide tree. The tree had an unusual display on it. Mia was very happy and ran to look at it.
