He thinks that means he can break his promise. Mia smiles. She trusts Tom. She peels her banana and breaks it in half. She gives one half to Tom and keeps the other. She takes a bite. "Thank you, Mia. This is good," Tom says. He takes a bite of the banana. He also takes a bite of his cracker. He still wants a grape. He looks at the table. He sees no one around. He thinks it is safe. He drops his banana and cracker. He runs to the table. He grabs a grape. He pops it in his mouth. He feels happy. But then he hears a loud roar. He turns around. He sees a big dog. The dog is angry. The dog is hungry. The dog wants the grapes. The dog chases Tom. Tom is scared. He runs away. He drops the grape. He cries for help. Mia hears Tom. She sees the dog. She is brave. She is playful. She picks up a stick. She waves it at the dog. She makes a funny noise. She distracts the dog. The dog stops chasing Tom. The dog looks at Mia. The dog is curious. The dog likes sticks. The dog likes noises. The dog forgets the grapes. The dog plays with Mia. Tom runs back to Mia. He hugs her. He says sorry. "I'm sorry, Mia. I broke my promise. I took a grape. I was greedy. I was wrong. The dog was scary. You saved me. You are a good friend," Tom says. Mia hugs Tom. She says it's OK. "It's OK, Tom. I forgive you. You made a mistake. You learned a lesson. The dog was scary. But he is also playful. He likes to play with us. He is a good dog," Mia says. They pet the dog. They give him some of their snacks. They make friends with him. They play with him. They have fun. They see a lady. She comes to the table. She sees the grapes. She sees the dog. She sees Tom and Mia. She smiles. "Hello, kids. I'm glad you like my dog. His name is Spot. He is very playful. He loves grapes. But he also loves to share. Do you want some grapes?" she asks. Tom and Mia look at each other. They nod. They say yes. "Thank you, lady. Thank you, Spot. We love grapes. We also love to share. We are sorry we took a grape without asking. We won't do it again. We promise," they say. They take a grape each. They eat it. They say it's delicious. They thank the lady again. They thank Spot again. They play with him some more. They are happy. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a cat named Tom. Tom loved to play with yarn. One day, Tom found a big ball of yarn. It was not a boring color. It was red and blue and made Tom very excite. Tom played with the yarn all day. He rolled it, chased it, and jumped on it. The yarn made him very happy. Tom's friends, a dog and a bird, saw him play. They wanted to play with the yarn too. So, they all played with the yarn together. They had so much fun that they forgot how boring the day was before. They played until they were tired. Then, they all took a nap, dreaming of more exciting days with the yarn.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Emily. She had a pet parrot named Polly. Whenever Emily came home from school, Polly would clap her wings. Polly was so happy to see Emily. Emily wanted to show Polly how much she loved her, so she decided to give her a special treat. She went outside and picked a lime from the tree. Polly was so excited when she saw the lime. She chirped and clapped her wings. But then, Emily saw something unusual - a green frog hopping around in the garden. She liked the frog and wanted to show him the lime. But the frog was so jealous that Emily had a pet parrot. He hopped away and hid behind a bush, so Emily couldn't give him the lime. Polly, however, was very happy. She clapped her wings, and the two friends enjoyed the lime together.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He had a big red ball. One day, Tim went to the park to play with his ball. He saw a girl named Sue. Sue was playing with her doll. Tim wanted to play with Sue, so he asked, "Can I play with you?" Sue said, "Yes, but don't be rude." Tim promised he would not be rude. They played together with the ball and the doll. They had a lot of fun. But then, Tim threw the ball too hard, and it missed Sue. The ball went far away. Tim felt sad. Sue said, "It's okay, let's go find the ball." They looked for the ball together. When they found it, they were happy. They gave each other a big touch with their hands. Then they played some more and had a great day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Tim found a small, cheap pebble on the ground. It was shiny and smooth. Tim picked it up and showed it to his friend, Sue. "Look, Sue! I found a pebble!" Tim said. Sue looked at the pebble and smiled. "Wow, it's so pretty!" she said. They both decided to keep the pebble and share it. Tim and Sue played with the pebble all day. They made sure to behave and be nice to each other. They took turns holding the pebble and showed it to all their friends. At the end of the day, Tim and Sue put the pebble in a special box. They promised to always behave and be kind when they played with their special pebble. And from that day on, they became the best of friends.

Once upon a time in a big park, there was a chubby cat named Fluffy. Fluffy liked to play with her friends, the birds, and the bugs. One day, Fluffy saw a cross made of sticks on the ground. She thought it was a toy, so she played with it. A little boy named Tim saw Fluffy playing with the cross. Tim said, "Hey Fluffy, did you make that cross?" Fluffy meowed and nodded her head. Tim was happy and wanted to play with Fluffy and the cross too. As they played with the cross, it started to move on its own! Fluffy and Tim were very surprised. The cross stood up and turned into a friendly stick man. He said, "Thank you for playing with me. I was stuck as a cross, but your play made me free!" Fluffy, Tim, and the stick man became best friends and played together in the park every day.

Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim went to his grandpa's house. Grandpa had a big box. Tim asked, "What's in the box, Grandpa?" Grandpa said, "This box has history. Let's unpack it together." They opened the box and found old toys and books. Tim saw a toy lion and a book about wild animals. Tim and Grandpa played with the lion and read the book. They learned about wild animals like lions, tigers, and bears. Tim loved the stories and wanted to know more. He was happy to share this special time with Grandpa.

Once upon a time, there was a little seed. This seed wanted to grow big and strong. It was in a small chamber under the ground, where it was dark and cozy. One day, the seed felt a little fearful. It was scared to grow because it didn't know what would happen. But it wanted to see the sun and feel the rain, so it decided to be brave and grow. The seed started to grow little roots and a tiny stem. It pushed through the dirt and finally saw the bright sun. The seed was so happy it grew and was no longer fearful. It became a beautiful flower, and everyone loved it.

One day, a shy boy named Tim went to the park. He wore his new red shirt. He saw kids playing and wanted to play too. But he was too shy to ask them. Tim saw a big pile of leaves. He thought it would be fun to scatter the leaves. So, he ran and jumped into the pile. The leaves went everywhere! The kids stopped playing and looked at Tim. One kid said, "Hey, that looks fun! Can we play too?" Tim smiled and said, "Yes, let's scatter more leaves!" All the kids played together, and Tim was not shy anymore. They all had a great time, and Tim made new friends.

One day, a little boy named Tim was playing with his toy car. He was very happy. Tim's mom was in the kitchen making dinner. She told Tim, "Be careful and don't break anything." Tim was not ready to stop playing. He drove his toy car very fast. It went up the couch and then down. Tim was having so much fun. But then, the car hit a lamp and it fell down. "Oh no!" Tim said. Tim's mom came into the room and saw the broken lamp. She was not happy. She said, "Tim, I told you to be careful. Now, I have to punish you. No more playing with your toy car today." Tim was sad, but he knew he had to listen to his mom. Next time, he would be more careful when playing.

Once upon a time, there was a little car. The car was red and very fast. It could zoom up and down the road. The car was very filthy because it loved to play in the mud. The car's name was Zoomy. One day, Zoomy was zooming down the road when it saw a big, green tree. Zoomy wanted to give the tree a big hug. So, Zoomy zoomed to the tree to give it some love. But when Zoomy got close to the tree, something unexpected happened. Zoomy didn't know that the tree was a magic tree! When Zoomy hugged the tree, it became clean and shiny. The filthy mud was gone! Zoomy was so happy and surprised. From that day on, Zoomy and the magic tree were best friends. They both shared love and happiness with each other.

Once upon a time, there was a big, ugly frog. He lived near a small pond. The ugly frog liked to speak a lot. He would speak to the fish, the bugs, and the birds. But, not everyone liked to hear him speak. One day, an angry bird came to the pond. The bird wanted to fight the ugly frog. The bird thought the frog spoke too much. The frog did not want to fight, but the bird was very mad. So, the ugly frog made a plan. He spoke to his friends, the fish and the bugs. They all helped him. When the bird came to fight, the frog spoke nicely to the bird. The bird was surprised. The bird and the frog became friends. Now, they all speak to each other and play together at the pond.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Yawn. He lived near a station where big trains came and went. Yawn loved to watch the trains every day. One day, Yawn saw a big, disgusting mess by the station. Yawn did not like the mess, but he did not know how to clean it up. He thought and thought, then he had an idea. Yawn asked his friends, the birds, to help him clean the mess. The birds agreed and together, they cleaned the disgusting mess. The station looked nice and clean again. Yawn and the birds were very happy. They learned that working together can make hard jobs easier. And from that day on, Yawn and the birds always helped each other keep the station clean.

Once upon a time, in a small house, lived a mouse named Tim. Tim loved cheese more than anything. One day, he saw a long piece of cheese in the kitchen. He wanted to eat it, but it was too big for him to carry. Tim asked his friend, Sam the cat, for help. "Sam, can you help me tear this long cheese into small pieces?" Tim said. Sam agreed to help him. They both pulled and pulled until the cheese was in small pieces. Tim and Sam shared the cheese and ate it together. They were very happy that they worked together to solve their problem. The moral of the story is that sharing and helping each other makes everyone happy.

One day, a small cat named Kitty took a step outside. Kitty wanted to play with her friend, Birdy. She looked up and saw Birdy in a tree. Kitty called out in a polite voice, "Birdy, will you come down and play with me?" Birdy heard Kitty's voice and flew down from the tree. "Hello, Kitty! I would love to play with you," said Birdy in a happy voice. They played together, running and jumping in the grass. After a while, they were tired and sat under the tree. Kitty and Birdy talked with their polite voices. They had a fun day playing together. In the end, they said goodbye and went to their homes, looking forward to playing again another day.

Once upon a time there was an ancient lion. He was walking through the forest and came across a lake. He was thirsty and tried to drink from the lake, but he couldn't reach. He frantically looked for a way to get to the water and soon found a big rock. He tried to move the rock but he couldn't manage. As the lion was getting more and more frustrated, he heard a voice. It was a little frog! The frog told the lion if he wanted to drink from the lake he had to do something. The frog said he had to make a bridge. The lion insisted he could not do it, he was too big and old. The frog started to hop around and asked the lion to help. Finally the lion agreed, so together they moved the ancient rock. The lion was finally able to drink and he thanked the frog for all his help.

Tom and Lily were playing outside with their ball. They liked to kick the ball to each other and catch it. They were having fun until they saw the sky. It was dark and gray. They heard a loud noise. It was thunder. "Tom, I'm scared!" Lily said. "Let's go home!" Tom nodded. He took Lily's hand and they ran to their house. But on the way, they saw something bright and colorful. It was a rainbow. It had many colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. "Look, Lily, a rainbow!" Tom said. "It's so pretty!" Lily looked up and smiled. She forgot about the thunder. She liked the rainbow. "Maybe the rainbow is a sign that everything will be okay," she said. Tom agreed. He hugged Lily and they walked to their house. They still heard the thunder, but they did not panic. They had each other and the rainbow.

One day, a girl named Lily went to the store with her mom. They wanted to buy some lemons. At the store, they saw a man who had a big display of lemons. The man said, "Hello! My lemons are very good and honest lemons. They are the best!" Lily and her mom looked at the lemons. They picked some and put them in a bag. They went to pay the man. But when Lily looked in the bag, she saw that one lemon was not yellow like the others. It was a green lemon! Lily said, "Mom, look! This lemon is green, not yellow!" Her mom looked and said, "Oh my! That is a surprise!" They showed the man the green lemon. The man said, "I did not know that was there! I am sorry. You can have that lemon for free." Lily and her mom smiled, and they went home with their lemons.

Tim liked to help his dad, who was a mechanic. He liked to watch his dad fix cars and trucks in the big garage. Sometimes, his dad let him hold a tool or a part, and Tim felt very proud. One day, Tim's dad had a difficult job. He had to fix a big truck that had a broken engine. He told Tim to stay away from the truck, because it was dangerous. But Tim was curious, and he wanted to see the engine. He waited until his dad was busy, and then he sneaked under the truck. Tim saw a lot of wires and pipes and metal things. He wondered what they did. He reached out his hand to touch one of them. But he did not know that it was very hot. He burned his finger, and he cried out loud. His dad heard him, and he ran to the truck. He saw Tim under the truck, and he was very scared. He tried to pull Tim out, but it was too late. The truck sneezed. It made a loud noise, and a lot of smoke and fire came out of the engine. The fire burned Tim and his dad, and they could not get out. The truck was fixed, but Tim and his dad were not. They were very hurt, and they had to go to the hospital. They were very sad, and they wished they had listened to each other.

One day, a yellow car went for a ride. The car loved to speed. It went very fast. The car felt happy when it went fast. The car had an impressive horn that went "beep beep." The car saw a big red ball on the road. The car said, "Hello, big red ball. Can I play with you?" The big red ball said, "Yes, yellow car. You can push me with your nose." The car pushed the big red ball with its nose. They had fun. After they played, the yellow car said goodbye to the big red ball. The car went home. It sped very fast again. The car felt happy and tired. The car went to sleep with a big smile.

Once upon a time, there was a polite dog named Max. Max had a chain around his neck. One day, Max saw a little girl named Lily. Lily looked sad. Max went to Lily and asked, "Why are you sad?" Lily said, "I want to learn how to jump rope, but I don't know how." Max wanted to help Lily. He thought he could teach her to jump rope. Max took off his chain and gave it to Lily. They tried to jump rope with the chain, but it was too heavy. Lily was sad again. Max had an idea. He found a long, light rope and taught Lily how to jump rope. Lily was happy and said, "Thank you, Max!" They played together and became best friends. From that day on, Max and Lily always played and learned new things together.

Once upon a time, there was a big room with a bookcase. The bookcase was full of colorful books. In the room, there was a small door that no one ever enter. One day, a little girl named Lily felt uncomfortable because she was bored. She saw the small door and decided to enter. When she went inside, she found a secret place with a big chair and a table. Lily sat in the chair and took a book from the bookcase. She read the book and felt happy. From that day on, whenever Lily felt uncomfortable, she would enter the secret place and read a book. And she was never bored again.

Mama and Baby were in the garden. Mama had a needle and some thread. Mama said, "Let's make something for the garden." Baby smiled. "What are we making, Mama?" Mama replied, "We are making something useful. We are going to use this thread to make a net. It will allow us to catch insects and keep them away from our flowers." Baby thought that sounded fun so they went to work. Mama used the needle to pull the thread through the fabric. Baby held the thread and watched as Mama made a big net. When it was done, Mama said, "Look, Baby! We have made something useful. Now let's put it in the garden and see what kind of insects we can catch." Baby and Mama laughed. They were so happy with the useful net they had made with the thread.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Daisy. Daisy was 3 years old and she loved going on adventures with her parents. One day, Daisy and her parents went on a walk in the park. Daisy was amazed by all the unknow wonders of the park. She laughed and smiled as she saw the beautiful flowers and friendly animals. Then, she noticed a tall hill that she wanted to climb. She asked her parents if she could try to climb it and they agreed. She was scared and a bit unsure, but with her parents' help, she was able to lift her feet and get to the top of the hill. Once at the top, she was surprised to see a cute puppy. The puppy barked happily and came to greet Daisy. Daisy was overjoyed and hugged the puppy. Daisy's parents were filled with love seeing how happy Daisy was with the puppy. Daisy named the puppy "Love" and the three of them went back home together. Daisey was so proud of herself for getting to the top of the hill and for meeting Love. She knew she could do anything if she worked hard and used a bit of unknown courage.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. Amy was very sad and miserable. She had lost her favorite toy, a small bear with a heart symbol on it. Amy looked everywhere for her bear, but she could not find it. One day, Amy went to the park with her mom. She saw a big tree with a hole in it. She thought maybe her bear was inside. She called out, "Bear, are you in there?" But there was no answer. Amy felt even more miserable. Then, a nice boy named Tom came to the park. He saw that Amy was sad and asked her what was wrong. Amy told him about her lost bear. Tom helped Amy look for the bear. They called out, "Bear, where are you?" And this time, they heard a soft sound from the bushes. They found the bear with the heart symbol! Amy was so happy, and she and Tom became good friends.

Lily and Tom were playing in the park with their mom. They liked to run, slide, swing and climb. They saw many birds, flowers, bugs and dogs. They had fun and laughed a lot. But then, the sky became dark and loud. Big drops of water started to fall. Lily and Tom felt wet and cold. They ran to their mom, who had a big umbrella. "Mom, we want to go home!" they cried. Mom nodded and smiled. "OK, let's go home. We can have a warm drink and a nap. You will feel better soon." She took their hands and walked to the car. She put them in their seats and covered them with a blanket. "You are safe with me," she said. But on the way home, something bad happened. A big truck came very fast and hit their car. Mom screamed and tried to stop, but it was too late. The car crashed and flipped over. Lily and Tom felt a lot of pain and fear. They called for their mom, but she did not answer. They were trapped and hurt. They wished they could have a nap and wake up from this bad dream. But they did not.

One day, a sister and her little brother played outside. The sun was bright and they were happy. They saw a big sack near the tree. The sister said, "Let's play with the sack!" They took the sack and played a loud game. They put toys in the sack and took turns to guess what was inside. The sister said, "Is it a ball?" The little brother said, "No, it's a car!" Then, they played sack race. They got inside the sack and jumped like frogs. The sister jumped fast and won the race. The little brother laughed and clapped his hands. After playing with the sack, they sat under the tree. They were tired but happy. They talked and laughed together. The sister said, "We had so much fun today!" The little brother said, "Yes, I love playing with you and the sack!"

Once upon a time, there was a sailor that wanted to go on an adventure. He had a boat with a bright sail that was ready to take him wherever he wanted to go. The sailor piled coal into the boat and pushed it to the lake. He looked up at the sky. The sun was bright and shining. The sailor smiled and called out, "Let's go sail!". The boat started to move. The sailor laughed and said, "We are going on an adventure!". The boat kept sailing until the sailor suddenly realized something. He had run out of coal and now the boat was stopped in the middle of the lake. The sailor looked around, feeling concerned. "Oh no!" he said. Suddenly, he saw a bright light in the distance. He grabbed a paddle and started rowing his boat towards the light. When he arrived, he saw a coal ship and the sailor smiled. "Thank you!" he shouted. He loaded the coal onto his boat and sailed back to shore. The sailor had learned an important lesson. Be prepared before you set sail. With the right preparation you'll always have a bright and safe journey.

One day, Jack and his family wanted to travel to the beach. So, they got in their car and drove away. On their way, they saw a police car. Jack was so excited and shouted, "Look! A police!" When they got to the beach, Jack and his family built a sandcastle together. They even put flags on the top. After that, they all went swimming in the sea. The waves were big and Jack enjoyed them a lot. Later, Jack's mom told him to go buy an ice cream for everyone. Jack said, "Yay! Ice cream!" He went to the truck and picked yummy flavors for everyone. Everyone was very happy with their ice cream. At the end of the day, Jack and his family drove back home. It had been a great day and Jack was already looking forward to his next adventure.

Once upon a time, in a tidy little house, there lived a boy named Sam. Sam had a big toy box filled with lots of fun toys. One day, Sam found a new toy in his box. It was a small plastic dinosaur. Sam played with the plastic dinosaur all day. He made the dinosaur walk, jump, and roar. Then, Sam had a funny idea. He wanted to see how the dinosaur would taste. So, he put the dinosaur in his mouth. Sam's mom saw him and said, "Oh no, Sam! We don't taste our toys!" Sam took the dinosaur out of his mouth and said, "Sorry, Mom." He put the dinosaur back in the tidy toy box and went to play with his other toys. From that day on, Sam never tried to taste his toys again.

One day, a beautiful girl went to a big park. She saw many kids playing. She wanted to play too. She saw a ball and she wanted to pass the ball to the kids. She took the ball and passed it to a boy. The boy passed it back. They played with the ball in rhythm. They laughed and had fun. The girl was happy. Then, something unexpected happened. A big dog came and took the ball. The dog ran away with the ball. The girl and the boy were sad. They could not play anymore. The beautiful day was not fun anymore.

Once upon a time, in a small house, lived a deaf dog named Max. Max loved to dress up in his red leather collar. Every day, Max would wear his collar and play in the yard. One sunny day, Max was playing with his ball. He saw a big tree with many birds. The birds were singing, but Max could not hear them. Max was happy, though, because he could see the birds and feel the sun on his face. As Max played, his friend, a little girl named Lucy, came to visit. Lucy and Max played all day long. They laughed and had fun together. When the sun went down, Max and Lucy went inside the house. Max's red leather collar shined in the light. They were tired but very happy. Max and Lucy knew they would have more fun days together.

Once upon a time, there was a big, hairy dog named Bobo. Bobo lived in a small house with a nice family. He loved to play with the kids and sleep in his warm bed. One day, Bobo went to the park with the kids. They played catch and ran around. Then, something unexpected happened. Bobo started to speak! The kids were very surprised. Bobo said, "I promise to be a good dog and help you." The kids were so happy, but then they realized it was not Bobo speaking. It was a little bird hiding in Bobo's hair! The bird was making the promise, not Bobo. The kids laughed and played with the bird too. They all had a fun day at the park together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily liked to wear her favorite dress. It was a very interesting dress with many colors. She wore it every day. One day, Lily's parent told her that she needed to share her dress with her sister, Ella. Lily did not want to share her dress. She wanted to wear it all the time. But her parent said it was important to share. Lily decided to share her interesting dress with Ella. When Ella wore the dress, she was very happy. Lily felt good about sharing. She learned that sharing made both her and Ella happy. And that was the moral value of the story: sharing makes everyone happy.

Once upon a time, there was a cheerful cat named Lucy. Lucy loved to play outside with her friends. One day, Lucy's mom told her, "On Wednesday, we will go to the park." On Wednesday, Lucy woke up very excited. But when she looked outside, she saw it was raining. Lucy was sad because the rain would delay their trip to the park. Her mom said, "Don't worry, Lucy. We can still go when the rain stops." Lucy waited and waited. Finally, the rain stopped, and the sun came out. Lucy and her mom went to the park. Lucy was so happy to play with her friends. At the end of the day, Lucy said, "Even though we had to wait, today was the best day ever!"

Once upon a time there was a baby who was so excited to get a new crib. He ran around the house saying “crib, crib!” with a big smile on his face. Everyone was pleased to see the baby so happy. Then one day the baby's mom realized that his new crib was too small and the baby was getting miserable inside it. She put on a thinking cap to figure out what to do. Suddenly she had an idea and headed off to the store to find a bigger crib. When she came back, the baby's eyes opened wide with excitement! He couldn't hide his joy! He couldn't stop saying “CRIB!” and jumping around the room. His mom was so happy too. The baby now has a comfy new crib and is never miserable. He sleeps tight and has sweet dreams every night.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom loved to play outside in the sun. One day, Tom found a tap near his house. The tap had water coming out of it. He liked to play with the water. Tom saw a bird near the tap. The bird looked sad and thirsty. The sun was very harsh that day. Tom said to the bird, "Do you want some water?" The bird nodded its head. Tom put his hands under the tap to give the bird some water. The bird was happy and said, "Thank you, Tom!" The bird accepted the water from Tom's hands. Tom felt good that he could help the bird. They became friends, and they played together every day.

Once upon a time there was a kitty named Meowny. Meowny was a fluffy, white, happy cat. She liked to take long naps in the sun and jump from high places. One day, Meowny decided to visit the animal park. When she arrived, she saw many different kinds of animals. There were birds, rabbits, and a big, fat bear. Meowny went to say hello to the bear. The bear said hello back and asked if Meowny wanted to discuss something. Meowny said yes, and the bear asked why she came to the park. Meowny said she wanted to find an owner for her toy. The bear thought for a moment and said he knew the perfect person. He said there was a young girl who lived in the deep forest nearby. The bear and Meowny agreed to go and find the girl. They made their way through the deep forest until they found the girl. Meowny and the bear approached her and asked if she would like to be the owner of Meowny's toy. The little girl was so excited and said yes. Meowny and the bear were very happy with the outcome. The bear said goodbye to Meowny and went back home to his cave. Meowny and the little girl played together in the park all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a happy dog named Max. Max loved to play with his ball and run in the park. One day, Max saw a big truck. The big truck had a barrel in it. Max was very curious. The man from the truck said he needed to deliver the barrel to the store. Max wanted to help the man. So, Max pushed the barrel with his nose. He pushed and pushed until the barrel was at the store. The man was very happy and said "thank you" to Max. Max was happy too because he helped the man. Max went home and played with his ball. Everyone was happy. The end.

One day, a sweet little dog went for a walk. He saw a big fence in front of him. The fence was very tall, but the dog wanted to see what was on the other side. The dog tried to jump over the fence, but it was too high. He walked around the fence, and he found a small hole. He looked through the hole and saw a big, green yard. There were many pretty flowers and a big tree. The sweet little dog was very happy. He jumped and played in the green yard all day. He smelled the pretty flowers and lay under the big tree. At the end of the day, the dog went back through the hole in the fence and went home.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toy cars. One day, he saw his friend Sue playing with her toy cars too. They both had cars that were a match. Tim's car was red and Sue's car was red too. Tim said, "Sue, let's unite and play together!" Sue smiled and said, "Yes, let's play and have fun!" So, they put their toy cars together and started to race them. They were very calm as they played together. As they played, more friends came and joined them. They all had toy cars that were a match too. The friends were happy to unite and play together. They all had a great time and played until the sun went down.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly cat. The cat loved to speak. It would speak to everyone it met. The cat had a special love for jazz music. One day, the cat went to a park. In the park, it heard some jazz music. The cat was very happy. It followed the sound of the music and found a band playing jazz. The friendly cat started to speak with the band. The band liked the cat. They asked the cat to join them. The cat danced and spoke while the band played jazz. Everyone at the park had fun with the friendly cat and the jazz band.

One day, a boy named Tom went to see his friend, Sam. Sam was sick and had to take medicine. Tom wanted to help, so he brought his heavy toy truck to play with Sam. They both liked to display their toy trucks and race them. Tom thought this would make Sam feel better. "Look, Sam! I brought my heavy truck!" said Tom. Sam smiled and showed Tom his medicine. "This makes me feel better," Sam said. They started to play with the trucks, but the heavy truck knocked over the medicine bottle. The medicine spilled everywhere! Tom and Sam tried to clean up the mess, but they couldn't. They were sad and scared. They knew they made a big mistake. In the end, Sam didn't feel better, and they both got in trouble for the spilled medicine.

Tommy was a big boy. He did not like his crib. He wanted to sleep in a big bed like his sister. One night, he tried to climb out of his crib. He put his leg over the rail and pushed with his arms. But he slipped and fell on the floor. He hit his head and felt dizzy. He started to cry. Mommy and Daddy heard him and ran to his room. They saw him on the floor and picked him up. They hugged him and kissed him. They asked him what happened. "I wanted to sleep in a big bed," Tommy said. "But I fell and hurt my head." Mommy and Daddy looked at each other. They smiled and said, "You are a brave boy, Tommy. But you are not ready for a big bed yet. You need to stay in your crib until you grow more. Your crib is safe and cozy. We love you very much." Tommy felt embarrassed. He knew he did something silly. He said sorry to Mommy and Daddy. They said it was okay and tucked him back in his crib. They gave him his teddy bear and sang him a lullaby. Tommy felt better and closed his eyes. He dreamed of sleeping in a big bed someday.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. Spot loved to play with his ball. He would run, jump, and take turns with his friends. Spot was a gentle dog and never hurt anyone. One day, Spot and his friends were playing with their ball. They would take turns to bite the ball and throw it to each other. They were having so much fun! The sun was shining, and the grass was soft under their feet. But then, something happened. The ball got stuck in a tree! Spot and his friends tried to get the ball down, but they were too small. They took turns jumping and biting at the air, but the ball would not come down. Then, a kind bird saw them and wanted to help. The bird flew up and gently pushed the ball out of the tree with her beak. Spot and his friends were so happy! They thanked the bird and went back to playing their game. They took turns biting the ball and throwing it, being gentle with each other, just like the kind bird had been with them. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there lived a very pale girl called Mary. Mary was three years old and loved to play in the East. One day, Mary cooled to pour some water from the river. She filled up the bucket with the cool water and started to pour. Suddenly, she heard a voice. "Don't pour too much!" Mary looked around and saw an old wise man. He smiled and said to her, "You can pour, but don't pour too much. The East needs the water, it's very important." Mary thought about it for a minute and nodded. She carefully poured just enough water and smiled. The wise man smiled back and said, "Good job, Mary." And then he left. From then on, Mary never poured too much water. She would just carefully pour enough and make sure the East had the water it needed.

Once upon a time, in a small house, lived a messy boy named Tom. Tom loved to play with his toys and make a lot of noise. He also liked to eat a lot of sugar. His mom always told him not to eat too much sugar, but Tom did not listen. One day, Tom's mom made a big cake with lots of sugar for a party. Tom saw the cake and wanted to eat it so bad. He thought it would be fun to joke with his mom. He took a big piece of the cake and hid it under his bed. Then, he went to his mom and said, "Mom, I found a big bug in my room!" His mom was scared and went to look for the bug. While she was looking, Tom ate the big piece of cake. He got sugar all over his face and clothes. His mom saw the mess and knew that Tom was joking. Tom's mom was not happy with him. She said, "Tom, you should not joke like that and eat so much sugar. It is not good for you." Tom felt bad and said sorry to his mom. From that day, Tom learned to listen to his mom and not to eat too much sugar.

One day, a little dog named Spike was playing in his yard. He loved to dig holes and run around. But today, Spike made a very messy hole. The dirt was everywhere, and he got very dirty too. "Help, help!" cried a tiny bird from a nearby tree. "My nest fell down, and I can't get it back!" Spike looked up and saw the bird's nest on the ground. Spike wanted to help the bird. "I can help you," said Spike. He picked up the nest with his mouth and put it back in the tree. The bird was so happy. "Thank you, Spike!" the bird chirped. "You are a good friend." Spike felt proud that he could help the bird. He learned that it is important to help others when they need it. And after that, Spike always tried to help his friends, no matter how messy he was.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom was a curious and ignorant boy. One day, he found a wide box in his backyard. He was very excited and wanted to show it to his friend, Sam. Tom ran to Sam's house and said, "Sam, I found a wide box! Let's bury it and see what happens." Sam agreed, and they went back to Tom's backyard. They dug a hole and put the wide box in it. Then, they covered the box with dirt. Days went by, and the boys forgot about the wide box they buried. One day, it rained a lot, and the ground turned into mud. Tom and Sam were playing in the yard when they slipped and fell into the hole where the wide box was buried. The mud covered them, and they couldn't get out. Their parents found them and were very angry. Tom and Sam learned that burying things without knowing what they were wasn't a good idea.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Pete who loved to race. Every day, he would borrow his dad's tool and race around his garden. One day, Pete's dad said, "I'll race you around the garden." Pete couldn't believe it! He was so excited that he started running immediately. Pete and his dad raced around the garden and Pete was so fast that he won every time. He was very proud of his dad and was grateful that he could run with him. One time, Pete's dad said, "I have something special for you. If you can race around the garden five times in a row, I'll give it to you." Pete knew it had to be something special, but he was not sure what it was. That day, Pete ran as fast as he could. When he finished, his dad handed him a shiny new toolbox. Pete was so happy and grateful to his dad. He knew that one day, he would use this tool to help him race around the garden even faster!

Mia was in the house with her brother Tom. Tom looked at the window and said, "I'm cold." Mia saw it was windy outside and said, "Let's put some fuel on the fire." Tom quickly ran to get some fuel. But when he came back, he began to shiver. Mia was uncomfortable. She thought to herself, "Why is Tom still shivering?" She asked Tom, "Do you still feel cold?" He said, "Yes, but it's uncomfortable." Mia noticed that the fire was almost out and said, "Let's get more fuel for the fire!" Tom went outside and got some more fuel for the fire. They quickly added it to the fire and soon it was nice and warm. Tom and Mia were no longer uncomfortable. But then the wind picked up and they started to shiver again. Mia asked Tom, "What can we do?" Tom thought for a minute and said, "Let's put a blanket over us. That will stop the wind and keep us warm." Mia agreed and they went to get a blanket. Then Tom and Mia finally got warm and stopped shivering. They were so relieved, and happy to be warm again!

Once upon a time, in a big green park, there was a young boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his big red ball. One sunny day, Tim went to the park with his mom to play with his ball. Tim threw the ball high up in the air and watched it bounce on the ground. "Mom, look!" Tim said. "My ball can bounce so high!" His mom smiled and said, "Yes, it does! You're good at playing with your ball." After some time, Tim saw a big blue pool of water. He wanted to see if his ball could bounce on the water too. Tim threw the ball into the water, but the ball did not bounce. It floated on the water instead. Tim looked at his mom and said, "Mom, the ball doesn't bounce on the water!" His mom laughed and said, "No, Tim, balls don't bounce on water, they float." Tim learned something new that day. He had fun playing with his ball at the park, and he was happy to know that the ball could bounce on the ground but not on the water. Tim and his mom went home, excited to come back to the park and play again another day.

Lily and her mommy were playing in the sand box. Mommy said, "Let's make something!" Lily excitedly grabbed a shovel. "What are we going to make?" She asked. "We're going to make a structure in the sand that fits." Mommy said. Lily began to dig in the sand. Mommy handed Lily some sticks and rocks. They set them up and put sand around them tightly. When the structure was finished, Lily stepped back to look at it. Mommy smiled. "It fits perfectly!" Lily was so excited. The structure fit perfectly in the sand! She smiled proudly at her work.

Once upon a time, there was a big, interesting building. Many people lived there. One day, a little boy named Tim and his mom went to visit the building. Tim was very excited. Inside the building, Tim met a girl named Sue. Sue said, "Hi! I hope we can play together." Tim was happy and said, "Yes, let's play!" They both played and had lots of fun. But then, a loud noise came from outside. Tim and Sue were scared. The big, interesting building started to shake. People ran out of the building. Tim and his mom left too. The building fell down. Everyone was sad.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had a very impressive toy tool. He loved to play with it all the time. One day, Tim went to the park with his mom and took his toy tool with him. At the park, Tim met a girl named Sue. Sue saw Tim's toy tool and wanted to play with it too. Tim decided to share his toy tool with Sue. They played together and had lots of fun. But then, something unexpected happened. A little dog ran up to them and took the toy tool in its mouth. Tim and Sue were very surprised. They chased the dog and, to their surprise, the dog led them to a big box of even more impressive toy tools. Tim and Sue were very happy and decided to share the new toy tools with all their friends at the park.

Jimmy was a three year old boy living with parents in an enormous house. One day, Jimmy was in the living room playing with his toys when he noticed a big box in the corner. He asked his mom what it was. "That's a television," she replied. Jimmy thought it was really cool and asked if he could watch it. His mom said yes, and Jimmy excitedly climbed onto the couch and switched it on. He was delighted by all the different characters and programs he saw on the screen. "This is the best thing ever," he exclaimed. Jimmy kept watching his shows, and eventually his mom had to tell him that it was time for bed. "Awww, Mum," said Jimmy. His mum said that he could watch the television again tomorrow if he wanted, and Jimmy smiled as he ran off to his bedroom. He lay on his bed, thinking about the enormous television and all the fun shows he could watch. He felt very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little soldier. He was pale and small. He lived in a box. One day, a girl named Lucy came to unpack the box. The soldier was happy to be out. But there was a problem. The soldier's hat was missing. The pale soldier and Lucy looked for the hat. They looked under the bed and in the closet. They found the hat behind a big toy. The soldier put on his hat and was happy again. And they played together all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a fat cat named Kitty. Kitty liked to play with her ball. One day, Kitty heard a noise outside. She went to see what it was. Kitty saw a little bird on the ground. The bird said, "I can't fly. Can you help me?" Kitty wanted to help, but she did not know how. She thought for a moment and said, "I will mind you until we find help." Kitty and the little bird went to find help. They found a big dog named Max. Max said, "I can help the bird fly." Max put the bird on his back and ran fast. The bird flapped its wings and started to fly. Kitty and the bird were happy. They thanked Max and played together all day long.

Ben and Mia were playing in the park. They liked to look for acorns under the big tree. They found many acorns, some big, some small, some brown, some green. They put them in a basket. "Look, Mia, this acorn is different!" Ben said. He showed Mia an acorn that had a hole in it. "What made the hole?" "Maybe a bug, or a bird, or a squirrel," Mia said. She looked inside the hole. "I see something shiny!" "What is it?" Ben asked. He looked too. He saw a small metal ring with a star on it. "Wow, it's a ring! Can I have it?" "No, I saw it first!" Mia said. She tried to take the acorn from Ben. "Hey, give it back!" Ben said. He pulled the acorn from Mia. They both wanted the ring. They started to fight over the acorn. They shouted and pushed and scratched each other. "Stop, stop, stop!" a voice said. It was Mom. She came to the park to pick them up. She saw them fighting. She was not happy. "What are you doing? Why are you fighting?" They both stopped and looked at Mom. They felt bad. They knew they did something wrong. "We found a ring in an acorn, and we both wanted it," Mia said. "Can we see it?" Mom asked. She took the acorn from Ben. She looked at the ring. She smiled. "This is not a real ring. It's a sticker. See, it peels off." She peeled off the sticker from the acorn. She showed it to Ben and Mia. They saw that it was just a shiny paper with a star on it. They felt silly. "Is this why you fought?" Mom asked. "Over a sticker?" They nodded. They were ashamed. Mom gave them a tissue. "Here, wipe your faces. You have dirt and tears on them. And say sorry to each other." Ben and Mia wiped their faces. They looked at each other. "I'm sorry, Mia," Ben said. "I'm sorry, Ben," Mia said. They hugged each other. They felt better. Mom smiled. "That's good. Now, let's go home. You can share the acorns and the sticker. And next time, remember to be nice and fair to each other, OK?" "OK, Mom," Ben and Mia said. They took the basket and the sticker. They followed Mom to the car. They learned a lesson. They decided to be good friends and not fight over silly things.

One day, a boy named Tim found a drum in his room. He did not know where it came from. Tim was very happy and started to play the drum. He played it loudly and danced around his room. He was a bit careless and did not look where he was going. He wondered if his friends would like his new drum too. Tim took his drum outside to show his friends. They all liked the drum and wanted to play it too. They took turns playing the drum and dancing. They were all having so much fun that they did not see the big rock in their way. Tim was still wondering where the drum came from. Then, something unexpected happened. Tim's dog, Spot, came running over and took the drum away. Tim and his friends were surprised. They chased after Spot and found out that the drum belonged to their neighbor, Mr. Brown. It turned out that Spot had taken the drum from Mr. Brown's yard. Tim felt bad for being careless with the drum. Tim and his friends gave the drum back to Mr. Brown. They said sorry for playing with it without asking. Mr. Brown was not mad. He said they could play the drum if they were careful. Tim and his friends were happy and promised to be more careful next time. They all played the drum together and had a great day.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl named Sarah. Every day, she would go play in the park with her friends. One day, she noticed something very strange in the park. In the corner, there was a bright green monster. Sarah was scared and ran to her friends. She asked them, "What should I do?" Her friends replied, "Don't worry, it's just a regular monster. He won't hurt you. But he does hate green things. The monster in the park hates the colour green." Sarah thought of a plan. She and her friends quickly collected all the green things from the park. They picked up the green leaves and the green twigs and put them in a big pile. The monster was so surprised that he smiled, thanked them, and left. Sarah and her friends were very happy and ever since that day, they visit the park more often. Every once in a while, they make sure there's no green things left in the park so the monster stays away.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom had a big, dull rock. He loved to play with his rock every day. Tom would put the rock on a stand and look at it. One day, Tom wanted to see what was inside the rock. He tried to split it open, but it was too hard. Tom asked his dad for help. His dad got a tool and helped Tom split the rock. When the rock split, they found a shiny, pretty stone inside. Tom was so happy! He put the shiny stone on the stand and looked at it every day. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a very independent boy. He liked to play with his computer all day. One day, Tim's mom told him, "Tim, you must surrender your computer and go outside to play with your friends." Tim did not want to surrender his computer. He wanted to play with it all day. But he knew his mom was right. So, he went outside to play with his friends. They played tag and hide-and-seek. They laughed and had fun. As Tim and his friends played, it started to rain. They all ran to find shelter, but Tim slipped and fell in the mud. He was sad and wet. His friends laughed at him. Tim wished he had stayed inside with his computer.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to the beach with her mommy. It was a sunny day, and Lily loved the beach. She saw the blue water and the soft sand. She felt happy. Lily found a beautiful shell on the sand. It was pink and shiny. She picked it up and showed it to her mommy. "Look, mommy! Pretty shell!" she said. Her mommy smiled and said, "Yes, Lily, it's a very pretty shell. Let's keep it safe." Lily saw the water wave at her. She wanted to play with the water. She said, "Mommy, I want to play with the water!" Her mommy held her hand, and they walked to the water. The water was cold and fun. Lily and her mommy splashed and laughed. They had a great day at the beach. When they went home, Lily put her beautiful shell on her shelf. She would always remember her fun day with her mommy.

Once there was a cat named Bundles who loved to bounce. Every day he would bounce around the house, up and down the stairs, and even outside. One day, Bundles decided he wanted some yogurt, so he hopped up to the kitchen. Unfortunately, the kitchen was a bit too rough for Bundles, and he ended up slipping on a tile and bouncing out the window. Downstairs, Bundles heard a surprised voice. "Hey, what happened there?" asked the voice. Bundles looked up, and saw a big dog staring down at him. Bundles was so scared that he just kept bouncing to try and run away from the dog. But no matter how much he bounced, the dog kept getting closer. The dog finally caught up to Bundles and said, "Hey buddy, what have you learned today?" Bundles was so scared that he couldn't say anything. But, in his heart, he knew what the moral of the story was: don't be tempted by things that are too dangerous, or else you might get into trouble. The moral of the story was clear, but it was too late for Bundles. The dog had already caught him and he never made it back inside.

Once upon a time, there was a big cat and a small mouse. They lived in a house. The cat hated the mouse because the mouse always took his food. The mouse was very fast and smooth. The cat could not catch the mouse. One day, the cat found a magic box. The box gave the cat power. The cat was very happy. The cat thought, "Now I can catch the mouse!" The cat tried to use the power to catch the mouse, but the mouse was still too smooth and fast. The cat was sad. A wise owl saw the cat and said, "Do not hate the mouse. Be friends with the mouse." The cat listened to the owl. The cat and the mouse became friends. They shared the food and played together. The cat was happy and did not need the power anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a bossy cat named Max. Max liked to speed around the yard and play with his friends. One day, Max found a bottle of lotion in the grass. He thought it was a toy, so he played with it. Max's friend, a little bird named Sam, saw Max playing with the lotion. "Max, don't play with that!" Sam said. "It's not a toy!" But Max was bossy and didn't listen to Sam. He kept playing with the lotion, running and speeding around the yard. As Max played, the lotion spilled all over the yard. Max and Sam didn't see it, and they slipped on the lotion. They both fell down and got hurt. Max wished he had listened to Sam. The end.

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to travel on their bikes. They go to different places and see new things. One day, they travel to the park. They see a big pond with ducks and fish. They see a slide and swings. They see a candy stand. "Look, Mia! Candy!" Tom says. He likes candy very much. He wants to buy some. "Me too, Tom! Candy!" Mia says. She likes candy too. She wants to buy some. They go to the candy stand. They see many kinds of candy. They see lollipops, gummies, chocolates, and more. They see a big jar of sugar. The sugar is white and shiny. It looks like snow. "Wow, sugar!" Tom says. He wants to try some. "Wow, sugar!" Mia says. She wants to try some too. They ask the candy man for some sugar. The candy man smiles. He gives them each a spoon of sugar. He says, "Be careful, kids. The sugar is very cool. It will make your tongue cold." Tom and Mia put the sugar in their mouths. They feel the sugar melt. They feel the coolness. They feel a tingling sensation. They giggle. "Ha ha, cool!" Tom says. "Ha ha, cool!" Mia says. They like the sugar. They thank the candy man. They buy some more candy. They travel back home on their bikes. They are happy. They share their candy with their families. They tell them about the cool sugar. They have a sweet day.

Once upon a time there was an elephant. He wanted to have a scrub, so he went to look for a pool of water. He found a big body of water and quickly went in. The water was thick and it felt nice to rub. He splashed around and rubbed his back. He could feel all his itches disappearing. Suddenly, he heard a voice, "You'd better watch out. I have to warn you about the monster in this lake!" The elephant was a bit scared. He wasn't sure what to do. He asked the voice, "What kind of monster?" But the voice had gone. The elephant was alone in the thick water. He tried to go, but he couldn't move. Then all of a sudden, something grabbed him! He was so scared! Suddenly he heard the voice again, "It's just me! The monster!" What the elephant didn't know was that the voice was his friend, the crocodile. He had set up a surprise for the elephant. He had pretended to be a monster. The elephant laughed and splashed around with his friend. Together they rubbed in the thick water until they were all clean.

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to the park with her mom. Lucy saw a big, interesting horn on the ground. She picked it up and showed it to her mom. "Mom, can I keep this horn? It's so interesting!" she asked. Her mom said, "No, Lucy, we don't know where it came from. It might be dirty. Let's leave it here." But Lucy insisted, "Please, mom, I really want it!" Her mom finally agreed, but told her to be careful with it. Lucy played with the horn all day, and she found out that when she blew into it, animals would come to her. She blew the horn, and a little dog came running. She blew it again, and a big bird flew down. Lucy was so happy, but she also learned that it was important to listen to her mom. Sometimes, things we want can be fun, but we should still be careful.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom loved to play chess with his friends. They would come to his house and sit on the floor to play. One day, Tom was playing chess with his best friend, Sam. Tom was winning, but then he accidentally knocked over his chess pieces. "Oh no!" Tom said. He felt sorry for making a mess. Sam smiled and said, "That's okay! We can fix it together." So, Tom and Sam put the chess pieces back on the board. They were happy to play again. And from that day on, Tom was more careful when he played chess with his friends. They all had lots of fun and always came back to play more.

Once upon a time, there was a cheerful frog named Bob. Bob lived near a big barrel. He liked to jump and play around the barrel all day. One day, a big bird came to the barrel. The bird wanted to take the barrel away from Bob. Bob did not want to lose his barrel. He thought, "I must stop the bird." So, Bob jumped high and snapped at the bird with his mouth. The bird was scared and flew away. Bob was happy that he saved his barrel. From that day, Bob learned that it's important to stand up for what you love. He continued to play near his barrel, always ready to protect it. And the other animals in the forest learned from Bob's brave act, too. They all lived happily and played together, knowing they could stand up for themselves.

One day, a little girl named Sue found a big, red button. She did not know what it did, but it looked incredible. Sue wanted to show it to her friend Tom. She went to his house and said, "Look what I found, Tom! It's a big red button!" Tom looked at the button and thought it was incredible too. He asked Sue, "What does it do?" Sue did not know, so she told Tom, "I don't know, but let's press it and see what happens!" They pressed the button together. Suddenly, the sky turned dark and it started to rain. The rain was not just water, but also mud! The mud rain made everything dirty. Sue and Tom were sad because the incredible button made a big mess. Sue and Tom went back inside and tried to clean up the mud. They worked very hard, but the mess was too big. They could not clean it all. Sue and Tom were very sad because their fun day turned into a bad day. They wished they never pressed the incredible button.

Once upon a time, a child named Tim went to the park. Tim thought the park was boring. He wanted to find something fun to do. So, he walked and walked, looking for something new. Then, Tim saw a big, funny-looking rock. He thought it was not boring. Tim touched the rock, and something unexpected happened! The rock moved and made a loud noise. Tim jumped back, scared. The big rock was not a rock at all! It was a big, friendly turtle. The turtle said, "Hello, Tim!" Tim was not bored anymore. He and the turtle played all day, and they were very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy. She had a big box with a pretty wrap on it. Amy was very happy because it was her birthday. She wanted to open the box and see what was inside. Amy looked at the box and saw a label with her name on it. She knew it was for her. She took off the wrap and opened the box. Inside the box, she found a soft, mild teddy bear. The teddy bear was so nice to hug and cuddle. Amy loved her new teddy bear. She took it with her everywhere she went. They played together, ate together, and slept together. Amy and her teddy bear were the best of friends, and they lived happily ever after.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a vest in his yard. He liked the vest a lot. It was blue and soft. Tim wanted to keep the vest, but he did not want his friends to take it. So, he decided to bury it in the ground. Tim dug a hole and put the vest inside. Then, he covered it with dirt. Later, Tim's friend, Sue, came over to play. Sue saw the spot where Tim buried the vest. "What's that?" she asked. Tim felt dizzy because he was scared Sue would find his vest. "Oh, it's just a hole," he said, trying to hide the truth. But Sue was curious. She started to dig in the hole. Tim tried to stop her, but it was too late. Sue found the vest and pulled it out. "Hey, this is a nice vest!" she said. Tim was sad and worried that Sue would take the vest away. But then, Sue smiled and said, "Let's share it. We can both wear the vest when we play together." Tim was happy, and they both played with the vest all day.

Once upon a time, there was a warm day. A little girl named Lily went to the park. She saw a big fountain. The water in the fountain went up and down. Lily liked to watch the water. One day, Lily saw a small fish in the fountain. The fish was sad. Lily wanted to help the fish. She had an idea. She would turn the fountain off and put the fish in a pond. Lily found a big cup. She put the fish in the cup. She walked to the pond. But when she got to the pond, the fish was gone! Lily was sad. She looked in the cup and saw a pretty stone. The fish turned into a stone! Lily put the stone in the pond. She saw the fish again. The fish was happy. Lily was happy too.

One day, a curious little boy named Tim went outside to play. He saw a big bowl of salad on the table. Tim thought it was strange to see salad outside. He decided to examine the salad to see what was in it. As Tim looked at the salad, he saw a tiny bug. The bug looked at Tim and said, "Hello! My name is Buzz. I like to eat salad. Can I have some?" Tim was very surprised that the bug could talk. He said, "Yes, you can have some salad, Buzz." Just then, Tim's mom came outside. She saw Tim talking to the bug and the salad. She was so surprised that the salad started to float in the air! Tim, Buzz, and Tim's mom all laughed and had a fun time eating the salad together.

Once upon a time there lived a kind king. The king smiled at everyone he met and made people feel happy. One day, something bad happened to the kind king. He felt very hurt. The king didn't know how to make the hurt go away. He tried many things but nothing worked. So the king decided to take a long walk. As he walked, he noticed something wonderful. He saw a rising sun, trees blowing in the wind and a stream that splashed in the air. As he watched, the hurt started to go away. The sun became higher and the king stopped walking. He knew his long walk had come to an end. He looked up and smiled. Even though he was still hurt, the kind king was glad that the hurt was ending. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim liked to play with his toy weapon. It was a big, red sword. One day, Tim went to the park to play with his friends. At the park, Tim met his friend, Sam. Sam saw Tim's toy weapon and said, "Wow, that's a cool sword! Can I play with it?" Tim said, "Sure, but be careful. We don't want to hurt anyone." As they played, Tim and Sam pretended to be brave knights. They fought the bad guys and saved the day. When they were done, they were very tired. Tim said, "Let's go home now. It's getting late." On their way home, they saw a dead bug on the ground. Tim and Sam looked at it and felt sad. They decided to give the bug a nice place to rest. They dug a small hole and put the bug inside. Then, they closed the hole with dirt. Tim and Sam went home feeling happy. They had a fun day playing and even helped a little bug. They couldn't wait to play together again.

Once upon a time, there was a little bell in a big tree. It was a harmless bell, and it made a nice sound when the wind blew. One day, a small boy named Tim walked by the tree. He heard the bell and looked up. "Hi, bell!" Tim said. "Why are you in the tree?" The bell answered, "I am here to make music for everyone." Tim wanted to taste the bell, so he climbed the tree. When he got to the top, he found a big, red apple next to the bell. He tasted the apple, and it was the best apple he had ever eaten. Just then, the bell started to ring loudly. Tim was surprised! The bell said, "I am not just a harmless bell, I am also a magic bell! Since you found my secret apple, I will give you a wish." Tim wished for more apples to share with his friends. The tree was filled with apples, and they all lived happily ever after.

Once there was a cute little bunny called Bob. Bob loved to play all day, but one day he had a problem. Bob's mother asked him to eat his broccoli, but Bob didn't want to. Bob was feeling naughty, so he decided to hide the broccoli. He put it in the cupboard and closed it tight. But Bob didn't know that his nosy neighbor, Mrs Rabbit, was watching him. Mrs Rabbit asked Bob, “What are you hiding?” Bob was scared so he didn't answer. Mrs Rabbit was very kind and said to Bob, “We all have to do things that we don't like, sometimes. Don't forget that!” Finally, Bob understood the moral of the story. He opened the cupboard and ate all his broccoli. He learned that it's always better to be honest, no matter what. Bob was proud of himself.

One day, a penguin found a box. It was from an unknown place. The penguin was very curious. He wanted to know what was inside the box. He tried to open it, but it was too hard. So, he asked his friend, the seal, for help. "Seal, can you help me open this box?" the penguin asked. The seal tried to help, but the box was still too hard to open. They needed a key to open it. The penguin and the seal looked around for the key, but they could not find it. Then, the penguin had an idea. "I will mail a letter to ask for help," he said. So, he wrote a letter and put it in a mailbox. After some time, a bird came with a key. The penguin and the seal were very happy. The penguin used the key to open the box. Inside, they found a big, soft blanket. The penguin and the seal were so happy. They shared the blanket and played with it all day. They knew that asking for help was a good idea.

One day, a little girl named Lily found a beautiful coat. The coat was red and blue with big buttons. She put it on and felt very warm and happy. Lily showed her new coat to her friend, Tom. Tom said, "Wow, your coat is very pretty!" Lily smiled and said, "Thank you! I love my coat." They played outside, and Lily's coat kept her warm all day. When it was time to go home, Lily said goodbye to Tom. She wore her beautiful coat every day, and everyone said how nice it looked. Lily was so happy to have found her special coat.

Once upon a time there was a nice furry bear. He wanted to include his friends in a fun adventure, so he asked them to come with him. The furry bear and his friends had a great time. They ran through the forest, jumped over big logs, and swam in the river. While they were swimming, the furry bear noticed a big rock. He decided to include it in the adventure. He hopped up on the rock and the other animals followed. At the top of the rock they could see far into the distance. The view was so nice! They all waved to a funny looking bird that was flying in the sky. The furry bear and his friends were so happy that they had included the big rock in their adventure. They loved it and knew that they would do it again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a zebra named Zara. Zara loved to run and play in the mud. One day, she got very dirty. Her black and white stripes were all brown from the mud. Zara's mommy looked at her and said, "Oh, Zara! You are so dirty! Let's go to the river and get clean." At the river, Zara saw a big rock. She wanted to jump on it. But when she tried, her foot slipped on the wet grass. "Ouch!" cried Zara. "I slipped and it hurts!" Her mommy came to help her. "Be careful, Zara. The grass is wet and can make you slip," said her mommy. Zara and her mommy went into the river to wash off the dirty mud. They splashed and played until Zara was clean again. Her black and white stripes were shiny and bright. Zara promised her mommy that she would be more careful when playing in the mud. And they both walked home, happy and clean.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. She was only three years old. Jane was very competitive and often competed with her brother to see who was best at playing games. One day, Jane and her brother were playing in the garden. They were running after each other, when Jane saw a plant. She thought it was a special flower, so she decided to poke it with her finger. But when she poked the flower the air filled with a horrible smell – it was poison! Jane was so scared that she quickly backed away. Her brother smiled at her and said, “Don’t worry Jane. You were just being competitive and trying to be the best.” Jane and her brother ran away, happy that they were safe. And they never poked a poisonous flower ever again!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. Lily liked to bake. She also had a toy called Microscope. Microscope was a flexible toy that could bend and twist. One day, Lily decided to bake a cake. She put all the things she needed in a big bowl. Microscope wanted to help too. So, Microscope used its flexible body to mix the cake mix in the bowl. When the cake was done, Lily and Microscope shared it. It was yummy! They were happy and had fun. From that day on, Lily and Microscope baked more cakes together.

Once upon a time, there was a gentle cat. The cat was very soft and nice. One day, the cat found a sock. The sock was big and red. The cat thought the sock was fun to play with. The cat played with the sock all day. It would jump on the sock and then run away. The cat was having so much fun. But soon, the cat got tired. It needed a place to rest and sleep. So, the gentle cat made a sack with the big red sock. The cat climbed into the sack and curled up. It was a warm and cozy place to sleep. The cat had sweet dreams and slept all night long. And that is how the gentle cat found a new home.

One day, a little car named Zoomy went to the park. Zoomy loved to zoom around and play with his friends. He saw his friend, a big truck named Trucko, near the swings. Zoomy zoomed over to say hi. "Hi Trucko! Want to play?" Zoomy asked. Trucko smiled and said, "Yes! Let's have an amazing race!" They got ready and started to zoom around the park. Zoomy was fast, but Trucko was big and strong. As they raced, they saw a wreck near the slide. A little bike named Biko had fallen down. Zoomy and Trucko stopped their race and went to help. "Are you okay, Biko?" asked Zoomy. Biko was sad but said, "Yes, I am okay. Thank you for helping me." Zoomy and Trucko helped Biko stand up. They all became friends and played together in the park. They had an amazing day, zooming around and helping each other. And from that day on, they always played together and helped their friends when they needed it.

Once upon a time, there was a kind girl named Lily. She lived in a small house with her mom, dad, and little dog, Max. Lily liked to play with Max in the sunny yard. She also liked to help her mom and dad with things around the house. One day, Lily's mom got some news. Her grandma was sick and needed help. Lily's mom had to go and help grandma. Lily wanted to do something nice for her grandma too. So, she thought of a plan. Lily made a pretty card with crayons and paper. She drew a big heart and a happy sun on the card. Then, she asked her dad to send the card to grandma. When grandma got the card, she felt very happy. The kind act from Lily made her feel better. And they all lived happily ever after.

One day, a tall man named Tom wanted to ride his motorcycle. He put on his helmet and went outside. His motorcycle was big and shiny. He was excited to ride it. Before he could go, his little friend, Tim, came running. Tim said, "Wait, Tom! I want to read you a story." Tom smiled and said, "Okay, let's read the story together." They sat under a tree and Tim read the story out loud. It was about a cat and a dog who were best friends. When the story was done, Tom said, "That was a nice story, Tim. Thank you for reading it to me." Tim smiled and said, "You're welcome, Tom. Have fun riding your motorcycle." Tom waved goodbye and rode away on his motorcycle, thinking about the story and his good friend Tim.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there lived a girl named Lily. She had a small garden where she grew herbs. Every day, she would water her herbs and watch them grow. One day, a tiny bird came to visit Lily's garden. The bird was hungry and asked Lily if it could eat some of her herbs. Lily said yes, and the bird ate some herbs. The bird was happy and flew away. The next day, the bird came back with many more birds. They all asked Lily if they could eat some herbs too. Lily said yes, but the birds ate all her herbs! Now, Lily had no more herbs left in her garden. She was very sad and learned that sometimes it is better to say no.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Julie. She was very clever. Julie loved to help her mom with her baking. One day her mom was making cookies. She put them in the oven and set the timer. “How long do we wait, mom?” asked Julie. “Ten minutes,” said her mom. But after five minutes, Julie said, “The timer is done. Let’s check the cookies.” Julie opened the oven and was very pleased. The cookies had increased in size. She was so proud of herself. “You are so clever, Julie,” said her mom. The cookies were delicious and Julie smiled. She was happy to help with the baking.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lucy. She was three years old and very excited to explore the garden. As she looked around, she saw a knot in front of a big tree. It looked like someone had tied it but she couldn't make it undone. She asked her mum, "Mummy, can we solve the knot?" Mum said, "Yes we can, but we'll have to be careful and gentle". Lucy thought for a moment and then started to pull. Suddenly, the knot came undone. Lucy felt a sense of accomplishment and said, "I solved it!" Mum smiled and said, "Well done Lucy! Now let's find a comfortable place to rest". As Lucy settled down, she looked back up at the knot and she realised that solving the knot had untied a second even bigger knot. She looked up the tree and thought, "What could that have been?". Mum smiled and said, "I guess you'll have to come back tomorrow to solve it and find out". The next day, Lucy and mum came back to the tree excited to find out what was inside the knot. Lucy slowly pulled at the strings and eventually, the knot opened up and hundreds of colourful flowers poured out. Lucy was amazed and exclaimed, "Wow! I solved another knot!" Lucy's mum hugged her and said, "This time

Once upon a time, in a big green field, there was a little daisy. The daisy was very pretty and had lots of friends. They all lived together in the field and were very happy. One day, a loyal dog came to play in the field. The dog was big and liked to run and jump. The dog saw the daisy and thought it looked fun to taste. So, the dog bent down and gave the daisy a little lick. The daisy didn't mind being tasted by the loyal dog. The dog and the daisy became friends. They played in the field every day, and the loyal dog would always come back to visit the daisy. They had lots of fun together, and they were happy.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big star in the sky. Anna says, "Look, Ben, a star! I want to make a wish." Ben says, "What do you wish for, Anna?" Anna thinks for a moment. She says, "I wish I could become a princess. Then I could wear a pretty dress and a crown and live in a castle." Ben says, "That sounds fun, Anna. But I wish I could become a superhero. Then I could fly and help people and fight bad guys." They close their eyes and wish hard. They hope the star will hear them. But nothing happens. They open their eyes and see that they are still in the park. They are still Anna and Ben. They feel sad. Anna says, "Maybe the star did not hear us. Maybe our wishes are too big." Ben says, "Maybe we should wish for something else. Something that we can do now." Anna says, "Like what, Ben?" Ben says, "Like playing on the swings. Or having a snack. Or giving each other a hug." Anna smiles. She says, "That sounds good, Ben. I like those things. And I like you." Ben smiles too. He says, "I like you too, Anna. You are my friend." They run to the swings and play. They share a snack and a hug. They forget about their wishes. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a large dog named Spot. Spot loved to play outside. One sunny day, Spot was playing in the park with his best friend, a little boy named Tim. Tim and Spot played near the water. They got very wet. Tim's mom said, "Let's use a towel to get dry." She took out a big, soft towel. Spot and Tim trusted her, so they let her dry them off with the towel. After they were dry, Tim and Spot went back to playing. They had so much fun in the park. When it was time to go home, Spot and Tim knew they could always trust each other and the big, soft towel.

Once upon a time, there was a big cliff near a small town. On top of the cliff, there was a little bird named Tim. Tim was ready to learn how to fly. One sunny day, Tim's mom said, "Tim, it's time to enjoy flying!" Tim was scared, but his mom said, "Don't worry, I'll be with you." So, Tim and his mom jumped off the cliff and started to fly. As they flew, Tim began to enjoy the feeling of the wind in his wings. He said, "Mom, I love flying!" His mom smiled and said, "I knew you would!" And they flew happily together in the sky.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who lived by the sea. She would love to go down to the beach and explore the shore. One day, she saw something shiny and sparkling in the sand. She was so excited when she saw it was a tiny golden key. She picked up the key and held it tight in her hand. The girl then noticed a man walking towards her. He had a big smile on his face. She asked the man, "What is this key for?" He shrugged and said, "Only you can tell". The girl went off, full of curiosity. She looked around and tried different places. She tried locks on the gate to the park, but none of them fit the key. Finally, she noticed an old chest that was open. She quickly inserted the key and heard a click. Inside the chest, she found a great treasure. The girl was so happy and excited with her new treasure. She knew it was the perfect souvenir from her beach adventure. She thanked the man who had shrugged before and waved goodbye to him.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Fin. He lived in a big sea with many other fish. One day, Fin saw a big wave coming near him. He was scared. The wave was so big and strong. Fin swam fast to his friend, a kind octopus named Ollie. Ollie had many useful arms. Fin asked Ollie for help. Ollie used his long arms to hold Fin safe. Together, they rode the big wave. After the wave was gone, Fin said sorry to Ollie for being scared. Ollie smiled and said, "I forgive you, Fin. We all get scared sometimes." They swam happily together, knowing they would always help each other.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a fit boy who loved to run and play with his friends. One day, while playing, Tim fell down and hurt his knee. It was bleeding, and he started to cry. Tim's mom heard him cry and came running to help him. She said, "Oh no, Tim! Your knee is hurt. I recommend we put a bandage on it to make it feel better." Tim nodded, still crying a little. Tim's mom went inside their house and came back with a bandage. She carefully put it on Tim's knee, and Tim stopped crying. He felt better already. Tim said, "Thank you, Mom. The bandage is helping." Tim's mom smiled and said, "You're welcome, my brave boy. Now, you can go back to playing with your friends. Just be careful not to fall again." And Tim did just that, playing happily for the rest of the day.
