Tim said, "I want to reach that rock first!" Sue said, "No, I will reach it first!" They both ran to the rock. But when they got there, they saw a frog sitting on the rock. It was a surprise! The frog said, "Hello, I am a magic frog. If you share the smooth rock, I will give you a wish." Tim and Sue looked at each other and said, "We will share the rock." They made a wish and the magic frog gave them a big bag of candy. They were very happy and played by the river all day.

Once upon a time, there was a little cat named Kitty. Kitty loved to spring and play all day. One day, Kitty saw a big dish of delicious food on the table. She wanted to eat it, but it was too high for her to reach. Kitty tried to spring up to the dish, but she could not jump high enough. She felt sad and hungry. She knew she needed help, so she asked her friend, Birdie. Birdie was good at flying high. Kitty thought Birdie could help her get the delicious food. Birdie flew up and pushed the dish off the table. It fell on the floor, and Kitty could now eat the delicious food. Kitty was so happy and thanked Birdie. They both ate the food and played together all day. From that day on, Kitty and Birdie were best friends and always helped each other.

Once upon a time, in a charming little house, there lived a girl named Lily. Lily loved to eat many things, but her favorite was grapes. Every day, she would ask her mom for a big bowl of grapes to eat. One day, Lily wanted to have a fun party with her friends. She asked her mom to help her plan the party. They made a list of things to include for the party. The list had balloons, games, and, of course, grapes! When the party day came, Lily and her friends had a great time. They played games, laughed, and ate lots of grapes. Everyone loved the charming party that Lily and her mom had planned together. And from that day on, Lily always included grapes in all her parties.

Once upon a time, there was a small, nosy cat named Fluffy. Fluffy loved to climb. Every day, Fluffy would climb up and down trees, chairs, and tables. Fluffy was very good at climbing. One sunny day, Fluffy saw a tall tree with a big bird on top. Fluffy wanted to say hello to the bird. So, Fluffy began to climb the tree. The tree was very, very tall. Fluffy climbed higher and higher. As Fluffy climbed, a girl named Lily saw him. Lily was wearing a pretty dress with a ribbon around her waist. Lily called out, "Fluffy, be careful!" Fluffy looked down and saw Lily. Fluffy climbed down the tree and jumped into Lily's arms. They were both happy and went to play in the park.

The boy was feeling helpless. He was standing at his mother's refrigerator and he wanted a snack, but he was too small to reach the food. He sighed and he stepped away. All of a sudden, he started to giggle. He had a brilliant idea! He ran off and found some boxes. After a lot of hard work, he had stacked them up beneath the refrigerator. Now he could reach the snack he wanted! But the stack of boxes was shaky! Suddenly, it started to wobble, and the boy felt scared. He watched as the boxes started to drop, one by one, until finally, they all crashed onto the floor! But the boy was happy again because he had hoped to get a snack and now he could!

Once upon a time, there was a friendly girl named Lily. Lily loved to look at things through her microscope. One day, she found a tiny bug and wanted to see it up close. Lily said to the bug, "Hello, little bug! I want to see you better. Let's use my microscope." The bug was scared but Lily was nice, so it agreed. They went to the microscope and tried to make the bug fit on the glass. But, Lily was not careful. When she tried to make the bug fit, she pressed too hard. The bug was hurt and could not be friends with Lily anymore. Lily was sad because she did not want to hurt the bug. She learned to be more careful with her friends.

Once upon a time, there was an intelligent bird named Blue. Blue loved to fly and collect shiny things. One day, while Blue was flying, he saw a shiny mineral on the ground. Blue flew down and said, "Wow! Look at this shiny mineral! I want to take it to my nest." As Blue picked up the mineral, a little mouse named Tiny came out from the grass. "Hi Blue," said Tiny. "That's a pretty mineral you have there. Can I see it?" Blue let Tiny look at the mineral. But then, something unexpected happened. The mineral started to glow! Blue and Tiny were surprised. The glowing mineral made them feel happy and they became best friends. They decided to keep the special mineral together and share the happiness with others.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom loved to watch films with his mom and dad. His favorite film was about a big, strong superhero who would save helpless animals. One day, Tom saw a little cat stuck in a tree. The cat was helpless and could not get down. Tom wanted to be like the superhero in his favorite film. He found a long rope and tried to tie it to the tree. Tom pulled and pulled on the rope, but he was too small to reach the cat. Just then, his mom and dad came outside. They saw Tom trying to help the helpless cat. Together, they all tied the rope to the tree and saved the cat. Tom was so happy, and he felt like a superhero, just like in his favorite film.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to paint. Her mommy gave her a new paint set. Lily was very happy. She knew something yummy was coming. One day, Lily painted a big cake. It was a yummy cake with pink and blue. She showed her mommy. Her mommy smiled and said, "Wait until tomorrow." Lily was excited. The next day, Lily saw a big box. She opened it. Inside was a real yummy cake! It looked just like her paint. Her mommy replaced the paint with a real cake. Lily and her mommy laughed and ate the yummy cake. They were very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to help people. One day, Tim went to a restaurant with his mom and dad. The restaurant was unknown to them. They had never been there before. At the restaurant, Tim saw an old man who needed help. The old man was carrying a big tray of food. Tim wanted to help the old man, so he took the tray from him. But Tim was too small to carry the big tray. The tray was very heavy and Tim dropped it. All the food fell on the floor. The old man, Tim's mom and dad, and everyone in the restaurant were sad. The food was all gone, and they could not eat. Tim felt bad because he wanted to help, but instead, he made a big mess.

Once upon a time, there was a wild cat named Tom. Tom was an honest cat who lived in a big forest. He had many friends who liked to play with him. One day, Tom and his friend, a small bird named Sue, went to play near the river. Sue said, "Tom, let's play catch!" Tom nodded and they started to play. As they were playing, Sue flew too close to the water and fell in. Tom saw this and started to panic. He didn't know how to swim. Tom yelled, "Help! Sue is in the water!" A big frog named Fred heard Tom's cry for help. He quickly jumped into the water and saved Sue. Tom and Sue thanked Fred for being so brave. From that day on, they all became the best of friends and played together in the forest.

Once upon a time, there was a big, honest dog named Max. Max liked to spend his days playing with his ball and eating tasty soup. The soup was made by his friend, a kind girl named Lily. Lily and Max were best friends and spent a lot of time together. One sunny day, Max and Lily were playing in the park. Max was running after his ball, and Lily was laughing. Suddenly, Max saw a big bowl of soup on the ground. Max was very hungry and wanted to eat the soup. But, he knew it was not his soup. Max was an honest dog and did not want to take something that was not his. Just then, a small, shy cat came out from behind a tree. The cat said, "I made this soup for you, Max, because I want to be your friend too." Max was very surprised but also very happy. He shared the soup with the cat and Lily. From that day on, Max, Lily, and the cat spent their days playing together and eating soup in the park. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, in a little wood, there lived a deaf bunny. The bunny liked to roll and play all day. Her best friend was a bird who lived in a tree nearby. One day, the bird said to the bunny, "Let's play a new game today!" The bunny just smiled, but she did not hear what the bird said. The bird knew the bunny was deaf, so she showed the bunny the game. They started to roll together, faster and faster. As they were rolling, they found a big, shiny ball. They had never seen anything like it before. The bird and the bunny looked at each other and smiled. They rolled the shiny ball all around the wood, playing and laughing. And from that day on, they had a new, fun game to play together.

Once upon a time, in a big tree, there was a hive. Many bees lived in the hive. They worked hard every day to make honey. One day, a wise old bee wanted to mail a letter to his friend. The wise old bee asked a little bee to help him. The little bee was happy to help. The little bee took the letter and flew to the mail box. He put the letter inside and went back to the hive. The wise old bee was happy and gave the little bee some sweet honey. They both enjoyed the honey and were good friends.

One day, a little dog named Max went out to play. It was a hot, sunny day, and Max was having an amazing time. He ran and jumped in the park, feeling very happy. After a while, Max got thirsty, so he went to the pond to drink some water. Max saw his friend, a duck named Daisy, swimming in the pond. Daisy said, "Hi, Max! Do you want to swim with me?" Max thought it was a good idea, so he jumped in the water. They splashed and played together, having lots of fun. But soon, Max started to feel cold and wet. Max got out of the pond and said to Daisy, "I need to get dry now. I'm too wet." Daisy told Max about a special operation. She said, "If you sit in the sun, it will make you dry." Max did what Daisy said, and soon he was dry and warm again. Max thanked Daisy and they continued to play together, happy and dry.

Lily and Ben are twins. They like to play in the park with their mom and dad. They like to swing, slide and run. They are very happy. One day, they see a big truck in the park. The truck has a long arm and a big scoop. The truck is digging a hole in the ground. Lily and Ben are curious. They want to see what the truck is doing. They run to the truck and ask the man who is driving it. "What are you doing, mister?" they say. The man smiles and says, "I am working, kids. I am making a new pond for the ducks and the fish. Do you like ducks and fish?" Lily and Ben nod. They like ducks and fish. They think the pond will be nice. The man says, "Working is hard, but it is good. It makes me strong and happy. Do you know what else makes me strong and happy?" Lily and Ben shake their heads. They do not know. The man says, "Eating good food makes me strong and happy. Food gives me energy to work. Do you know what food is good for you?" Lily and Ben think. They say, "Fruits and vegetables are good for us. They make our stomachs happy. And milk and cheese are good for us. They make our bones strong." The man nods. He says, "You are right, kids. Fruits, vegetables, milk and cheese are good for you. And so are meat, eggs, bread and water. They give you protein, carbs and fluids. Do you know what those are?" Lily and Ben shake their heads. They do not know. The man says, "They are things that help your body grow and work. You need them every day. But you also need something else. Do you know what that is?" Lily and Ben think. They say, "Love?" The man smiles. He says, "Yes, love. Love is the best thing for you. Love makes you happy and healthy. Love comes from your mom and dad, your family and friends, and from yourself. Do you love yourself?" Lily and Ben nod. They say, "Yes, we love ourselves. And we love you, mister. Thank you for working and making the pond." The man hugs them. He says, "You are welcome, kids. And thank you for loving me. You are very sweet and smart. Now, go and play. Have fun. And remember to eat well and love yourself." Lily and Ben wave goodbye. They run back to their mom and dad. They tell them about the truck and the pond and the food and the love. They are very happy.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the store with his mom. The store was big and had many things. Tim liked to look at all the toys and games. But today, the store was empty. There were no other people there. Tim felt a bit sad. "Mom, why is the store empty?" Tim asked. His mom looked around and said, "I don't know, Tim. Maybe everyone is at home today." Tim and his mom walked around the store. They found a big bag with a long zip. Tim liked to play with zips, so he asked his mom if he could have it. His mom said yes, and they went to pay for it. At home, Tim played with the zip on the big bag. He opened and closed it again and again. He put his toys in the bag and zipped it up. Then he opened it and took them out. Tim was happy with his new bag, even though the store was empty that day.

One day, a hairy dog went for a walk. He saw a big temple. The temple was very big and tall. The dog wanted to go inside and see what was there. He walked up to the door and pushed it open with his nose. Inside the temple, the dog saw a big cat. The cat was very big and had long hair. The dog was not sure what to do. He did not know if the cat was nice or mean. The dog thought for a moment and then decided to shrug his shoulders and walk up to the cat. As the dog got closer to the cat, something unexpected happened. The cat turned around and it was not a cat at all! It was a big, friendly bear! The bear smiled at the dog and said, "Come play with me!" The dog was very happy to find a new friend and they played together all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a nosy cat named Tom. Tom liked to know what everyone was doing. One day, Tom saw a big mist in the forest. He wanted to find out what it was. So, he walked into the mist. Tom met a bird in the mist. The bird said, "Don't go in the mist, it is not safe." But Tom did not listen. He disagreed with the bird. He thought he knew better. Tom kept walking into the mist. As Tom went deeper into the mist, he got lost. He could not find his way back home. He called for help, but no one could hear him. The nosy cat stayed lost in the mist forever.

One day, a little girl named Ann found a big eraser. It was pink and soft. She was very glad because she liked to draw and needed an eraser. She picked it up and thought it was heavy. Ann wanted to know how much it weighed. Ann went to her friend, Tom, who had a toy scale. She asked Tom, "Can you help me weigh my eraser?" Tom said, "Yes, I can help you!" They put the eraser on the scale and saw that it weighed five toy blocks. Ann and Tom were happy to know how much the eraser weighed. Ann and Tom used the eraser to fix their drawings. They drew happy faces, flowers, and trees. They were glad they had the eraser to make their drawings perfect. Ann and Tom played and drew all day, having fun with their new eraser.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there was a soft bunny named Ben. Ben had a lot of friends. They liked to play all day. One day, Ben and his friends saw a little bird stuck in a tree. "Help me, please!" said the bird. Ben knew he had to save the bird. He thought of a plan. He told his friends to find a long stick. They found the stick and Ben used it to help the bird get down from the tree. The bird was so happy. As the year went by, Ben and the bird became best friends. They played together every day. One day, Ben got stuck in a hole. He was scared. The bird remembered how Ben saved her. She flew to get help. Soon, all their friends came to save Ben. They pulled him out of the hole. Ben was happy and thanked his friends. They all learned that when you help others, they will help you too.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Billy. Billy was different from the other birds because he had big, colorful wings. One day, Billy was flying around when he saw his friend, Timmy the squirrel. Timmy told Billy about the pretty sunrise he saw that morning. He mentioned that it was the most beautiful thing he had ever seen. Billy wanted to see the sunrise too, so he asked Timmy to show him where it was. The next morning, Billy and Timmy woke up very early. They went to the top of a big hill and waited for the sunrise. When the sun came up, it was so bright and pretty. Billy and Timmy were very happy to see it together. From that day on, they always watched the sunrise together, and it made them the best of friends.

One day, a famous crab named Bob saw a big fish. The big fish said, "Let's race!" Bob the crab said, "Okay!" They started to race. Bob ran fast. The big fish swam fast. They went past a little house. They went past a big tree. They went past a small rock. Then, something unexpected happened. A bird came down and picked up the big fish. The big fish was scared. Bob the crab stopped racing and helped the big fish. The bird let go of the big fish. The big fish and Bob were happy. They did not finish the race, but they became good friends. They played together every day. And they lived happily ever after.

One day, a little bug named Tim wanted to play. He saw a long rope in the yard. Tim thought it would be fun to crawl on the rope. So, he went to the rope and started to crawl. He crawled up and down, and he had a lot of fun. Tim's friend, the bird, saw him on the rope. The bird said, "Tim, that is a stupid game. Let's play something else." But Tim liked to crawl on the rope. He did not want to stop. The bird tried to play with Tim on the rope. But the bird was too big. The bird felt silly and flew away. Tim kept crawling on the rope. He was happy to play his game, even if it was a little stupid.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily was very sleepy, but she wanted to go to the store with her mom. So, Lily put on her shoes and walked with her mom to the store. At the store, Lily saw a big shelf with a toy she wanted. But the toy was too high for her to reach. She tried to reach and reach, but she just couldn't get it. Lily felt sad and asked her mom, "Mom, can you help me get the toy?" Her mom smiled and said, "Of course, Lily!" Her mom reached up and got the toy for her. Lily was so happy and thanked her mom. They bought the toy and went back home. When they got home, Lily played with her new toy for a little while. But she was still very sleepy. Her mom said, "Lily, it's time for a nap." Lily agreed and went to her room. Lily went to bed, hugged her new toy, and fell fast asleep. She had a wonderful day with her mom and her new toy.

One day, a little brown dog went for a walk. He saw a big box. The box had a lock on it. The little brown dog wanted to unlock the box. He found a key and unlocked the box. Inside the box, he found a bubble wand. He wanted to blow bubbles. The little brown dog blew and blew, but no bubbles came out. Then, the little brown dog tried again. This time, when he blew, big bubbles came out. But something unexpected happened. The bubbles turned into big, bouncy balls! The little brown dog was so happy. He played with the bouncy balls all day long.

Tim and Lily are friends. They like to play in the park. Today, they have a plan. They want to keep some bugs in a jar. They look for bugs under the rocks, in the grass, and on the flowers. They find ants, beetles, and a caterpillar. They put them in the jar with some leaves and dirt. "Look, we have a lot of bugs!" Tim says. "Yes, they are so cool!" Lily says. "Let's make them march!" They shake the jar gently and watch the bugs move around. They pretend the bugs are soldiers. They sing a song: "Bugs, bugs, march, march, march! You are the best bugs in the park! Bugs, bugs, march, march, march! You have a long and fun walk!" They laugh and clap. They are happy. They love their bugs. They decide to keep them as pets. They make a home for them in a shoebox. They give them names and water and food. They are good friends to the bugs. The bugs are good friends to them.

One day, a nosy bird named Billy saw a big pitch. He wanted to play with his friends. So, he asked them, "Do you want to play on the pitch with me?" His friends said, "Yes, let's go!" They all went to the pitch and played. They had so much fun. They kicked the ball and ran around. But then, Billy saw a big pond near the pitch. Billy wanted to dive into the pond. He thought it would be fun. But his friend, Timmy the turtle, said, "No, Billy! It's not safe. You don't know how deep it is." Billy listened to Timmy and did not dive into the pond. They all went back to the pitch and played some more. They had a great day. The moral of the story is to always listen to your friends when they try to keep you safe.

One day, a little girl named Lily and her reliable dog, Max, went to the park. They saw a big pond with ducks. Lily and Max wanted to play with the ducks. They went close to the pond and saw the ducks splashing in the water. Lily said, "Max, let's splash in the water too!" Max barked and wagged his tail. They both jumped into the pond and splashed with the ducks. The ducks quacked, and Lily and Max laughed. After playing, they were hungry. Lily's mom had packed pasta for them. They sat under a tree and ate the pasta together. Lily said, "I love playing with you, Max!" Max barked happily, and they went home after a fun day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a man who liked to work. He wore a cap every day. One day, he met a foolish dog. The dog was very silly and liked to play. The man and the dog became friends. They would work and play together. The man would wear his cap, and the dog would wag its tail. One day, the foolish dog took the man's cap. The man laughed and chased the dog. They played all day. The man and the foolish dog were very happy.

One day, a famous dog named Max wanted to play. Max was a big, brown dog who liked to run and jump. He had many friends in the park. Max was so famous, he even had a special license with his name on it. He was very proud of his license. Max went to the park to meet his best friend, a little girl named Lily. They loved to play together. "Max, let's play ball!" Lily said. Max barked happily and wagged his tail. They played with the ball, running and laughing together. Suddenly, Max saw a big bird in the sky. He wanted to say hi to the bird. Max shouted, "Hello, bird!" The bird looked down and saw Max. The bird flew down and said, "Hello, Max! I heard you are famous and have a special license." Max smiled and showed the bird his license. They all played together until it was time to go home.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the store with his mom. They wanted to buy an expensive toy car. Tim was very excited. At the store, Tim saw a girl named Sue with a big, red ball. Tim wanted the ball too. Tim asked Sue, "Can we trade? I will give you my toy car for your ball." Sue said, "Okay, let's trade!" They traded their toys and were very happy. But then, something unexpected happened. Tim's toy car could talk! The car said, "Please take me back to Tim." The car would repeat this over and over. Sue was surprised and decided to trade back with Tim. When they traded their toys back, the toy car stopped talking. Tim and Sue became friends and played together with their toys.

Once upon a time, there was a big forest. In the forest, there was a big tree. A man wanted to cut the tree with an axe. The man was anxious because the tree was very big. A little bird saw the man and wanted to help him. The bird said, "Let's share the work. I will help you cut the tree with my beak." The man was happy, and they started to cut the tree together. After a while, the tree fell down. The man and the bird were very happy. They learned that when they share the work, it becomes easy. The moral of the story is, "Sharing makes things easier and better for everyone."

Once upon a time, there was a wealthy man named Tom. Tom lived in a big house near a station. Every day, Tom would watch the trains go by from his window. One day, Tom saw a little bird sitting on his window. "Hello, little bird," Tom said. "Would you like to settle in my big house?" The little bird nodded, and Tom let the bird come inside. Tom and the little bird became best friends. They played games and shared food. The little bird liked living in the big house with Tom. And every day, they would watch the trains go by from the window together.

One day, a big lion with a loud roar was walking in the woods. He saw a basket under a tree. The lion was very curious about the basket. He went close to the basket and looked inside. He saw a tiny kitten, who was uncomfortable and scared. The kitten looked up at the lion with big eyes. The lion felt bad for the kitten. He wanted to help the kitten feel better. So, the lion picked up the basket with his teeth and carried it to his cave. The kitten was still scared, but the lion was gentle and kind. He made a warm bed for the kitten in the cave. As the days went by, the kitten and the lion became best friends. The kitten was not scared anymore, and the lion did not roar as loud as before. They played together in the woods, and the kitten even learned how to roar like a lion. And the lion, who was once known for his loud roar, became the kindest and gentlest lion in the woods.

Once upon a time, in a land of winter, there was a big bear named Ben. Ben was an original bear because he had a blue spot on his nose. He lived in a cave with his family. One day, Ben went for a walk in the snow. He saw a soft, warm spot under a big tree. Ben thought it would be a good place to lie down and take a nap. So, he lay down and soon fell asleep. While Ben was sleeping, a little bird flew by and saw him. The bird thought Ben looked cold, so it found a warm blanket to cover him. When Ben woke up, he was warm and happy. He thanked the little bird, and they became friends. From that day on, they played together all winter long.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to help his mom in the kitchen. One hot and dry day, Tim was helping his mom make a cake. They put all the things they needed on the table. Tim was very excited. As they started to make the cake, Tim's mom had a hard time remembering the next step. She looked at her memory, but it was not there. Tim wanted to help, so he tried to remember too. Suddenly, he had an idea. He ran to his room and came back with a big book. It was the book where the cake recipe was! They followed the recipe in the book and finished making the cake. When they took the cake out of the oven, they saw something unexpected. The cake was not a normal cake, it was a rainbow cake! Tim and his mom were so surprised. They laughed and enjoyed the beautiful and tasty rainbow cake together. And from that day on, Tim always helped his mom with her memory, and they made many more fun and tasty things together.

Once upon a time, there was a lonely boy named Tim. He lived in a big house with a big elevator. Tim loved to collect toys. He had many toys, but he still felt lonely. One day, Tim met a girl named Sue. Sue also loved to collect toys. She asked Tim, "Do you want to play with me and share your toys?" Tim said, "Yes, I would love to play with you!" Tim and Sue played together with their toys in the big house. They took the elevator to go up and down. They were very happy. Now, Tim was not lonely anymore. They became best friends and collected toys together forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named May. She liked walking around in circles, so one day she decided to make a loop. It was a really big loop, and it was lots of fun. May even found a yellow ribbon to help her manage it! She kept walking around and around in her loop, and each time it got bigger and bigger. Suddenly, May started to feel really wobbly and she knew something was wrong. She tried to keep walking, but it was too hard and she eventually fell down. May was sad because she'd made the loop so big and she'd had so much fun. But the yellow ribbon she'd used to manage the loop had been too weak and it had snapped. May was very sad, but she still tried to keep walking around her loop. But even with her tiny steps, she just couldn't manage it. So with a heavy heart, May had to give up and her loop was never finished.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a different lunch every day. One day, she had a big red apple. The next day, she had a yummy yellow banana. Lily loved her different lunches. One sunny day, Lily went to the park with her lunch. She sat under a big tree to eat. A little bird flew down and said, "Hello, Lily! What do you have for lunch today?" Lily smiled and said, "I have a big green pear today!" The little bird looked sad. It said, "I hope I can have a different lunch too. I always eat the same seeds every day." Lily wanted to help the little bird. So, she gave the bird a small piece of her pear. The bird was very happy. From that day on, Lily and the bird shared their different lunches with each other. They became the best of friends. And they both hoped for many more happy days together.

Once upon a time, there was a big round shape and a small square shape. They were good friends and lived in a beautiful park. One day, they had a quarrel about who was the best shape. The big round shape said, "I am the best because I am big and round like the sun." The small square shape said, "No, I am the best because I am small and strong like a house." They could not agree and their quarrel got louder and louder. A disgusting smell came from a nearby trash can. The shapes stopped their quarrel and looked at the trash can. A little triangle shape came out and said, "Why are you fighting? You are both great shapes. We should all be friends." The big round shape and the small square shape agreed. They all became friends and played happily in the park. The disgusting smell went away and they never had a quarrel again.

Johnny and his mom were in the kitchen getting ready to make lunch. Johnny was playing with some paper while Mom opened the fridge. "Look what I found," said Mom. She pulled out a big surprise. It was a hot pizza. "Yay!" yelled Johnny. He loved pizza. Mom smiled and told Johnny to help her fold the pizza box. She showed him how to do it. Johnny was so excited that he folded the box quicker than Mom! After the box was closed, Mom said, "Let's have a surprise. I hid something inside." She opened the box and pulled out a little toy car. Johnny was so excited. He thanked his Mom and said, "Let's play cars!" They then enjoyed the hot pizza and Johnny's surprise.

Once upon a time, there was a sleepy cat named Fluffy. Fluffy lived in a small house with her friend, a little girl named Lily. Every day, Lily would do the laundry, and Fluffy would watch. One day, Fluffy saw a bird outside. She ran out the door to chase it. Lily saw Fluffy run away and called out, "Fluffy, come back!" But Fluffy did not hear her and kept running. Lily was sad. After a while, Fluffy got tired and missed her friend. She decided to return home. When she got back, Lily was so happy to see her. "Fluffy, I was worried about you!" Lily said. Fluffy meowed softly, and they both went inside to finish the laundry together.

Once upon a time, there was a busy street. On this street, there was a little shop. In the shop, there was an ashtray. The ashtray was very sad because it was always dirty. One day, a boy saw the ashtray and wanted to help. He tried to clean the ashtray, but he made a big mess. The boy was embarrass because people saw him make the mess. The shop owner was not happy with the boy. The ashtray stayed dirty and the boy went home sad. The busy street stayed messy and the ashtray never got clean.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a pink house. In the pink house, there lived a little girl named Lily and her mom. One day, Lily found a small seed in their yard. She asked her mom, "Can I plant this seed, please?" Her mom said, "Yes, but you must take care of it and remain patient. It will take a year to grow big and strong." Lily was excited and planted the seed. She watered it every day and made sure it had enough sun. Months went by, and the seed grew into a beautiful plant. Lily's friends would come over and ask her, "How did you make it grow so big?" Lily would smile and say, "I remained patient and took care of it every day for a whole year." The moral of the story is that good things come to those who are patient and take care of what they have.

One day, a dog named Spot and a cat named Fluffy were playing in the yard. They liked to play with their new ball. They were very happy. Spot said, "I have a surprise for you, Fluffy!" Fluffy was excited. "What is the surprise, Spot?" Fluffy asked. Spot ran to the tree and found a big box. Fluffy's eyes got big. They opened the box together. Inside, there were many new toys! They were so happy. But then, something unexpected happened. A bird flew down and said, "I have news! Those toys are for all the animals in the yard, not just you two." Spot and Fluffy looked at each other and smiled. They were happy to share their new toys with all their friends.

Once upon a time, there lived two friends called Tim and Perri. Tim was very envious of Perri, because she had a card that was special and sparkly. Every day, Perri would take the card out and show it to Tim, and then she would spread it open and show him the bright, colorful design inside. Tim would look at the card with envy in his eyes. Finally, one day, Tim asked Perri if she would share her card with him. She smiled and spread the card open, and placed it in Tim's hands. The two friends shared the card and admired it together, and Tim was so happy that he finally got to share Perri's magical sparkly card. From then on, Tim and Perri enjoyed sharing the card and making up secret stories about the beautiful design inside. They remained close friends, and Tim was no longer envious of the magical sparkly card.

Once upon a time, in a big park, there was a tall tree. Many kids loved to play near the tree. One day, a little boy named Tim came to play. He was a naughty boy who did not listen to his mom. Tim saw a squirrel on the tree. He wanted to catch the squirrel. He climbed up the tree very high. His mom saw him and said, "Tim, come down! It's not safe!" But Tim did not listen. As Tim went higher, a bird on the tree said, "Listen to your mom, Tim. It's not good to be naughty." Tim heard the bird and felt scared. He slowly climbed down and said sorry to his mom. From that day, Tim learned to listen and was not naughty anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a big boat. The boat liked to sail on the deep blue sea. One sunny day, the boat met a friendly tire floating on the water. "Hi tire," said the boat. "Do you want to sail with me on the deep blue sea?" "Yes, I would like that," said the tire with a big smile. So, the boat and the tire sailed together on the deep blue sea. As they sailed, they saw many fish and birds. The boat and the tire became very good friends. They liked to sail together and have fun. And they lived happily ever after.

Anna loved to draw with her crayons. She had many colors and shapes to make on her paper. She liked to draw her family, her friends, and her toys. Sometimes, she drew things that she saw in her dreams. One night, she had a very special dream. She dreamed that she was in a big garden with many flowers and butterflies. She saw a big rainbow in the sky. She wanted to draw the rainbow with her crayons, but she did not have them with her. She looked around and saw a fairy sitting on a mushroom. The fairy smiled and said, "Hello, Anna. Do you like my garden?" Anna nodded and said, "Yes, it is very pretty. But I want to draw it with my crayons. Do you have any crayons?" The fairy laughed and said, "I don't have crayons, but I have something better. I have magic dust. You can use it to draw anything you want in the air. Just close your eyes and imagine what you want to draw. Then, open your eyes and sprinkle some magic dust. You will see your drawing come to life." Anna was very excited. She closed her eyes and imagined a big rainbow. She opened her eyes and sprinkled some magic dust. She saw a bright and colorful rainbow appear in the air. She clapped her hands and said, "Wow, this is amazing. Thank you, fairy." The fairy said, "You're welcome, Anna. You can draw anything you want with my magic dust. But remember, this is only a dream. When you wake up, your drawings will be gone. So, enjoy them while you can." Anna nodded and said, "Okay, I will. Can I draw more things?" The fairy said, "Of course, you can. Have fun, Anna." Anna had fun drawing many things with the magic dust. She drew flowers, butterflies, stars, and hearts. She was very happy. She did not want to wake up. But soon, she heard a voice calling her name. It was her mom. "Anna, wake up. It's time to get ready for school." Anna opened her eyes and saw her mom standing by her bed. She rubbed her eyes and said, "Mom, I had a wonderful dream. I met a fairy who gave me magic dust. I drew a rainbow and many other things in the air. It was so beautiful." Her mom smiled and said, "That sounds like a lovely dream, Anna. But now, you have to get up and get dressed. You can tell me more about your dream later. Maybe, you can draw it with your crayons." Anna nodded and said, "Okay, mom. I will. But I wish I could keep the magic dust." Her mom said, "Maybe, you can find it again in your next dream. But for now, you have to be alert and ready for school. Come on, let's go." Anna got out of bed and followed her mom. She still felt the magic of her dream in her heart. She hoped to see the fairy again. She was glad she had her crayons to draw her dream. She thought, "Maybe, my crayons are magic too."

One day, a little boy named Tim found a pin on the floor. He picked it up and saw that it was very sharp. Tim decided to show it to his friend, Sarah. He ran to her and said, "Look what I found!" Sarah looked at the pin and said, "Be careful, Tim! It might hurt you." Tim was stubborn and did not listen to Sarah. He wanted to point the pin at things to see what it could do. He pointed it at a tree and saw that it made a little hole. Then he pointed it at a rock, but it did not make a hole. Tim was having fun, but he was not being safe. Suddenly, a big wind blew and the pin flew out of Tim's hand. It landed in a pile of leaves. Tim and Sarah were sad and scared. They did not know what to do. Just then, a friendly squirrel came and found the pin. The squirrel picked it up and gave it back to Tim. Tim said, "Thank you, squirrel!" From that day on, Tim learned to be more careful with sharp things and to listen to his friends.

One day, a big cat and a little dog were playing in the park. The big cat said, "I need to find a good toy to play with." The little dog said, "I know where to find a good toy." They took a turn and found a big ball. The big cat said, "This is a good toy!" They played with the ball and had a lot of fun. But then, a big rain came. The big cat and the little dog got wet and cold. The big cat said, "We need to go home now." They tried to find their way back, but they were lost. The big cat and the little dog walked and walked, but they could not find their home. They were very sad and tired. The big cat said, "We should not have taken that turn." In the end, the big cat and the little dog could not find their home. They stayed in the park, wet and cold, wishing they had not played with the big ball.

Lily liked to organize her toys. She had a big box for her dolls, a small box for her cars, and a shelf for her books. She liked to make everything neat and pretty. One day, Lily's mom said they had to go to the dentist at noon. Lily did not like the dentist. She was scared of the big chair, the loud drill, and the shiny tools. She wanted to stay home and play with her toys. But Lily's mom said it was important to take care of her teeth. She said Lily was a brave girl and she could do it. She said they would have a special treat after the dentist. Lily decided to be brave. She put on her coat and shoes, and took her favorite doll with her. She hugged her doll and said, "We can do it, doll. We are brave." At the dentist, Lily sat on the big chair and opened her mouth. The dentist was nice and gentle. He counted her teeth, cleaned them, and gave her a sticker. He said Lily was a very good and brave patient. Lily smiled and thanked the dentist. She was proud of herself. She had done it. She and her doll were brave. She and her mom went to get ice cream as a special treat. Lily was happy. She had organized her toys, gone to the dentist, and had ice cream. It was a good day.

One day, a little girl named Lucy was playing in her room. She had a pretty skirt that she loved to wear. It was pink and had a lot of colors. Lucy liked to spin in her skirt and watch the colors twirl. As she was spinning, something unknown appeared in her room. It was a little cat! The cat had a note on its collar. Lucy could not read, so she took the cat to her mom. Her mom read the note out loud. It said, "This cat is magic. It can grant you one wish." Lucy was so excited! She thought about what she wanted to wish for. She decided to wish for a huge ice cream cone. The cat closed its eyes and meowed. Suddenly, a big ice cream cone appeared in Lucy's hands! She was so happy and shared it with her mom and the magic cat. They all enjoyed the sweet treat together.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She had a job to deliver mail to all her friends. Lily liked her job a lot. She would walk and say "hi" to her friends when she gave them their mail. One day, it started to rain. Lily needed to keep the mail dry. She looked around and saw a big tree. The tree had a lot of big leaves. Lily went under the tree to stay dry. The mail stayed dry too. After the rain stopped, Lily went back to work. She delivered all the mail to her friends. They were happy to see her and their dry mail. Lily felt good that she did her job well.

Once upon a time, there was an adorable dog named Binky. Binky lived in a small house with his best friend, a mechanic named Tom. They were always happy and loved to play together. One day, Binky saw a sad little bird outside the window. He wanted to help and comfort the bird, so he asked Tom if they could go outside. "Tom, can we go out and help the sad bird?" Binky asked. Tom agreed, and they went outside to comfort the sad little bird. They played with the bird and soon, the bird was happy again. But then, a big storm came, and they all ran back to the house. The wind was very strong, and it blew the door shut. Tom, Binky, and the bird tried to open the door, but it was stuck. They were very scared and didn't know what to do. The storm got worse, and the little house started to shake. Tom, Binky, and the bird huddled together for comfort. Suddenly, the house fell down around them. They were all very sad and scared. The moral of the story is that sometimes, even when we try to help others, bad things can still happen. But it's important to always be kind and try to comfort those in need.

Once there was a gifted dog named Spot. Spot could do many things other dogs could not. Spot had a plan to make a big start. He wanted to show his friends how he could jump high and run fast. One day, Spot talked to his friend, Cat. He said, "I have a plan to show everyone my tricks. I will start tomorrow." Cat said, "That sounds fun! I will come and watch you." The next day, all the animals came to see Spot. He jumped high and ran fast, just like he planned. The animals clapped and cheered. Spot was happy that his plan worked and his big start was a success.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park. He wanted to observe the birds and play. Tim was glad because it was a sunny day. In the park, he saw a girl named Sue. Sue was sad because she lost her toy. "Hi Sue, why are you sad?" asked Tim. Sue said, "I lost my toy. Can you help me find it?" Tim was happy to help. They looked for the toy together, but they could not find it. They felt tired and sat down. Just then, a big dog came to them. The dog had Sue's toy in its mouth. "Welcome, dog! Thank you for finding my toy," said Sue. But the dog did not give the toy back. It ran away with the toy, and they could not catch it. Tim and Sue were sad because they lost the toy forever.

Once upon a time, in a small house, there was a boy named Tim. Tim loved to skip and play with his toy car. One sunny day, he went outside to skip with his friends. While they were skipping, Tim saw an open box. He was curious and looked inside. He found a big piece of beef! Tim and his friends were very surprised. They didn't know what to do with the beef. Tim had an idea. He decided to take the beef home and give it to his mom. When he got home, his mom was so happy. She told Tim that the beef was just what they needed for dinner. The whole family enjoyed a yummy beef dinner, and Tim felt proud that he could help his mom.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy dog named Spot. Spot did not like to play or run. He just liked to sleep all day. Spot's heart was not very strong because he was so lazy. One day, a little bird named Chirpy came to Spot. Chirpy was very worry. She lost her mom and dad. She asked Spot to help her find them. But Spot did not want to help. He just wanted to sleep. Chirpy tried to find her mom and dad by herself. But she was too little and the world was too big. In the end, Chirpy did not find her mom and dad. She was very sad. Spot did not help, and now Chirpy was all alone.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy was very independent. She loved to dress up and play with her toys. Her favorite toy was a laser. The laser made bright lights and fun sounds. One day, Lucy was playing with her laser when her friend Tom came over. Tom said, "Lucy, can I play with your laser too?" Lucy said, "Yes, we can play together!" So, Lucy and Tom played with the laser and had lots of fun. But then, something unexpected happened. The laser made a funny noise and turned into a magic wand! Lucy and Tom were surprised. They waved the magic wand and their toys came to life. They played with their new toy friends all day long.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a little boy named Tom. Tom wanted to gain success by doing a crazy dance. He practiced his dance every day. Tom's dance made people laugh and feel happy. One day, Tom met a girl named Sally. Sally asked, "What are you doing, Tom?" Tom said, "I am doing my crazy dance. I want to gain success and make people happy." Sally smiled and said, "I want to learn your dance too!" So, Tom and Sally practiced the crazy dance together. Soon, they were very good at it. They danced in the village and made everyone laugh. Tom and Sally gained success and happiness by doing their crazy dance. And they became the best of friends, always ready to share their dance and make others happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia lived with her old cat, Tom. Tom was a magic cat. Mia and Tom loved to play and eat together. One day, Mia and Tom went to the park. They saw a big cake. It was a magic cake. Mia and Tom wanted to eat the cake. They took a bite and something unexpected happened. Mia and Tom switched places! Mia was now a cat and Tom was a little girl. They laughed and played all day. At the end of the day, they ate the magic cake again and switched back. Mia and Tom were happy to be themselves again, and they knew they had a very special secret.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a very alert boy. He always watched and listened to everything around him. One day, Tim went to the park with his mom. He was so happy to play with his new toy car. While Tim was playing, a thief came to the park. The thief saw Tim's toy car and wanted it for himself. The thief sneaked up and tried to take the toy car. But Tim was alert and saw the thief. Tim yelled, "No, that's my car!" Tim's mom heard him yell and came running. She saw the thief and shouted, "Go away!" The thief was scared and tried to run away. But Tim's mom was fast and grabbed the thief's shirt. It began to tear, and the thief dropped the toy car. Tim picked up his toy car and hugged his mom. They were both very happy that they had stopped the thief. From that day on, Tim knew that being alert was very important. And he always made sure to keep a close eye on his toys.

One day, a little girl named Lucy went to play with her friends. They were playing a fun game. Lucy had a pin in her hand. She wanted to put it on her shirt. While they were playing, Lucy's pin fell on the ground. Her friend, Tim, saw the pin and picked it up. He started to clap and laugh. Lucy felt embarrassed. She wanted her pin back. Lucy asked Tim for her pin. Tim didn't want to give it back. Lucy was sad. Then, a big girl named Sue came and helped Lucy. Sue told Tim to give the pin back. Tim gave the pin back to Lucy. Lucy was happy and clapped her hands. Now, they all played together and had fun.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there was a brown dog named Max. Max loved to run and catch balls. One day, Max was playing catch with his friend, a little boy named Tim. As they were playing, Max saw a fire in a house. Max barked, "Woof, woof!" Tim looked and saw the fire too. Tim said, "Oh no, Max! We must get help!" Tim and Max ran to the village people and told them about the fire. The people came with water and put out the fire. The house was saved, and everyone was happy. The village people thanked Max and Tim for their help. They said, "You both are very brave!" Max wagged his tail, and Tim smiled. From that day on, Max and Tim became heroes in their village, and they continued to play catch every day.

Tom and Sam were best friends. They liked to play outside and pretend they were cowboys. They had hats and boots and toy guns. One day, they found a large gun in the shed. It looked like a real gun, but they did not know. "Wow, look at this!" Tom said, picking up the gun. "It is so big and heavy. I bet it can shoot very far." "Be careful, Tom," Sam said. "You don't know how to use it. It might be dangerous." "Don't worry, Sam," Tom said. "It is just a toy, like ours. I remember Dad told me once that guns are not for kids, but he was joking. He likes to joke a lot. Watch this, I will show you how to shoot it." Tom pointed the gun at a can on the fence. He pulled the trigger. But nothing happened. The gun did not make a sound or a flash. Tom frowned. He tried again. Still nothing. "See, Sam, it is not working. It is a broken toy. It is no fun. Let's go play with our guns instead." Tom threw the gun on the ground and ran to get his toy gun. Sam followed him. They did not see the man who came out of the shed. He was angry. He saw the large gun on the ground. He picked it up and checked it. It was his gun. It was real. It was loaded. He had put the safety on, but Tom had turned it off. He was lucky that the gun did not fire. "Hey, you kids!" the man shouted. "What are you doing with my gun? Do you know how dangerous this is? You could have killed yourselves or someone else!" Tom and Sam stopped and turned around. They saw the man with the large gun. They were scared. They did not know what to say. They wished they had listened to Sam. They wished they had remembered Dad's joke. They wished they had never found the large gun.

Once upon a time, there was a playful dog named Spot. Spot loved to run and play all day. One day, Spot had a task. He needed to find his favorite ball. Spot looked everywhere for his ball. He could not find it. He felt sad. Then, Spot saw a big cat. The cat had his ball! Spot did not recognize the cat. The cat was not nice. The cat said, "You can't have the ball!" Spot was sad but he had an idea. He found a new ball. He gave the new ball to the cat. The cat liked the new ball. The cat gave Spot his ball back. Spot was happy. Now, Spot and the cat could play together.

Once upon a time, there was a zebra. The zebra liked to scatter yummy food for his friends. One day, he found a big pile of apples. The zebra called his friends, the bird, the dog, and the cat. They all came running to eat the yummy apples. The zebra scattered the apples around so everyone could have some. They all ate and played together. The zebra and his friends were happy. They loved the yummy apples and they all had a fun day.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a famous cat named Tom. Tom was well-known for his big, fluffy tail. One day, Tom went for a walk outside. He looked up and saw a big, gray cloud in the sky. Tom knew that the cloud meant rain was coming. He wanted to play outside all day, but he didn't want his fluffy tail to get wet and spoil. So, Tom went to his friend, a wise old dog named Max. Max told Tom that it was okay if his tail got wet. He said that sometimes things get wet, dirty, or spoiled, but they can always be fixed. Max told Tom that playing outside and having fun was more important than keeping his tail perfect. Tom listened to Max and decided to play outside, even if his tail got wet. He had a great time playing with his friends in the rain. When the rain stopped, Tom's tail was wet and not fluffy, but he was happy. He learned that having fun and making memories with his friends was more important than keeping his tail perfect. And that was the moral value Tom learned that day.

Ben and Sam are friends. They like to play outside. Ben has a new bicycle. It is red and shiny. Sam has an old bicycle. It is blue and rusty. "Look at my bicycle!" Ben says to Sam. "It is fast and cool. Do you want to try it?" Sam looks at Ben's bicycle. He likes it, but he also likes his bicycle. "No, thank you," he says to Ben. "My bicycle is old, but it is good. It can go up and down hills. It can match your bicycle." Ben laughs. He does not think Sam's bicycle can match his bicycle. "Let's have a race then," he says to Sam. "We can go to the big tree and back. The first one to come back is the winner. Are you ready?" Sam nods. He is ready. He likes races. He gets on his bicycle and waits for Ben. Ben gets on his bicycle and counts. "One, two, three, go!" They start to pedal. Ben's bicycle is fast, but Sam's bicycle is steady. They go to the big tree and turn around. Ben is ahead, but Sam is close. They come back to the start. Ben is almost there, but Sam is faster. He passes Ben and reaches the start first. He is the winner. "Wow, you are fast!" Ben says to Sam. "Your bicycle can match my bicycle. You are a good racer. Can we race again?" Sam smiles. He is happy. He likes Ben and his bicycle. "Yes, we can race again," he says to Ben. "But first, do you want to share my snack? I have some cookies and juice." Ben nods. He is hungry. He likes cookies and juice. He likes Sam and his bicycle. "Yes, please," he says to Sam. "You are a good friend. And your bicycle is not old. It is awesome."

One day, a wise old owl went on a safari. He wanted to see all the animals. He flew high in the sky and saw lions, elephants, and giraffes. The wise owl was so happy to see all the animals. The wise owl wanted to play a game. He said, "Let's all imagine we are different animals." The lions imagined they were birds. The elephants imagined they were monkeys. The giraffes imagined they were fish. All the animals were having fun. But then, something unexpected happened. The wise owl imagined he was a lion. He roared so loud that all the animals got scared. They did not know it was the wise owl. The wise owl laughed and said, "It's okay, it's just me!" All the animals laughed too, and they all went back to playing their game.

Once upon a time, there was a big fridge in a small house. The fridge was full of yummy food. A little boy named Tim lived in the house with his mom and dad. They all loved the fridge and the food inside. One day, Tim wanted to help his mom cook. He tried to open the fridge, but it was very hard. Tim felt a little stupid because he could not open it. He wanted to admire all the food inside the fridge. Mom saw Tim was sad and came to help. She opened the fridge and let Tim admire the food. Together, they cooked a yummy meal for the family. Tim felt happy and not stupid anymore. From that day on, Tim loved to help his mom cook and admire the food in the fridge.

Lily and Ben were best friends. They liked to play in the park and pretend they were knights and princesses. One day, they saw a big hill with a cave. They wondered what was inside. "Let's go and see!" said Ben. "Maybe there is a dragon!" Lily was scared. She did not like dragons. They were big and loud and had fire. She said, "No, Ben, I don't want to go. What if the dragon hurts us?" Ben said, "Don't worry, Lily. I will protect you. I have a sword and a shield. And I promise, I will not leave you alone. Come on, it will be fun!" Lily trusted Ben. He was her best friend. He always kept his promises. She said, "Okay, Ben, I will go with you. But you have to hold my hand." Ben nodded. He took Lily's hand and they walked to the cave. They were brave and curious. They wanted to see the dragon. When they reached the cave, they heard a roar. It was the dragon! It was big and green and had scales and horns. It saw Lily and Ben and opened its mouth. It was ready to breathe fire. Lily and Ben were scared. They wanted to run away. But Ben remembered his promise. He said, "Lily, stay behind me. I will fight the dragon. You are my friend and I will not leave you alone." He raised his sword and shield and faced the dragon. He shouted, "Go away, dragon! This is our park and you are not welcome here!" The dragon was surprised. It did not expect a little boy to challenge it. It was curious and amused. It said, "Who are you, little boy? And why do you have a sword and a shield?" Ben said, "I am Ben, the knight. And this is Lily, the princess. We are playing in the park and you are ruining our game. You are big and loud and have fire. You are scary and mean. You have to leave!" The dragon said, "I am not scary and mean. I am lonely and bored. I have no friends and no games. I only have fire. And I like fire. It is warm and bright and beautiful. Do you want to see my fire?" Ben said, "No, we don't want to see your fire. Your fire is dangerous and hot and hurts. We don't like fire. We like flowers and trees and swings. We like to play and laugh and hug. We don't want to play with you. You are a dragon and we are not." The dragon said, "But I want to play with you. You are brave and curious and have swords and shields. You are fun and interesting and have friends and games. I want to be your friend and play your games. Can I be your friend and play your games?" Lily and Ben looked at each other. They felt sorry for the dragon. He was lonely and bored. He wanted to be their friend and play their games. Maybe he was not so scary and mean. Maybe he was just different and misunderstood. Maybe they could be his friends and play his games. Lily said, "Okay, dragon, you can be our friend and play our games. But you have to be nice and gentle and not breathe fire. You have to be careful and quiet and not hurt us. You have to promise, promise, promise!" The dragon nodded. He said, "I promise, promise, promise! I will be nice and gentle and not breathe fire. I will be careful and quiet and not hurt you. I will be your friend and play your games. Thank you, thank you, thank you!" Lily and Ben smiled. They said, "You're welcome, welcome, welcome! Come on, let's go and play!" They took the dragon's hand and they walked out of the cave. They were happy and excited. They had a new friend and a new game. They were successful and proud. They had found the dragon and made him their friend. They had kept their promises and had fun. They were the best knights and princesses in the park.

Once upon a time, in a mild summer, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. They saw many flowers, trees, and a big blue sky. Tim was very happy. At the park, Tim saw a dog. The dog was big and brown. Tim asked his mom, "Mom, do we know that dog?" His mom said, "No, but it seems to recognize us. Maybe it's a friend's dog." Tim and his mom played with the dog. They ran and laughed in the warm sun. The dog was very happy too. After playing, they all sat under a tree and ate a yummy snack. It was a fun day for Tim, his mom, and the dog.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom loved to build with his toy blocks. He also loved cookies. One day, Tom had a big idea. He wanted to build something new. It was not a regular house or tower. He wanted to build a cookie house! Tom asked his mom for help. His mom said yes. They started to make cookies. They made big cookies, small cookies, and round cookies. They put the cookies on a big plate. Tom was very happy. He started to build his cookie house. Tom's cookie house was almost done. But then, something unexpected happened. Tom's dog, Spot, ran into the room. Spot saw the cookies and jumped up. He ate all the cookies in the cookie house! Tom was very sad. His cookie house was gone. The story had a bad ending because Tom could not build his cookie house again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. His mom and dad used to always talk and discuss things in the kitchen. But one day, they were discussing something very quietly. The little boy was curious. He wanted to know what they were talking about, so he crept up to the door. He heard them talking about soup. He wanted some soup, but his parents said it was not ready yet. He felt sad and frustrated. But then, he heard his dad say: "Soup is a great way to show love. We should always help each other and share, even when things are quiet." The little boy thought about what his dad said. He understood that even if he couldn't always get what he wanted, he should still be patient and kind. That's the moral of the story!

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Lucky. Lucky was a very happy dog. He liked to run and play with his friends. One day, Lucky met a big dog named Teach. Teach was very good at playing games. Lucky wanted to learn how to play too. Teach urged Lucky to play with him and his friends. Lucky and Teach played and played. They had so much fun. Lucky felt lucky to have a friend like Teach. They played every day and Lucky learned many new games. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Charlie and Daisy. Charlie and Daisy were three years old and were best friends. One day, they were playing in Daisy's backyard when they noticed a delicious place up in a tree. Charlie said to Daisy, "Let's go and get it!" Daisy agreed and they started to climb. When they reached the place, they saw that it was full of delicious wrapped sweets. Charlie said they should each take one. Daisy said, "No, we should share them!" Charlie said, "No, I want them all for myself!" Charlie started to wrap the sweets in his shirt. He was about to climb down when Daisy said, "Stop! Don't be so greedy! We should share them all." Charlie thought for a moment and said, "OK, let's share them." Daisy and Charlie shared the delicious sweets and agreed to always take turns and share with each other.

Jeff and Hazel were best friends. They loved playing together every day. One day, Hazel wanted to play on Jeff's new brown yacht. Jeff said no. Hazel got really mad and said, "I don't want to be your friend anymore!" Jeff felt very sad. Then, the next day Hazel came to play again. Jeff said, "I'm sorry for not letting you play on the yacht, can you forgive me?" Hazel said, "Yes, I forgive you!" They hugged each other and then started playing together. They had lots of fun, and they were best friends again. The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She was an adventurous girl who loved to dance. One sunny day, Sue went to the park to play with her friends. At the park, Sue met a talking bird named Bob. Bob was a funny bird who could dance too. Sue asked Bob, "Do you want to dance with me?" Bob said, "Yes, I would love to dance with you, Sue!" So, they danced together and had a lot of fun. After dancing, Sue and Bob were thirsty. They went to a small store to buy a drink. In the store, they saw a jar of salt. Sue knew that salt was good for food, but not for drinks. They bought some juice instead. Sue and Bob sat on a bench, drank their juice, and talked about their fun day. They became best friends and had many more adventures together.

Sara likes to study the garden. She likes to see the flowers and the bugs and the birds. She likes to touch the leaves and the dirt and the rocks. She likes to smell the roses and the mint and the lemon. One day, Sara finds a smooth stone in the garden. It is round and shiny and gray. She picks it up and feels how cool and heavy it is. She wonders what it is and where it came from. She puts it in her pocket and runs to show her mom. Mom is in the kitchen. She is making a cake for Sara's birthday. She sees Sara and smiles. She asks her what she has in her pocket. Sara takes out the smooth stone and shows it to her mom. She tells her she found it in the garden and she wants to keep it. Mom looks at the smooth stone and nods. She tells Sara it is a special stone. She says it is a fossil. She says it is very old and it used to be a shell of a sea animal. She says it is a gift from the earth and the water and the time. Sara is amazed. She holds the smooth stone closer and feels its smoothness. She thinks it is beautiful and wonderful. She thanks her mom and gives her a hug. She says she loves her and she loves the garden and she loves the fossil. She says she wants to study more things in the garden and learn more stories from the earth. Mom says she is proud of her and she is happy to help her. She says they can study the garden together and have fun. She says they can also eat the cake and celebrate. Sara agrees and smiles. She puts the smooth stone back in her pocket and follows her mom to the table. She thinks it is the best birthday ever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a toy named Mr. Bear. They loved to play together. One day, Lily saw a screen. She saw other kids playing on the screen. Lily wanted to play with them. But Mr. Bear felt upset. Lily tried to cheer Mr. Bear up. She said, "Don't be upset, Mr. Bear. We can play together and watch the screen too." Mr. Bear smiled a little. They played and watched the screen together. Mr. Bear felt better. Later, Lily's mommy came into the room. She mentioned, "Lily, it's time to eat." Lily and Mr. Bear stopped playing. They went to eat with mommy. After eating, Lily and Mr. Bear played and watched the screen again. They were happy.

Lily loved to visit her grandpa's ranch. She liked to see the cows, the horses, and the chickens. She also liked to play with her grandpa's dog, Spot. Spot was a big, brown, and charming dog. He was always happy to see Lily and to run with her in the fields. One day, Lily and Spot were playing near the barn when they heard a loud noise. It was a tractor. The tractor was very big and very noisy. It scared Spot. Spot ran away from the tractor and into the woods. Lily called for him, but he did not come back. Lily was very sad. She ran to her grandpa and told him what happened. Her grandpa hugged her and said, "Don't worry, Lily. Spot will come back. He is a smart and brave dog. He knows the way home. He just needs some time to calm down." Lily and her grandpa waited for Spot. They looked at the sky and saw the stars. They heard the crickets and the owls. They smelled the hay and the flowers. But they did not hear Spot. Lily started to weep. She missed Spot. She wanted to hug him and play with him. She said, "Grandpa, I'm sorry. I scared Spot. I want him to come back. I love him." Her grandpa said, "I know, Lily. I love him too. But you didn't scare him. The tractor did. It was not your fault. Spot loves you too. He will come back. I promise." As he said that, they heard a bark. It was Spot. He came out of the woods and ran to Lily and her grandpa. He licked their faces and wagged his tail. He was happy to see them. Lily was overjoyed. She hugged Spot and said, "Spot, you're back! I'm so glad. I'm sorry you were scared. I love you." Spot barked and nuzzled her. He was not scared anymore. He was safe and loved. Lily and her grandpa smiled and said, "Welcome back, Spot. You're a good dog. We love you too." They all went to the house and had some cookies and milk. They were a happy family. They had a charming dog. They lived on a ranch. They were very lucky.

One day, a little frog named Tim was hopping in the park. He liked to hop on the soft grass and play with his friends. Tim saw a big bike with pedals. He wanted to try it. Tim hopped on the bike and started to pedal. His friends said, "Wow, Tim! You look so proud on the bike!" Tim felt happy and proud. He pedaled faster and faster, but then something unexpected happened. The bike started to hop like a frog! Tim was surprised and scared. The bike said, "Don't worry, Tim! I am a magic bike. I can hop too!" Tim laughed and they hopped together. They had a fun day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was a restless boy. He liked to run, jump, and play all day long. One day, Tim's mom asked him to bring her the soap. She needed it to wash his dirty clothes. Tim went to the bathroom to find the soap. He looked on the sink, but it was not there. He looked in the bathtub, but it was not there either. Finally, he found the soap under the sink. He picked it up and ran back to his mom. "Here is the soap, mom!" Tim said, as he handed her the soap. His mom smiled and thanked him. She told him that he was a big help. Tim felt happy that he could help his mom. After that, Tim was not as restless. He learned that helping others can be fun too.

Once upon a time, there was a blue computer. It was a very special computer because it could talk. The computer lived in a big room with lots of toys and colors. One day, a little boy named Tim came into the room. He saw the blue computer and said, "Hello, computer! What can you do?" The computer smiled and said, "I can help design things! What do you want to make?" Tim thought for a moment and said, "I want to design a big, fun park with lots of slides and swings!" The blue computer was happy to help. They worked together to make the best park ever. Tim was very proud of their creation, and the blue computer was happy to have a new friend.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a police officer named Tom. Tom was very good at his job. He made sure everyone was safe and happy. His job was not always easy, but he loved helping people. One day, Tom found a magic hat. When he put it on, he started to shrink! He became very tiny, like a toy. Tom was scared but he knew he needed to be brave. He wanted to be big again so he could help people. Tom asked his friends for help. They looked for a way to make him big again. They tried many things, but nothing worked. Then, a little girl found a note under the magic hat. It said, "To grow big again, just say the magic word 'please'". Tom said "please" and he grew back to his normal size. He was so happy! Tom knew that even when things are not easy, friends can help you.

Once upon a time there lived a little girl. She was very busy and she had many toys. Every day she would polish her toys and make them look very nice. One day, she had a big urge to go to the toy store. She begged her mom to take her, but her mom told her she was too busy. The little girl kept asking and asking but her mom did not change her mind. Finally, one day the little girl's mom said "Ok, I will take you". She was so happy, she quickly polished her favorite toys and ran out the door. On the way to the toy store, the little girl's mom said "You know, I told you no earlier because if you don't learn to handle all your own activities, you won't have time for fun things like going to the toy store." The little girl understood. From that day on she learned to balance her fun activities and her busy routines. That way she always had a bit of time for having fun, and also for polishing her toys!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big, orange piano in her room. Lily loved to play on her piano every day. One day, Lily had a friend named Tim come over to play. They decided to pretend to be in a band. Lily played her orange piano, and Tim played on a toy drum. They made up a fun song together. They laughed and had a great time. As they played, Lily's mom came into the room. She said, "Wow, you two sound great! Can I join your band?" Lily and Tim said, "Yes, of course!" So, Lily's mom grabbed a toy guitar and played with them. They all pretended to be in a band and had a wonderful day playing music together.

Once upon a time there wasa a boy named Jim. Jim saw something shiny in the sky. He wanted to pick it up. It was a guitar! Jim felt excited and ran as fast as he could to pick it up. When he reached it, he held it as tight as he could. He was so happy to have found it. Jim wanted to learn how to use the guitar like a real musician. So he started to practice every day. He worked very hard, and soon he could play songs fast. Jim's friends were so proud of him. They all sang and danced while Jim played the guitar. Everyone was so happy! From then on, Jim was known as the fastest guitar player in the world!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a modest market. Many people went there to buy food and toys. It was a happy place where everyone liked to go. One day, a sneaky fox came to the market. He saw a big, red apple and wanted it. But he did not want to pay. So, he tried to steal the apple when no one was looking. But a kind little girl saw the fox. She said, "Mr. Fox, you should not steal. It is not nice." The fox felt bad and gave the apple back. From that day on, the fox never tried to steal again. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a boy. He was always playing games and today he wanted to win one. He went to the park and saw a nice big field. He saw a worm in the field. "I want to win!" the boy said. He took a step forward and his foot got wet. The ground was wet! The boy looked around and saw a little puddle with water. He had an idea. He picked up the worm and placed it in the puddle. It was a race! He said to the worm, "You win if you get to the other side of the puddle first!" The boy waited for a few minutes and then the worm started to move. It was slow but it kept going. The boy was so excited. The worm was winning! In the end, the boy was so happy because the worm was the winner. He pumped his fist out in the air and laughed. He knew if he had been race, he would have won, but he was happy that the worm had won.

Tom and Anna like to play with their cars. They have many cars of different colors and sizes. Some cars are old and some cars are modern. Modern cars are shiny and fast. One day, Tom and Anna decide to have a race with their cars. They make a track with their blocks and books. They choose their cars and get ready to start. Tom picks a modern car that is red and silver. Anna picks an old car that is blue and yellow. "Ready, set, go!" Tom says and pushes his car. Anna pushes her car too. The cars zoom along the track, passing the blocks and books. Tom's car is faster than Anna's car. He thinks he will win the race. But then, something happens. Tom's car hits a book and flips over. It lands on its roof and stops. Anna's car keeps going and reaches the end of the track. Anna jumps up and cheers. "I win! I win!" Anna says. "My car is the best!" Tom feels sad and angry. He picks up his car and wipes the dust off it. He looks at Anna and says, "No, you don't win. You cheat! You put the book there to make me crash!" Anna shakes her head and says, "No, I don't cheat. You are just a sore loser. You can't handle my victory!" Tom and Anna start to argue. They yell and call each other names. They forget to have fun and be nice. They are not friends anymore.

One day, a little girl named Lily found a pretty yellow dress in her closet. She loved the dress very much. She put it on and went outside to play. While she was playing, she saw a little bird with a hurt wing. The bird said, "Help me, please!" Lily wanted to save the bird. She picked it up and took it to her mom. Her mom helped her save the bird. They put a bandage on its wing. Then, something unexpected happened. The bird turned into a fairy! The fairy said, "Thank you for saving me, Lily! I will give you a wish for being so kind." Lily thought and thought. She wished for a big yellow dress for her mom. Now, they both had pretty yellow dresses and played together every day.

One day, a little boy named Tim went for a walk. He saw an open field with lots of snow. In the field, he found an igloo. Tim was very happy and wanted to play in the igloo. Tim tried to get inside the igloo, but he had to struggle. He was too big for the small door. Tim pushed and pushed, but he could not get in. He was sad and sat down in the snow. Then, a little girl named Sue came to help Tim. Sue was smaller and could fit in the igloo. She went inside and made the door bigger. Now, Tim could go in too. They both played in the igloo and had a fun day.

Once upon a time, there was a cheerful little girl named Lucy. She loved to play with her best friend, a cute dog named Max. They played in the park every day, running and laughing together. One day, while Lucy and Max were playing, Lucy told Max a secret. "Max," she whispered, "I sometimes feel embarrass when I can't tie my shoes." Max looked at her and said, "Don't worry, Lucy. I can't tie shoes either, but we can learn together!" Just then, a talking bird flew down from a tree. "Hello, Lucy and Max!" said the bird. "I heard your secret and I can help you learn to tie your shoes." Lucy and Max were very surprised that the bird could talk, but they were also happy for the help. The talking bird showed Lucy and Max how to tie their shoes, and they practiced together. Soon, they could both tie their shoes very well. Lucy was no longer embarrass about her shoes, and they all became good friends. From that day on, the park was filled with even more laughter and fun.

Once upon a time, there was a clean leopard named Leo. Leo lived in a big jungle with many friends. One day, Leo met a little bird named Bella. Bella was sad because she lost her way home. "Hi Bella, why are you sad?" asked Leo. "I can't find my home," said Bella. "Don't worry, I will help you," said Leo with a smile. Leo and Bella started to look for Bella's home. They walked and walked until they found a big tree. The tree was shaking! Leo and Bella were scared, but they went closer to see what was happening. A big monkey named Max was shaking the tree. "Hi Max, why are you shaking the tree?" asked Leo. "I am looking for yummy fruit," said Max. "Can you help us find Bella's home?" asked Leo. Max agreed to help them. Together, Leo, Bella, and Max found Bella's home. Bella was happy and thanked her new friends. They all played together and became best friends forever.
